trans-unit.source: View or edit detailed information for the products that you trade in. The item card can be of type Inventory or Service to specify if the item is a physical unit or a labor time unit. Here you also define if items in inventory or on incoming orders are automatically reserved for outbound documents and whether order tracking links are created between demand and supply to reflect planning actions.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger detaljerede oplysninger om de produkter, du handler med. Varekortet kan være af typen lager eller tjeneste for at angive, om varen er en fysisk enhed eller en består af arbejdstimer. Her angiver du også, om varerne på lager eller i indgående ordrer automatisk reserveres til udgående bilag, og om der er oprettet ordresporingsbindinger mellem behov og forsyning for at afspejle planlægningshandlinger.

trans-unit.source: Move inventory items between company locations. With transfer orders, you ship the outbound transfer from one location and receive the inbound transfer at the other location. This allows you to manage the involved warehouse activities and provides more certainty that inventory quantities are updated correctly.

Med overflytningsordrer kan du sende udgående overflytninger fra én lokation og modtage den indgående overførsel på den anden lokation. Derved kan du administrere de involverede lageraktiviteter, og det øger sikkerheden for, at vareantallet opdateres korrekt.

trans-unit.source: Adjust the quantity of an item in a particular bin or bins. For instance, you might find some items in a bin that are not registered in the system, or you might not be able to pick the quantity needed because there are fewer items in a bin than was calculated by the program. The bin is then updated to correspond to the actual quantity in the bin. In addition, it creates a balancing quantity in the adjustment bin, for synchronization with item ledger entries, which you can then post with an item journal.
trans-unit.target: Reguler antallet af en vare på én eller flere placeringer. Det kan f.eks. være, at du finder nogle varer på en placering, der ikke er registreret i systemet, eller at du ikke kan plukke det nødvendige antal, fordi der er færre varer på en placering, som programmet har beregnet. Placeringen opdateres derefter, så den svarer til det faktiske antal på placeringen. Desuden oprettes et udlignende antal på reguleringsplaceringen til synkronisering med vareposter, som du derefter kan bogføre med en varekladde.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Whse. Worker WMS Role Center - Action Whse. Item &Journal - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Whse. Worker WMS Role Center - Action Whse. Item &Journal - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit detailed information for the customers that you trade with. From each customer card, you can open related information, such as sales statistics and ongoing orders, and you can define special prices and line discounts that you grant if certain conditions are met.
trans-unit.target: Få vist eller rediger detaljerede oplysninger om de debitorer, som du handler med. Fra det enkelte debitorkort kan du få adgang til relaterede oplysninger, som f.eks. salgsstatistik og igangværende ordrer, og du kan definere specialpriser og linjerabatter, som debitoren får, når bestemte betingelser er opfyldt.

The bin is then updated to correspond to the actual quantity in the bin. trans-unit.source: Prepare to count inventories by preparing the documents that warehouse employees use when they perform a physical inventory of selected items or of all the inventory. When the physical count has been made, you enter the number of items that are in the bins in this window, and then you register the physical inventory.

trans-unit.source: View a list of the service document changes that have been logged. The program creates entries in the window when, for example, the response time or service order status changed, a resource was allocated, a service order was shipped or invoiced, and so on. Each line in this window identifies the event that occurred to the service document. The line contains the information about the field that was changed, its old and new value, the date and time when the change took place, and the ID of the user who actually made the changes.

I programmet oprettes der poster i vinduet, f.eks. når svartiden eller serviceordrens status er ændret, en ressource er allokeret, en serviceordre er leveret eller faktureret osv. Hver linje i vinduet identificerer den hændelse, der er forekommet i servicedokumentet. Linjen indeholder oplysninger om det felt, der er ændret, dets gamle og nye værdi, datoen og tidspunktet for, hvornår ændringen fandt sted, og id'et for den bruger, som foretog ændringerne.

trans-unit.source: View a list of the service document changes that have been logged. The program creates entries in the window when, for example, the response time or service order status changed, a resource was allocated, a service order was shipped or invoiced, and so on. Each line in this window identifies the event that occurred to the service document. The line contains the information about the field that was changed, its old and new value, the date and time when the change took place, and the ID of the user who actually made the changes.
trans-unit.target: Få vist en liste over de ændringer i servicedokumentet, der er registreret. I programmet oprettes der poster i vinduet, f.eks. når svartiden eller serviceordrens status er ændret, en ressource er allokeret, en serviceordre er leveret eller faktureret osv. Hver linje i vinduet identificerer den hændelse, der er forekommet i servicedokumentet. Linjen indeholder oplysninger om det felt, der er ændret, dets gamle og nye værdi, datoen og tidspunktet for, hvornår ændringen fandt sted, og id'et for den bruger, som foretog ændringerne.

trans-unit.source: Remind customers about overdue amounts based on reminder terms and the related reminder levels. Each reminder level includes rules about when the reminder will be issued in relation to the invoice due date or the date of the previous reminder and whether interests are added. Reminders are integrated with finance charge memos, which are documents informing customers of interests or other money penalties for payment delays.
trans-unit.target: Påmind debitorer om forfaldne beløb ud fra rykkerbetingelserne og de relaterede rykkerniveauer. Hvert rykkerniveau omfatter regler om, hvornår rykkeren skal udstedes i forhold til fakturaens forfaldsdato eller datoen for den forrige rykker, og om der påløber renter. Rykkerne integreres i rentenotaerne, som er dokumenter, der informerer debitorerne om renter eller andre skyldige sanktioner for forsinket betaling.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Reminders - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Reminders - Property Caption)

trans-unit.target: Få vist revisionsoplysninger om alle finansposter. Hver gang en post bogføres, oprettes der en journal. Her kan du se det første og sidste tal for posterne og derved dokumentere, hvornår posterne er bogført.

trans-unit.target: Vis en liste over debitorers betalingshistorik op til en bestemt dato. Du kan bruge rapporten til at udtrække oplysninger om din samlede salgsindkomst ved slutningen af en regnskabsperiode eller et regnskabsår.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Customer - &Balance to Date - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Customer - &Balance to Date - Property Caption)

trans-unit.target: Find poster og dokumenter, der findes for dokumentnummeret og bogføringsdatoen på det valgte dokument. (Tidligere blev denne handling kaldt Naviger).

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Navi&gate - Property Caption)

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Posted Sales Shipments - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Posted Sales Shipments - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Record your agreements with customers to sell certain products on certain delivery and payment terms. Sales orders, unlike sales invoices, allow you to ship partially, deliver directly from your vendor to your customer, initiate warehouse handling, and print various customer-facing documents. Sales invoicing is integrated in the sales order process.
trans-unit.target: Registrer dine aftaler med debitorer for at sælge bestemte varer på bestemte leverings- og betalingsbetingelser. I modsætning til salgsfakturaer gør salgsordrer det muligt at levere delvist, levere direkte fra kreditoren til debitoren, starte lagerstedsekspedition og udskrive forskellige bilag til kunderne. Salgsfakturering er integreret i salgsordreprocessen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Sales Orders_Embedding - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Sales Orders_Embedding - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Create a new sales credit memo to revert a posted sales invoice.
trans-unit.target: Opret en ny salgskreditnota for at tilbageføre en bogført salgsfaktura.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Sales &Credit Memo - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Sales &Credit Memo - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Sales Credit Memos - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Register your sales to customers and invite them to pay according to the delivery and payment terms by sending them a sales invoice document. Posting a sales invoice registers shipment and records an open receivable entry on the customer's account, which will be closed when payment is received. To manage the shipment process, use sales orders, in which sales invoicing is integrated.
trans-unit.target: Registrer dit salg til debitorer, og inviter dem til at betale i henhold til leverings- og betalingsbetingelserne ved at sende dem et salgsfakturabilag. Bogføring af en salgsfaktura registrerer leveringen og registrerer en åben tilgodehavendepost på debitorens konto, som vil blive lukket, når betalingen er modtaget. Brug salgsordrer, hvor salgsfaktureringen er integreret, til at administrere leveringsprocessen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Sales Invoices_Embedding - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Sales Invoices_Embedding - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Reports - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Action111 - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action &Sales - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open the list of posted sales credit memos.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Posted Sales Credit Memos - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Posted Sales Credit Memos - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View, print, or save a summary of each customer's total payments due, divided into three time periods. The report can be used to decide when to issue reminders, to evaluate a customer's creditworthiness, or to prepare liquidity analyses.
trans-unit.target: Vis, udskriv eller gem en oversigt over hver debitors samlede forfaldne betalinger, opdelt i tre tidsperioder. Rapporten kan bruges til at bestemme, hvornår der skal udstedes rykkere, til at vurdere en debitors kreditværdighed eller til at udarbejde likviditetsanalyser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Customer - &Summary Aging Simp. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Customer - &Summary Aging Simp. - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Create sales invoices according to standard sales lines that are assigned to the customers and with posting dates within the valid-from and valid-to dates that you specify on the standard sales code. Can also be used for SEPA direct debit.
trans-unit.target: Opret salgsfakturaer i overensstemmelse med standardsalgslinjer, der er knyttet til debitorer og med bogføringsdatoer, der ligger inden for de gyldig fra- og gyldig til-datoer, du angiver på standardsalgskoden. Kan også bruges til SEPA Direct Debit.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Create Recurring Invoices - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Create Recurring Invoices - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Sales Documents - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open the cash receipt journal to post incoming payments.
trans-unit.target: Åbn indbetalingskladden for at bogføre indgående betalinger.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Cash Receipt &Journal - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Cash Receipt &Journal - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Process your customer payments by matching amounts received on your bank account with the related unpaid sales invoices, and then post the payments.
trans-unit.target: Du kan behandle debitorbetalinger ved at afstemme beløb, der er modtaget på bankkontoen, med de relaterede ubetalte salgsfakturaer og derefter bogføre betalingerne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action PaymentRegistration - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action PaymentRegistration - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Reconcile unpaid documents automatically with their related bank transactions by importing a bank statement feed or file. In the payment reconciliation journal, incoming or outgoing payments on your bank are automatically, or semi-automatically, applied to their related open customer or vendor ledger entries. Any open bank account ledger entries related to the applied customer or vendor ledger entries will be closed when you choose the Post Payments and Reconcile Bank Account action. This means that the bank account is automatically reconciled for payments that you post with the journal.
trans-unit.target: Afstem ubetalte bilag automatisk med deres relaterede banktransaktioner ved at importere et bankkontoudtog eller en fil. I betalingsudligningskladden udlignes indgående eller udgående betalinger for din bank automatisk eller delvist automatisk med deres relaterede åbne debitor- eller kreditorposter. Alle åbne bankkontoposter i forhold til de udlignede debitor- eller kreditorposter bliver lukket, når du vælger handlingen Bogfør betalinger og Afstem bankkontoen. Det betyder, at bankkontoen automatisk afstemmes for de betalinger, som du bogfører med kladden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Payment Reconciliation Journals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Payment Reconciliation Journals - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Reminder Documents - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Tasks - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View an overview of when your receivables from customers are due or overdue (divided into four periods). You must specify the date you want aging calculated from and the length of the period that each column will contain data for.
trans-unit.target: Vis en oversigt over, hvornår dine tilgodehavender fra debitorer skal betales eller rykkes for (opdelt i fire tidsperioder). Du skal angive den dato, som aldersfordelingen skal beregnes ud fra, og du skal angive den periode, som hver kolonne skal indeholde data for.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Aged &Accounts Receivable - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Aged &Accounts Receivable - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post financial transactions directly to general ledger accounts and other accounts, such as bank, customer, vendor, and employee accounts. Posting with a general journal always creates entries on general ledger accounts. This is true even when, for example, you post a journal line to a customer account, because an entry is posted to a general ledger receivables account through a posting group.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør økonomiske transaktioner direkte til finanskonti og andre konti, f.eks. bank-, debitor-, kreditor- og medarbejderkonti. Bogføring med en finanskladde opretter altid poster på finanskontiene. Dette gælder også, når du eksempelvis bogfører en kladdelinje til en debitorkonto, fordi der er bogført en post til finansregnskabets konto for tilgodehavender via en bogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action General Journals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action General Journals - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Posted Documents - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open the list of posted sales invoices.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Posted Sales Invoices - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Posted Sales Invoices - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Compensate your customers for incorrect or damaged items that you sent to them and received payment for. Sales return orders enable you to receive items from multiple sales documents with one sales return, automatically create related sales credit memos or other return-related documents, such as a replacement sales order, and support warehouse documents for the item handling. Note: If an erroneous sale has not been paid yet, you can simply cancel the posted sales invoice to automatically revert the financial transaction.
trans-unit.target: Kompenser dine kunder for forkerte eller beskadigede varer, som du har sendt til dem og modtaget betaling for. Salgsreturvareordrer gør det muligt at modtage varer fra flere salgsbilag med samme salgsreturnering, automatisk oprette de relaterede salgskreditnotaer eller andre returneringsbilag, f.eks. en erstatningssalgsordre, og understøtte bilag for lagerekspeditionen. Bemærk: Hvis et fejlbehæftet salg endnu ikke er betalt, kan du blot annullere den bogførte salgsfaktura for automatisk at tilbageføre den økonomiske transaktion.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Sales Return Orders - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Sales Return Orders - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Customers - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Customers - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Instruct your bank to withdraw payment amounts from your customer's bank account and transfer them to your company's account. A direct debit collection holds information about the customer's bank account, the affected sales invoices, and the customer's agreement, the so-called direct-debit mandate. From the resulting direct-debit collection entry, you can then export an XML file that you send or upload to your bank for processing.
trans-unit.target: Bed din bank om at trække betalingsbeløb fra debitorens bankkonto og overføre dem til din virksomheds konto. En Direct Debit-opkrævning indeholder oplysninger om debitorens bankkonto, de berørte salgsfakturaer og debitorens aftale, dvs. den såkaldte Direct Debit-betalingsaftale. Ud fra den resulterede Direct Debit-opkrævningspost kan du derefter eksportere en XML-fil, som du kan sende eller overføre til din bank til behandling.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Direct Debit Collections - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Direct Debit Collections - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the beginning and ending balance for customers with entries within a specified period. The report can be used to verify that the balance for a customer posting group is equal to the balance on the corresponding general ledger account on a certain date.
trans-unit.target: Vis start- og slutsaldi for debitorer med poster i en bestemt periode. Rapporten kan bruges til at bekræfte, at saldoen for en debitorbogføringsgruppe svarer til saldoen på den tilsvarende finanskonto på en bestemt dato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Customer - Trial Balan&ce - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Customer - Trial Balan&ce - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View if a certain general ledger account reconciles the balance on a certain date for the corresponding posting group. The report shows the accounts that are included in the reconciliation with the general ledger balance and the customer or the vendor ledger balance for each account and shows any differences between the general ledger balance and the customer or vendor ledger balance.
trans-unit.target: Vis, om en bestemt finanskonto afstemmer balancen på en bestemt dato for den tilsvarende bogføringsgruppe. Rapporten viser de konti, der medtages i afstemningen af finansbalancen og debitor- eller kreditorbalancen for hver konto, samt eventuelle forskelle mellem finansbalancen og debitor- eller kreditorbalancen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Reconcile Customer and &Vendor Accounts - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Account Receivables - Action Reconcile Customer and &Vendor Accounts - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list of the service document changes that have been logged. The program creates entries in the window when, for example, the response time or service order status changed, a resource was allocated, a service order was shipped or invoiced, and so on. Each line in this window identifies the event that occurred to the service document. The line contains the information about the field that was changed, its old and new value, the date and time when the change took place, and the ID of the user who actually made the changes.
trans-unit.target: Få vist en liste over de ændringer i servicedokumentet, der er registreret. I programmet oprettes der poster i vinduet, f.eks. når svartiden eller serviceordrens status er ændret, en ressource er allokeret, en serviceordre er leveret eller faktureret osv. Hver linje i vinduet identificerer den hændelse, der er forekommet i servicedokumentet. Linjen indeholder oplysninger om det felt, der er ændret, dets gamle og nye værdi, datoen og tidspunktet for, hvornår ændringen fandt sted, og id'et for den bruger, som foretog ændringerne.

trans-unit.source: Register your sales to customers and invite them to pay according to the delivery and payment terms by sending them a sales invoice document. Posting a sales invoice registers shipment and records an open receivable entry on the customer's account, which will be closed when payment is received. To manage the shipment process, use sales orders, in which sales invoicing is integrated.
trans-unit.target: Registrer dit salg til debitorer, og inviter dem til at betale i henhold til leverings- og betalingsbetingelserne ved at sende dem et salgsfakturabilag. Bogføring af en salgsfaktura registrerer leveringen og registrerer en åben tilgodehavendepost på debitorens konto, som vil blive lukket, når betalingen er modtaget. Brug salgsordrer, hvor salgsfaktureringen er integreret, til at administrere leveringsprocessen.

trans-unit.source: View, print, or send a report that shows balance sheet movements for selected periods. The report shows the closing balance by the end of the previous fiscal year for the selected ledger accounts. It also shows the fiscal year until this date, the fiscal year by the end of the selected period, and the balance by the end of the selected period, excluding the closing entries. The report can be used at the close of an accounting period or fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Vis, udskriv, eller send en rapport, der viser bevægelser på balancen for udvalgte perioder. Rapporten viser slutsaldoen ved afslutningen af det foregående regnskabsår for de valgte konti. Den viser også regnskabsåret til dato, dette regnskabsår ved afslutningen af den valgte periode og saldoen ved afslutningen af den valgte periode med undtagelse af ultimoposterne. Rapporten kan bruges ved afslutningen af en regnskabsperiode eller ved årsafslutningen.

trans-unit.source: Analyze the dynamics of your sales according to key sales performance indicators that you select, for example, sales turnover in both amounts and quantities, contribution margin, or progress of actual sales against the budget. You can also use the report to analyze your average sales prices and evaluate the sales performance of your sales force.
trans-unit.target: Analyser udviklingen i dit salg i henhold til nøglesalgsindikatorer, som du vælger, f.eks. salgsomsætningen i både beløb og antal, dækningsbidrag eller det aktuelle salgs forløb i forhold til budgettet. Du kan også anvende rapporten til at analysere dine gennemsnitlige salgspriser og evaluere din salgsstyrkes præstationer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Sales Analysis Report - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Sales Analysis Report - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View, print, or send a report that shows this year's and last year's figures as an ordinary trial balance. The closing of the income statement accounts is posted at the end of a fiscal year. The report can be used in connection with closing a fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Vis, udskriv, eller send en rapport, der viser dette og sidste års tal som en almindelig råbalance. Nulstilling af resultatopgørelseskonti bogføres ultimo i regnskabsåret. Rapporten kan bruges i forbindelse med årsafslutning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action &Closing Trial Balance - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action &Closing Trial Balance - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View customers' total costs, sales, and profits over time, for example, to analyze earnings trends. The report shows amounts for original and adjusted costs, sales, profits, invoice discounts, payment discounts, and profit percentage in three adjustable periods.
trans-unit.target: Vis debitorers samlede omkostninger, salg eller avance over tid, f.eks. med henblik på at analysere indtjeningstendenser. Rapporten viser beløb for den oprindelige og regulerede kostpris, omsætning, avance, fakturarabat, kontantrabat og avanceprocent i tre regulerbare perioder.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Sales &Statistics - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Sales &Statistics - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit detailed information for the customers that you trade with. From each customer card, you can open related information, such as sales statistics and ongoing orders, and you can define special prices and line discounts that you grant if certain conditions are met.
trans-unit.target: Få vist eller rediger detaljerede oplysninger om de debitorer, som du handler med. Fra det enkelte debitorkort kan du få adgang til relaterede oplysninger, som f.eks. salgsstatistik og igangværende ordrer, og du kan definere specialpriser og linjerabatter, som debitoren får, når bestemte betingelser er opfyldt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Customers - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Customers - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit estimated amounts for a range of accounting periods.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger anslåede beløb for et interval af regnskabsperioder.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Budgets - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Budgets - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Get insight into the financial data stored in your chart of accounts. Financial reports analyze figures in G/L accounts, and compare general ledger entries with general ledger budget entries. For example, you can view the general ledger entries as percentages of the budget entries. Financial reports provide the data for core financial statements and views, such as the Cash Flow chart.
trans-unit.target: Få indsigt i de finansielle data, som er gemt i din kontoplan. Finansielle rapporter analyserer tal i finanskonti og sammenligner finansposter med finansbudgetposter. Du kan f.eks. få vist finansposterne som en procentsats af budgetposterne. Finansielle rapport indeholder data om de vigtigste årsregnskaber og visninger, f.eks. pengestrømsdiagrammet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Account Schedules - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Account Schedules - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Action11 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View amounts in G/L accounts by their dimension values and other filters that you define in an analysis view and then show in a matrix window.
trans-unit.target: Vis beløb i finanskonti efter deres dimensionsværdier og andre filtre, som du definerer i en analysevisning og derefter viser i et matrixvindue.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Analysis by Dimensions - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Analysis by Dimensions - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View which customers purchase the most or owe the most in a selected period. Only customers that have either purchases during the period or a balance at the end of the period will be included.
trans-unit.target: Vis de debitorer, der køber mest, eller som skylder mest, i en bestemt periode. Kun de debitorer, der har køb i løbet af perioden eller en saldo ved periodens afslutning, vil blive vist i rapporten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Customer - T&op 10 List - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Customer - T&op 10 List - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View customer sales for a period, for example, to report sales activity to customs and tax authorities. You can choose to include only customers with total sales that exceed a minimum amount. You can also specify whether you want the report to show address details for each customer.
trans-unit.target: Vis debitorsalg for en given periode, f.eks. for at rapportere om salgsaktivitet til SKAT. Du kan vælge kun at medtage debitorer med et samlet salg, der overstiger et bestemt beløb. Du kan også angive, om rapporten skal vise adresseoplysningerne for hver enkelt debitor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Customer - S&ales List - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Customer - S&ales List - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Record your agreements with customers to sell certain products on certain delivery and payment terms. Sales orders, unlike sales invoices, allow you to ship partially, deliver directly from your vendor to your customer, initiate warehouse handling, and print various customer-facing documents. Sales invoicing is integrated in the sales order process.
trans-unit.target: Registrer dine aftaler med debitorer for at sælge bestemte varer på bestemte leverings- og betalingsbetingelser. I modsætning til salgsfakturaer gør salgsordrer det muligt at levere delvist, levere direkte fra kreditoren til debitoren, starte lagerstedsekspedition og udskrive forskellige bilag til kunderne. Salgsfakturering er integreret i salgsordreprocessen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Sales Orders - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Sales Orders - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list of all your contacts.
trans-unit.target: Vis en liste med alle dine kontakter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Contacts - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Contacts - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Make offers to customers to sell certain products on certain delivery and payment terms. While you negotiate with a customer, you can change and resend the sales quote as much as needed. When the customer accepts the offer, you convert the sales quote to a sales invoice or a sales order in which you process the sale.
trans-unit.target: Giv tilbud til debitorer for at sælge bestemte varer på bestemte leverings- og betalingsbetingelser. Når du forhandler med en debitor, kan du ændre og sende salgstilbud, så mange gange du har brug for. Når debitoren accepterer tilbuddet, skal du konvertere salgstilbuddet til en salgsfaktura eller en salgsordre, som du bruger til at behandle salget.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Sales Quotes - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Sales Quotes - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Recei&vables-Payables - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page CEO and President Role Center - Action Recei&vables-Payables - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Set up the key that web services use to access your data, and then specify the key on the user card for the relevant user accounts.
trans-unit.target: Konfigurer den nøgle, som webtjenester bruger til at få adgang til dine data, og angiv derefter nøglen på brugerkortet til de relevante brugerkonti.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Card - Action ChangeWebServiceAccessKey - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Card - Action ChangeWebServiceAccessKey - Property Caption)

trans-unit.target: Skift brugerens adgangskode, hvis brugeren opretter forbindelse via godkendelse med adgangskode.

(Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Card - Action ChangePassword - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Set up Access Control Service authentication, such as generating an authentication key that the user can use to connect to Azure.
trans-unit.target: Konfigurer godkendelse af Access Control Service såsom generering af godkendelsesnøgle, som brugeren kan bruge til at oprette forbindelse til Azure.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Card - Action AcsSetup - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Card - Action AcsSetup - Property Caption)

trans-unit.target: Hvis du rydder feltet Adgangsnøgle til webtjeneste på siden Brugerkort, kan du sikre, at der ikke kan bruges adgangsnøgler til godkendelse fra en anden service.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Card - Action RemoveWSAccessKey - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Card - Action RemoveWSAccessKey - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Create purchase orders to mirror sales documents that vendors send to you. This enables you to record the cost of purchases and to track accounts payable. Posting purchase orders dynamically updates inventory levels so that you can minimize inventory costs and provide better customer service. Purchase orders allow partial receipts, unlike with purchase invoices, and enable drop shipment directly from your vendor to your customer. Purchase orders can be created automatically from PDF or image files from your vendors by using the Incoming Documents feature.
trans-unit.target: Opret købsordrer for at afspejle de salgsbilag, som leverandører sender til dig. På denne måde kan du registrere købsomkostninger og spore kreditorer. Bogføringen af købsordrer opdaterer lagerniveauerne dynamisk, så du kan minimere lageromkostningerne og levere bedre kundeservice. Købsordrer tillader delleverancer, modsat købsfakturaer, og muliggør direkte levering fra kreditoren til debitoren. Købsordrer kan oprettes automatisk ud fra PDF- eller billedfiler fra dine kreditorer ved hjælp af funktionen Indgående bilag.

trans-unit.source: View a list of the service document changes that have been logged. The program creates entries in the window when, for example, the response time or service order status changed, a resource was allocated, a service order was shipped or invoiced, and so on. Each line in this window identifies the event that occurred to the service document. The line contains the information about the field that was changed, its old and new value, the date and time when the change took place, and the ID of the user who actually made the changes.
trans-unit.target: Få vist en liste over de ændringer i servicedokumentet, der er registreret. I programmet oprettes der poster i vinduet, f.eks. når svartiden eller serviceordrens status er ændret, en ressource er allokeret, en serviceordre er leveret eller faktureret osv. Hver linje i vinduet identificerer den hændelse, der er forekommet i servicedokumentet. Linjen indeholder oplysninger om det felt, der er ændret, dets gamle og nye værdi, datoen og tidspunktet for, hvornår ændringen fandt sted, og id'et for den bruger, som foretog ændringerne.

trans-unit.source: View or edit detailed information for the products that you trade in. Her angiver du også, om varerne på lager eller i indgående ordrer automatisk reserveres til udgående bilag, og om der er oprettet ordresporingsbindinger mellem behov og forsyning for at afspejle planlægningshandlinger.

trans-unit.source: View a list of invoices for each salesperson for a selected period. The following information is shown for each invoice: Customer number, sales amount, profit amount, and the commission on sales amount and profit amount. The report also shows the adjusted profit and the adjusted profit commission, which are the profit figures that reflect any changes to the original costs of the goods sold.

Der vises følgende oplysninger om hver faktura: debitornummer, salgsbeløb, avancebeløb og provisionen på salgsbeløbet og avancebeløbet. Desuden vises reguleret avance og reguleret avanceprovision, som er de avancetal, der afspejler evt. ændringer i de oprindelige beløb for de solgte varer. Rapporten kan f.eks. bruges til beregning og dokumentation af sælgerprovision.

trans-unit.source: Register your sales to customers and invite them to pay according to the delivery and payment terms by sending them a sales invoice document. Posting a sales invoice registers shipment and records an open receivable entry on the customer's account, which will be closed when payment is received. To manage the shipment process, use sales orders, in which sales invoicing is integrated.

Bogføring af en salgsfaktura registrerer leveringen og registrerer en åben tilgodehavendepost på debitorens konto, som vil blive lukket, når betalingen er modtaget. Brug salgsordrer, hvor salgsfaktureringen er integreret, til at administrere leveringsprocessen.

trans-unit.source: Revert the financial transactions involved when your customers want to cancel a purchase or return incorrect or damaged items that you sent to them and received payment for. To include the correct information, you can create the sales credit memo from the related posted sales invoice or you can create a new sales credit memo with copied invoice information. If you need more control of the sales return process, such as warehouse documents for the physical handling, use sales return orders, in which sales credit memos are integrated. Note: If an erroneous sale has not been paid yet, you can simply cancel the posted sales invoice to automatically revert the financial transaction.
trans-unit.target: Tilbagefør økonomiske transaktioner, når debitorerne vil annullere et køb eller returnere forkerte eller beskadigede varer, som du har sendt til dem og modtaget betaling for. For at få de rette oplysninger med, kan du oprette salgskreditnotaen ud fra den relaterede bogførte salgsfaktura, eller du kan oprette en ny salgskreditnota, hvor du indsætter en kopi af fakturaoplysninger. Hvis du har brug for mere kontrol over processen for salgsreturvarer som f.eks. bilag for den fysiske lagerekspedition, skal du bruge salgsreturvareordrer, hvor salgskreditnotaer er integreret. Bemærk: Hvis et fejlbehæftet salg endnu ikke er blevet betalt, kan du blot annullere den bogførte salgsfaktura for automatisk at tilbageføre den økonomiske transaktion.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Sales & Relationship Mgr. RC - Action Sales Credit Memos - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Sales & Relationship Mgr. RC - Action Sales Credit Memos - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit the codes for item charges that you can assign to purchase and sales transactions to include any added costs, such as freight, physical handling, and insurance that you incur when purchasing or selling items. This is important to ensure correct inventory valuation. For purchases, the landed cost of a purchased item consists of the vendor's purchase price and all additional direct item charges that can be assigned to individual receipts or return shipments. For sales, knowing the cost of shipping sold items can be as vital to your company as knowing the landed cost of purchased items.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger de koder for varegebyrer, som du kan tildele til købs- og salgstransaktioner, så de omfatter alle tilføjede omkostninger, såsom fragt, fysisk håndtering og forsikring, som du har ved køb eller salg af varer. Dette er vigtigt for at sikre korrekt lagerværdi. For køb gælder det, at hjemtagelsesprisen for en købt vare består af kreditorens købspris og alle ekstra direkte varegebyrer, der kan tildeles til individuelle leverancer eller returvareleverancer. For salg gælder det, at det at kende omkostningerne ved levering af solgte varer kan være ligeså afgørende for din virksomhed som det at kende omkostningen for købte varer.

Sales return orders enable you to receive items from multiple sales documents with one sales return, automatically create related sales credit memos or other return-related documents, such as a replacement sales order, and support warehouse documents for the item handling. Note: If an erroneous sale has not been paid yet, you can simply cancel the posted sales invoice to automatically revert the financial transaction.

trans-unit.source: View or edit sales line discounts that you grant when certain conditions are met, such as customer, quantity, or ending date. The discount agreements can be for individual customers, for a group of customers, for all customers or for a campaign.
trans-unit.target: Få vist eller rediger de salgslinjerabatter, som du giver, når bestemte betingelser er opfyldt, f.eks. debitor, mængde eller slutdato. Rabataftalerne kan gælde for individuelle debitorer, for debitorgrupper, for alle debitorer eller for en kampagne.

(Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Sales & Relationship Mgr. RC - Action Sales Line &Discounts - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Compensate your customers for incorrect or damaged items that you sent to them and received payment for. Sales return orders enable you to receive items from multiple sales documents with one sales return, automatically create related sales credit memos or other return-related documents, such as a replacement sales order, and support warehouse documents for the item handling. Note: If an erroneous sale has not been paid yet, you can simply cancel the posted sales invoice to automatically revert the financial transaction.
trans-unit.target: Kompenser dine kunder for forkerte eller beskadigede varer, som du har sendt til dem og modtaget betaling for. Salgsreturvareordrer gør det muligt at modtage varer fra flere salgsbilag med samme salgsreturnering, automatisk oprette de relaterede salgskreditnotaer eller andre returneringsbilag, f.eks. en erstatningssalgsordre, og understøtte bilag for lagerekspeditionen. Bemærk: Hvis et fejlbehæftet salg endnu ikke er betalt, kan du blot annullere den bogførte salgsfaktura for automatisk at tilbageføre den økonomiske transaktion.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Sales & Relationship Mgr. RC - Action Sales &Return Order - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Sales & Relationship Mgr. RC - Action Sales &Return Order - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Use blanket sales orders as a framework for a long-term agreement between you and your customers to sell large quantities that are to be delivered in several smaller shipments over a certain period of time. Blanket orders often cover only one item with predetermined delivery dates. The main reason for using a blanket order rather than a sales order is that quantities entered on a blanket order do not affect item availability and thus can be used as a worksheet for monitoring, forecasting, and planning purposes..
trans-unit.target: Brug rammesalgsordrer som en ramme for en langsigtet aftale mellem dig og dine debitorer for at sælge et stort antal varer, der skal leveres i flere mindre portioner i løbet af en bestemt periode. En rammeordre omfatter ofte kun en enkelt vare med leveringsdatoer, der er fastsat på forhånd. Den væsentligste årsag til at bruge en rammeordre i stedet for en salgsordre er, at de antal, der angives i en rammeordre, ikke påvirker varedisponeringen, og at oplysningerne dermed kan bruges til overvågnings-, prognose- og planlægningsformål.

trans-unit.source: Record your agreements with customers to sell certain products on certain delivery and payment terms. Sales invoicing is integrated in the sales order process.

trans-unit.source: Register payments to vendors. A payment journal is a type of general journal that is used to post outgoing payment transactions to G/L, bank, customer, vendor, employee, and fixed assets accounts. The Suggest Vendor Payments functions automatically fills the journal with payments that are due. When payments are posted, you can export the payments to a bank file for upload to your bank if your system is set up for electronic banking. You can also issue computer checks from the payment journal.
trans-unit.target: Registrer betalinger til kreditorer. En betalingskladde er en finanskladde, der bruges til at bogføre udgående betalingstransaktioner til finansregnskab, bank, debitor, kreditor, medarbejder og anlægskonti. Funktionerne for Lav kreditorbetalingsforslag udfylder automatisk kladden med de forfaldne betalinger. Når betalingerne er bogført, kan du eksportere betalingerne til en bankfil med henblik på overførsel til din bank, såfremt systemet er konfigureret til elektronisk betaling. Du kan også sende computercheck fra betalingskladden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Team Member Role Center - Action PaymentJournals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Team Member Role Center - Action PaymentJournals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Personalize the structure of your financial statements by mapping general ledger accounts to account categories. You can create category groups by indenting subcategories under them. Each grouping shows a total balance. When you choose the Generate Financial Reports action, the row definitions for the underlying financial reports are updated. The next time you run one of these reports, such as the balance statement, new totals and subentries are added, based on your changes.
trans-unit.target: Tilpas strukturen for dit årsregnskab ved at knytte finanskontiene til kontokategorier. Du kan oprette kategorigrupper ved at placere underkategorier under dem. Hver gruppe viser en totalsaldo. Når du vælger handlingen Generér finansrapporter, opdateres rækkedefinitionerne for de underliggende finansrapporter. Næste gang du kører en af disse rapporter som f.eks. resultatopgørelsen, tilføjes der nye totaler og underposter ud fra dine ændringer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Team Member Role Center - Action G/L Account Categories - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Team Member Role Center - Action G/L Account Categories - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Use blanket purchase orders as a framework for a long-term agreement between you and your vendors to buy large quantities that are to be delivered in several smaller shipments over a certain period of time. Blanket orders often cover only one item with predetermined delivery dates. The main reason for using a blanket order rather than a purchase order is that quantities entered on a blanket order do not affect item availability and thus can be used as a worksheet for monitoring, forecasting, and planning purposes.
trans-unit.target: Brug rammekøbsordrer som en ramme for en langsigtet aftale mellem dig og dine kreditorer for at købe et stort antal varer, der skal leveres i flere mindre portioner i løbet af en bestemt periode. En rammeordre omfatter ofte kun en enkelt vare med leveringsdatoer, der er fastsat på forhånd. Den væsentligste årsag til at bruge en rammeordre i stedet for en købsordre er, at de antal, der angives i en rammeordre, ikke påvirker varedisponeringen, og at oplysningerne dermed kan bruges til overvågnings-, prognose- og planlægningsformål.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Team Member Role Center - Action Blanket Purchase Orders - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Team Member Role Center - Action Blanket Purchase Orders - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Remind customers about overdue amounts based on reminder terms and the related reminder levels. Each reminder level includes rules about when the reminder will be issued in relation to the invoice due date or the date of the previous reminder and whether interests are added. Reminders are integrated with finance charge memos, which are documents informing customers of interests or other money penalties for payment delays.

Hvert rykkerniveau omfatter regler om, hvornår rykkeren skal udstedes i forhold til fakturaens forfaldsdato eller datoen for den forrige rykker, og om der påløber renter. Rykkerne integreres i rentenotaerne, som er dokumenter, der informerer debitorerne om renter eller andre skyldige sanktioner for forsinket betaling.
