(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Adjust E&xchange Rates - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a statement of posted VAT amounts, calculate your VAT settlement amount for a certain period, such as a quarter, and prepare to send the settlement to the tax authorities.
trans-unit.target: Få vist en opgørelse over de bogførte momsbeløb, beregn dine momsafregningsbeløb for en bestemt periode som f.eks. et kvartal, og forbered indsendelse af momsangivelsen til myndighederne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action VAT Statements - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action VAT Statements - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View if a certain general ledger account reconciles the balance on a certain date for the corresponding posting group. The report shows the accounts that are included in the reconciliation with the general ledger balance and the customer or the vendor ledger balance for each account and shows any differences between the general ledger balance and the customer or vendor ledger balance.
trans-unit.target: Vis, om en bestemt finanskonto afstemmer balancen på en bestemt dato for den tilsvarende bogføringsgruppe. Rapporten viser de konti, der medtages i afstemningen af finansbalancen og debitor- eller kreditorbalancen for hver konto, samt eventuelle forskelle mellem finansbalancen og debitor- eller kreditorbalancen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Reconcile Cus&t. and Vend. Accs - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Reconcile Cus&t. and Vend. Accs - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Show the opening balance by general ledger account, the movements in the selected period of month, quarter, or year, and the resulting closing balance.
trans-unit.target: Viser primosaldoen efter finanskonto, bevægelserne i den valgte periode for måned, kvartal eller år, og den resulterende ultimosaldo.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Trial Balance by &Period - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Trial Balance by &Period - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Register received payments by manually applying them to the related customer, vendor, or bank ledger entries. Then, post the payments to G/L accounts and thereby close the related ledger entries.
trans-unit.target: Registrer modtagne betalinger ved at udligne dem manuelt for de relaterede debitor-, kreditor- eller bankposter. Bogfør derefter betalingerne til finanskontiene, så du kan lukke de relaterede poster.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action CashReceiptJournals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action CashReceiptJournals - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Action53 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View, print, or send a report that shows balance sheet movements for selected periods. The report shows the closing balance by the end of the previous fiscal year for the selected ledger accounts. It also shows the fiscal year until this date, the fiscal year by the end of the selected period, and the balance by the end of the selected period, excluding the closing entries. The report can be used at the close of an accounting period or fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Vis, udskriv, eller send en rapport, der viser bevægelser på balancen for udvalgte perioder. Rapporten viser slutsaldoen ved afslutningen af det foregående regnskabsår for de valgte konti. Den viser også regnskabsåret til dato, dette regnskabsår ved afslutningen af den valgte periode og saldoen ved afslutningen af den valgte periode med undtagelse af ultimoposterne. Rapporten kan bruges ved afslutningen af en regnskabsperiode eller ved årsafslutningen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &Fiscal Year Balance - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &Fiscal Year Balance - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post fixed asset transactions, such as acquisition and depreciation book without integration to the general ledger.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør transaktioner for faste anlægsaktiver, f.eks. anskaffelse og afskrivningsprofil, uden integration til finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Fixed Assets Journals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Fixed Assets Journals - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action G/L Registers - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action G/L Registers - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Handle incoming documents, such as vendor invoices in PDF or as image files, that you can manually or automatically convert to document records, such as purchase invoices. The external files that represent incoming documents can be attached at any process stage, including to posted documents and to the resulting vendor, customer, and general ledger entries.
trans-unit.target: Håndter indgående bilag, f.eks. kreditorfakturaer i PDF- eller billedfiler, som kan bruges til manuel eller automatisk konvertering til bilagsrecords, f.eks. købsfakturaer. De eksterne filer, der repræsenterer indgående bilag, kan knyttes til ethvert procestrin, herunder bogførte bilag og de resulterende kreditor-, debitor- og finansposter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Incoming Documents - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Incoming Documents - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Find entries and documents that exist for the document number and posting date on the selected document. (Formerly this action was named Navigate.)
trans-unit.target: Find poster og dokumenter, der findes for dokumentnummeret og bogføringsdatoen på det valgte dokument. (Tidligere blev denne handling kaldt Naviger).
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Navi&gate - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Navi&gate - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Create a new sales credit memo to revert a posted sales invoice.
trans-unit.target: Opret en ny salgskreditnota for at tilbageføre en bogført salgsfaktura.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Sales &Credit Memo - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Sales &Credit Memo - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post fixed asset transactions, such as acquisition and depreciation, in integration with the general ledger. The FA G/L Journal is a general journal, which is integrated into the general ledger.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør transaktioner for faste anlægsaktiver, f.eks. anskaffelse og afskrivning, med integration til finans. Anlægsfinanskladden er en generel kladde, der er integreret med finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Fixed Assets G/L Journals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Fixed Assets G/L Journals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the list of issued finance charge memos.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Issued Fin. Charge Memos - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Issued Fin. Charge Memos - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cost Accounting - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Use an EU VAT number validation service to validated the VAT number of a business partner.
trans-unit.target: Brug en tjeneste til validering af EU-momsnumre til at validere en forretningspartners momsnummer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &VAT Registration No. Check - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &VAT Registration No. Check - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Close open VAT entries and transfers purchase and sales VAT amounts to the VAT settlement account. For every VAT posting group, the batch job finds all the VAT entries in the VAT Entry table that are included in the filters in the definition window.
trans-unit.target: Luk åbne momsposter og overfører købs- og salgsmomsbeløb til momsafregningskontoen. For hver momsbogføringsgruppe finder kørslen alle momsposter i den momsposttabel, der er inkluderet i filtrene i definitionsvinduet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Calc. and Pos&t VAT Settlement - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Calc. and Pos&t VAT Settlement - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit dimensions, such as area, project, or department, that you can assign to sales and purchase documents to distribute costs and analyze transaction history.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger dimensioner, f.eks. område, projekt eller afdeling, som du kan tildele til salgs- og købsbilag for at fordele omkostninger og analysere transaktionshistorik.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Dimensions - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Dimensions - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the credit and debit balances per cost type, together with the chart of cost types.
trans-unit.target: Vis kredit- og debetsaldi pr. omkostningstype sammen med diagrammet over omkostningstyper.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cost Accounting P/L Statement - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cost Accounting P/L Statement - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Record manual expenses, such as salaries, interest on credit, or planned investments to be used in cash flow forecasting.
trans-unit.target: Registrer manuelle udgifter, f.eks. lønninger, renter på kredit eller planlagte investeringer, der skal bruges i pengestrømsprognoser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cash Flow Manual Expenses - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cash Flow Manual Expenses - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View, print, or send a report that shows the balances for the general ledger accounts, including the debits and credits. You can use this report to ensure accurate accounting practices.
trans-unit.target: Vis, udskriv, eller send en rapport, der viser saldo for finanskontiene, herunder debet og kredit. Du kan bruge denne rapport til at sikre nøjagtig regnskabspraksis.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &G/L Trial Balance - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &G/L Trial Balance - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Manage cost centers, which are departments and profit centers that are responsible for costs and income. Often, there are more cost centers set up in cost accounting than in any dimension that is set up in the general ledger. In the general ledger, usually only the first level cost centers for direct costs and the initial costs are used. In cost accounting, additional cost centers are created for additional allocation levels.
trans-unit.target: Administrer omkostningssteder, som er afdelinger og overskudscentre, der er ansvarlige for omkostninger og indtægter. Der findes ofte flere omkostningssteder i et omkostningsregnskab end i en dimension, der er oprettet i finansregnskabet. I finansregnskabet anvendes normalt kun omkostningssteder på første niveau for direkte omkostninger, og de oprindelige omkostninger anvendes. I et omkostningsregnskab oprettes ekstra omkostningssteder for yderligere fordelingsniveauer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cost Centers - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cost Centers - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post intercompany transactions. IC general journal lines must contain either an IC partner account or a customer or vendor account that has been assigned an intercompany partner code.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør koncerninterne transaktioner. Koncerninterne finanskladdelinjer skal indeholde en koncernintern partnerkonto eller en debitor- eller kreditorkonto, der er tildelt en koncernintern partnerkode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action ICGeneralJournals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action ICGeneralJournals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Import entries from the business units that will be included in a consolidation. You can use the batch job if the business unit comes from the same database in Business Central as the consolidated company.
trans-unit.target: Importér poster fra de koncernvirksomheder, der skal indgå i en konsolidering. Du kan anvende kørslen, hvis koncernvirksomheden stammer fra den samme database i Business Central som det konsoliderede regnskab.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Import Co&nsolidation from Database - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Import Co&nsolidation from Database - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View information to the customs and tax authorities for sales to other EU countries/regions. If the information must be printed to a file, you can use the VAT- VIES Declaration Disk report.
trans-unit.target: Vis oplysninger til told- og skattemyndighederne ved salg til andre EU-lande/områder. Hvis oplysningerne skal skrives til en fil, kan du bruge rapporten Moms - listeangivelse disk.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action VAT - VIES Declaration Tax Aut&h - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action VAT - VIES Declaration Tax Aut&h - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open the list of posted sales credit memos.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Posted Sales Credit Memos - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Posted Sales Credit Memos - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Set up posting groups, so that payments in and out of each bank account are posted to the specified general ledger account.
trans-unit.target: Opret bogføringsgrupper, så betalinger til og fra de enkelte bankkonti bogføres på den angivne finanskonto.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Bank Account Posting Groups - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Bank Account Posting Groups - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Define your general policies for sales invoicing and returns, such as when to show credit and stockout warnings and how to post sales discounts. Set up your number series for creating customers and different sales documents.
trans-unit.target: Definer dine generelle politikker for fakturering af salg og for returneringer, som f.eks. hvornår krediterings- og beholdningsadvarsler skal vises, og hvordan salgsrabatter skal bogføres. Konfigurer dine nummerserier for oprettelse af debitorer og forskellige salgsbilag.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &Sales && Receivables Setup - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &Sales && Receivables Setup - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Manage allocation rules to allocate costs and revenues between cost types, cost centers, and cost objects. Each allocation consists of an allocation source and one or more allocation targets. For example, all costs for the cost type Electricity and Heating are an allocation source. You want to allocate the costs to the cost centers Workshop, Production, and Sales, which are three allocation targets.
trans-unit.target: Administrer fordelingsregler for at fordele omkostninger og indtægter mellem omkostningstyper, omkostningssteder og omkostningsemner. Hver fordeling består af en fordelingskilde og et eller flere fordelingsmål. Eksempelvis er alle omkostninger for omkostningstypen El og varme en fordelingskilde. Det er en god idé at fordele omkostningerne til omkostningsstederne Workshop, Produktion og Salg, som er tre fordelingsmål.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cost Allocations - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cost Allocations - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit estimated amounts for a range of accounting periods.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger anslåede beløb for et interval af regnskabsperioder.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Bu&dget - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Bu&dget - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Record manual revenues, such as rental income, interest from financial assets, or new private capital to be used in cash flow forecasting.
trans-unit.target: Registrer manuelle indtægter, f.eks. lejeindtægter, renter fra finansielle anlæg eller ny privat kapital, der skal bruges i pengestrømsprognoser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cash Flow Manual Revenues - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cash Flow Manual Revenues - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Action115 - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Action49 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Create purchase orders to mirror sales documents that vendors send to you. This enables you to record the cost of purchases and to track accounts payable. Posting purchase orders dynamically updates inventory levels so that you can minimize inventory costs and provide better customer service. Purchase orders allow partial receipts, unlike with purchase invoices, and enable drop shipment directly from your vendor to your customer. Purchase orders can be created automatically from PDF or image files from your vendors by using the Incoming Documents feature.
trans-unit.target: Opret købsordrer for at afspejle de salgsbilag, som leverandører sender til dig. På denne måde kan du registrere købsomkostninger og spore kreditorer. Bogføringen af købsordrer opdaterer lagerniveauerne dynamisk, så du kan minimere lageromkostningerne og levere bedre kundeservice. Købsordrer tillader delleverancer, modsat købsfakturaer, og muliggør direkte levering fra kreditoren til debitoren. Købsordrer kan oprettes automatisk ud fra PDF- eller billedfiler fra dine kreditorer ved hjælp af funktionen Indgående bilag.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Purchase Orders - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Purchase Orders - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Pa&yment Journal - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Pa&yment Journal - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Reconcile unpaid documents automatically with their related bank transactions by importing a bank statement feed or file. In the payment reconciliation journal, incoming or outgoing payments on your bank are automatically, or semi-automatically, applied to their related open customer or vendor ledger entries. Any open bank account ledger entries related to the applied customer or vendor ledger entries will be closed when you choose the Post Payments and Reconcile Bank Account action. This means that the bank account is automatically reconciled for payments that you post with the journal.
trans-unit.target: Afstem ubetalte bilag automatisk med deres relaterede banktransaktioner ved at importere et bankkontoudtog eller en fil. I betalingsudligningskladden udlignes indgående eller udgående betalinger for din bank automatisk eller delvist automatisk med deres relaterede åbne debitor- eller kreditorposter. Alle åbne bankkontoposter i forhold til de udlignede debitor- eller kreditorposter bliver lukket, når du vælger handlingen Bogfør betalinger og Afstem bankkontoen. Det betyder, at bankkontoen automatisk afstemmes for de betalinger, som du bogfører med kladden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Payment Reconciliation Journals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Payment Reconciliation Journals - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Tasks - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Report your sales to other EU countries or regions to the customs and tax authorities. If the information must be printed out on a printer, you can use the VAT- VIES Declaration Tax Auth report. The information is shown in the same format as in the declaration list from the customs and tax authorities.
trans-unit.target: Rapportér dit salg til andre EU-lande/områder til SKAT. Hvis oplysningerne skal udskrives på en printer, kan du bruge rapporten Moms - listeangivelse TS. Oplysningerne er opstillet på samme måde som i listeangivelsen fra SKAT.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action VAT - VIES Declaration Dis&k - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action VAT - VIES Declaration Dis&k - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Calculate VAT amounts from sales, and submit the amounts to a tax authority.
trans-unit.target: Beregn momsbeløb fra salg, og indberet beløbene til skattemyndighederne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action EC Sales &List - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action EC Sales &List - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View, print, or send a report that shows this year's and last year's figures as an ordinary trial balance. The closing of the income statement accounts is posted at the end of a fiscal year. The report can be used in connection with closing a fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Vis, udskriv, eller send en rapport, der viser dette og sidste års tal som en almindelig råbalance. Nulstilling af resultatopgørelseskonti bogføres ultimo i regnskabsåret. Rapporten kan bruges i forbindelse med årsafslutning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &Closing Trial Balance - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &Closing Trial Balance - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Define how to post transactions that recur with few or no changes to general ledger, bank, customer, vendor, or fixed asset accounts
trans-unit.target: Definer, hvordan transaktioner, der gentages med få eller ingen ændringer, skal bogføres på finanskonti, bankkonti, debitor- og kreditorkonti eller anlægskonti.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action <Action3> - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action <Action3> - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Chart of Accounts - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Chart of Accounts - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post financial transactions directly to general ledger accounts and other accounts, such as bank, customer, vendor, and employee accounts. Posting with a general journal always creates entries on general ledger accounts. This is true even when, for example, you post a journal line to a customer account, because an entry is posted to a general ledger receivables account through a posting group.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør økonomiske transaktioner direkte til finanskonti og andre konti, f.eks. bank-, debitor-, kreditor- og medarbejderkonti. Bogføring med en finanskladde opretter altid poster på finanskontiene. Dette gælder også, når du eksempelvis bogfører en kladdelinje til en debitorkonto, fordi der er bogført en post til finansregnskabets konto for tilgodehavender via en bogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action General &Ledger Setup - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action General &Ledger Setup - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Action60 - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Action97 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post entries to the insurance coverage ledger.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Insurance Journals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Insurance Journals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Create reminders for one or more customers with overdue payments.
trans-unit.target: Opret rykkere for en eller flere debitorer med forfaldne betalinger.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action C&reate Reminders - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action C&reate Reminders - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a comparison of the balance to the budget figures and calculates the variance and the percent variance in the current accounting period, the accumulated accounting period, and the fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Vis en sammenligning af saldoen med budgettallene, som beregner varians og afvigelse i procent i den aktuelle regnskabsperiode, den akkumulerede regnskabsperiode og regnskabsåret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action CA P/L Statement with Budget - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action CA P/L Statement with Budget - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Verify that the VAT amounts on the VAT statements match the amounts from the G/L entries.
trans-unit.target: Kontrollér, at momsbeløb på momsangivelse svarer til beløbene fra finansposterne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action G/L - VAT Reconciliation - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action G/L - VAT Reconciliation - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Prepare the EC Sales List report so you can submit VAT amounts to a tax authority.
trans-unit.target: Forbered rapporten med oversigt over EU-salg, så du kan indberette momsbeløb til skattemyndighederne.

trans-unit.source: View the chart of cost types with a structure and functionality that resembles the general ledger chart of accounts. You can transfer the general ledger income statement accounts or create your own chart of cost types.
trans-unit.target: Vis diagrammet over omkostningstyper med en struktur og funktionalitet, der minder om finanskontoplanen. Du kan overføre finanskontoens resultatopgørelseskonti eller oprette dit eget diagram over omkostningstyper.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cost Types - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post financial transactions directly to general ledger accounts and other accounts, such as bank, customer, vendor, and employee accounts. Posting with a general journal always creates entries on general ledger accounts. This is true even when, for example, you post a journal line to a customer account, because an entry is posted to a general ledger receivables account through a posting group.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør økonomiske transaktioner direkte til finanskonti og andre konti, f.eks. bank-, debitor-, kreditor- og medarbejderkonti. Bogføring med en finanskladde opretter altid poster på finanskontiene. Dette gælder også, når du eksempelvis bogfører en kladdelinje til en debitorkonto, fordi der er bogført en post til finansregnskabets konto for tilgodehavender via en bogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action GeneralJournals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action GeneralJournals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open the list of posted sales invoices.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Posted Sales Invoices - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Posted Sales Invoices - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Calculate depreciation according to the conditions that you define. If the fixed assets that are included in the batch job are integrated with the general ledger (defined in the depreciation book that is used in the batch job), the resulting entries are transferred to the fixed assets general ledger journal. Otherwise, the batch job transfers the entries to the fixed asset journal. You can then post the journal or adjust the entries before posting, if necessary.
trans-unit.target: Beregn afskrivningerne i overensstemmelse med de betingelser, du angiver. Hvis de faste anlægsaktiver i kørslen er integreret med finans (defineret i den afskrivningsprofil, der bruges i kørslen), overføres posterne til finanskladden for faste anlægsaktiver. Ellers overføres posterne til kladden for faste anlægsaktiver. Du kan postere kladden eller eventuelt justere posteringerne inden bogføringen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Calculate Deprec&iation - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Calculate Deprec&iation - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View, print, or send a report that shows a detailed trial balance for selected bank accounts. You can use the report at the close of an accounting period or fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Vis, udskriv, eller send en rapport, der viser en detaljeret råbalance for udvalgte bankkonti. Du kan bruge rapporten ved afslutningen af en regnskabsperiode eller ved årsopgørelsen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &Bank Detail Trial Balance - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action &Bank Detail Trial Balance - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit detailed information for the customers that you trade with. From each customer card, you can open related information, such as sales statistics and ongoing orders, and you can define special prices and line discounts that you grant if certain conditions are met.
trans-unit.target: Få vist eller rediger detaljerede oplysninger om de debitorer, som du handler med. Fra det enkelte debitorkort kan du få adgang til relaterede oplysninger, som f.eks. salgsstatistik og igangværende ordrer, og du kan definere specialpriser og linjerabatter, som debitoren får, når bestemte betingelser er opfyldt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Customers - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Customers - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit estimated amounts for a range of accounting periods.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger anslåede beløb for et interval af regnskabsperioder.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Budgets - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post recurring fixed asset transactions, such as acquisition and depreciation book without integration to the general ledger.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør tilbagevendende transaktioner for faste anlægsaktiver, f.eks. anskaffelse og afskrivningsprofil, uden integration til finans.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Number Series - Property Caption)

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Create Finance Charge &Memos - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or set up detailed information about your bank account, such as which currency to use, the format of bank files that you import and export as electronic payments, and the numbering of checks.
trans-unit.target: Få vist eller konfigurer detaljerede oplysninger om din bankkonto, f.eks. hvilken valuta der skal bruges, formatet på de bankfiler, du importerer og eksporterer som elektroniske betalinger, samt nummereringen af checks.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Bank Accounts - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Analyze amounts in your general ledger by their dimensions using analysis views that you have set up.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Analysis &Views - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Define your general policies for purchase invoicing and returns, such as whether to require vendor invoice numbers and how to post purchase discounts. Set up your number series for creating vendors and different purchase documents.
trans-unit.target: Definer dine generelle politikker for fakturering af køb og for returneringer, f.eks. om kreditorfakturanumre skal angives, og hvordan købsrabatter skal bogføres. Konfigurer dine nummerserier for oprettelse af kreditorer og forskellige købsbilag.

trans-unit.source: Get insight into the financial data stored in your chart of accounts. Financial reports analyze figures in G/L accounts, and compare general ledger entries with general ledger budget entries. For example, you can view the general ledger entries as percentages of the budget entries. Financial reports provide the data for core financial statements and views, such as the Cash Flow chart.
trans-unit.target: Få indsigt i de finansielle data, som er gemt i din kontoplan. Finansielle rapporter analyserer tal i finanskonti og sammenligner finansposter med finansbudgetposter. Du kan f.eks. få vist finansposterne som en procentsats af budgetposterne. Finansielle rapport indeholder data om de vigtigste årsregnskaber og visninger, f.eks. pengestrømsdiagrammet.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Account Schedules - Property Caption)

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Aged Accounts &Receivable - Property Caption)

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Posted Purchase Invoices - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the different currencies that you trade in or update the exchange rates by getting the latest rates from an external service provider.
trans-unit.target: Få vist de forskellige valutaer, du handler i, eller opdater valutakurserne ved at hente de seneste kurser fra en ekstern tjenesteudbyder.

trans-unit.source: Set up cost accounting budgets that are created based on cost types just as a budget for the general ledger is created based on general ledger accounts. A cost budget is created for a certain period of time, for example, a fiscal year. You can create as many cost budgets as needed. You can create a new cost budget manually, or by importing a cost budget, or by copying an existing cost budget as the budget base.
trans-unit.target: Konfigurer omkostningsregnskabsbudgetter, der er oprettet ud fra omkostningstyper, præcis som et budget for finansregnskabet oprettes baseret på finanskontiene. Et omkostningsbudget oprettes for en bestemt periode, f.eks. et regnskabsår. Du kan oprette et ubegrænset antal omkostningsbudgetter efter behov. Du kan oprette et nyt omkostningsbudget manuelt eller ved at importere et omkostningsbudget eller ved at kopiere et eksisterende omkostningsbudget som basis for budgettet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cost Budgets - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Cost Budgets - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post any sales-related transaction directly to a customer, bank, or general ledger account instead of using dedicated documents. You can post all types of financial sales transactions, including payments, refunds, and finance charge amounts. Note that you cannot post item quantities with a sales journal.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør enhver transaktion, der er relateret til salg, direkte til en debitor-, bankkonto eller finanskonto i stedet at bruge dedikerede bilag. Du kan bogføre alle typer finansielle salgstransaktioner, herunder betalinger, refusioner og finansgebyrbeløb. Bemærk, at du ikke kan bogføre varebeholdninger med en salgskladde.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action SalesJournals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.target: Vis en opgørelse over bogført moms, og beregn de skyldige afgifter for den valgte periode til toldvæsenet.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action VAT &Statement - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Send finance charge memos to customers with delayed payments, typically following a reminder process. Finance charges are calculated automatically and added to the overdue amounts on the customer's account according to the specified finance charge terms and penalty/interest amounts.
trans-unit.target: Send rentenotaer til debitorer med forsinkede betalinger, hvilket typisk følger efter en rykkerprocedure. Renter beregnes automatisk og føjes til de forfaldne beløb på debitorens konto i henhold til de angivne rentebetingelser og sanktions- eller rentebeløb.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accounting Manager Role Center - Action Finance Charge Memos - Property Caption)

Sales invoicing is integrated in the sales order process.

trans-unit.source: Adjust the quantity of an item in a particular bin or bins. For instance, you might find some items in a bin that are not registered in the system, or you might not be able to pick the quantity needed because there are fewer items in a bin than was calculated by the program. The bin is then updated to correspond to the actual quantity in the bin. In addition, it creates a balancing quantity in the adjustment bin, for synchronization with item ledger entries, which you can then post with an item journal.
trans-unit.target: Reguler antallet af en vare på én eller flere placeringer. Det kan f.eks. være, at du finder nogle varer på en placering, der ikke er registreret i systemet, eller at du ikke kan plukke det nødvendige antal, fordi der er færre varer på en placering, som programmet har beregnet. Placeringen opdateres derefter, så den svarer til det faktiske antal på placeringen. Desuden oprettes et udlignende antal på reguleringsplaceringen til synkronisering med vareposter, som du derefter kan bogføre med en varekladde.

trans-unit.source: Register payments to vendors. A payment journal is a type of general journal that is used to post outgoing payment transactions to G/L, bank, customer, vendor, employee, and fixed assets accounts. The Suggest Vendor Payments functions automatically fills the journal with payments that are due. When payments are posted, you can export the payments to a bank file for upload to your bank if your system is set up for electronic banking. You can also issue computer checks from the payment journal.
trans-unit.target: Registrer betalinger til kreditorer. En betalingskladde er en finanskladde, der bruges til at bogføre udgående betalingstransaktioner til finansregnskab, bank, debitor, kreditor, medarbejder og anlægskonti. Funktionerne for Lav kreditorbetalingsforslag udfylder automatisk kladden med de forfaldne betalinger. Når betalingerne er bogført, kan du eksportere betalingerne til en bankfil med henblik på overførsel til din bank, såfremt systemet er konfigureret til elektronisk betaling. Du kan også sende computercheck fra betalingskladden.

(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action PaymentJournals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Revert the financial transactions involved when your customers want to cancel a purchase or return incorrect or damaged items that you sent to them and received payment for. To include the correct information, you can create the sales credit memo from the related posted sales invoice or you can create a new sales credit memo with copied invoice information. If you need more control of the sales return process, such as warehouse documents for the physical handling, use sales return orders, in which sales credit memos are integrated. Note: If an erroneous sale has not been paid yet, you can simply cancel the posted sales invoice to automatically revert the financial transaction.
trans-unit.target: Tilbagefør økonomiske transaktioner, når debitorerne vil annullere et køb eller returnere forkerte eller beskadigede varer, som du har sendt til dem og modtaget betaling for. For at få de rette oplysninger med, kan du oprette salgskreditnotaen ud fra den relaterede bogførte salgsfaktura, eller du kan oprette en ny salgskreditnota, hvor du indsætter en kopi af fakturaoplysninger. Hvis du har brug for mere kontrol over processen for salgsreturvarer som f.eks. bilag for den fysiske lagerekspedition, skal du bruge salgsreturvareordrer, hvor salgskreditnotaer er integreret. Bemærk: Hvis et fejlbehæftet salg endnu ikke er blevet betalt, kan du blot annullere den bogførte salgsfaktura for automatisk at tilbageføre den økonomiske transaktion.

trans-unit.source: View information to the customs and tax authorities for sales to other EU countries/regions. If the information must be printed to a file, you can use the VAT- VIES Declaration Disk report.
trans-unit.target: Vis oplysninger til told- og skattemyndighederne ved salg til andre EU-lande/områder. Hvis oplysningerne skal skrives til en fil, kan du bruge rapporten Moms - listeangivelse disk.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action VAT-VIES Declaration Tax A&uth - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action VAT-VIES Declaration Tax A&uth - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open the cash receipt journal to post incoming payments.
trans-unit.target: Åbn indbetalingskladden for at bogføre indgående betalinger.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Cash Receipt &Journal - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Cash Receipt &Journal - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Create purchase orders to mirror sales documents that vendors send to you. This enables you to record the cost of purchases and to track accounts payable. Posting purchase orders dynamically updates inventory levels so that you can minimize inventory costs and provide better customer service. Purchase orders allow partial receipts, unlike with purchase invoices, and enable drop shipment directly from your vendor to your customer. Purchase orders can be created automatically from PDF or image files from your vendors by using the Incoming Documents feature.
trans-unit.target: Opret købsordrer for at afspejle de salgsbilag, som leverandører sender til dig. På denne måde kan du registrere købsomkostninger og spore kreditorer. Bogføringen af købsordrer opdaterer lagerniveauerne dynamisk, så du kan minimere lageromkostningerne og levere bedre kundeservice. Købsordrer tillader delleverancer, modsat købsfakturaer, og muliggør direkte levering fra kreditoren til debitoren. Købsordrer kan oprettes automatisk ud fra PDF- eller billedfiler fra dine kreditorer ved hjælp af funktionen Indgående bilag.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Purchase Orders - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Purchase Orders - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a statement of posted VAT and calculate the duty liable to the customs authorities for the selected period.
trans-unit.target: Vis en opgørelse over bogført moms, og beregn de skyldige afgifter for den valgte periode til toldvæsenet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action V&AT Statement - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action V&AT Statement - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the list of marketing tasks that exist.
trans-unit.target: Få vist listen over eksisterende marketingopgaver.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Tasks - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Tasks - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post entries to a depreciation book without integration to the general ledger.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør poster i en afskrivningsprofil uden integration i finansregnskabet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action FA Journals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action FA Journals - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Chart of Accounts - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Chart of Accounts - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Change the inventory value of items, for example after doing a physical inventory.
trans-unit.target: Ret lagerværdien af varer, f.eks. når du har foretaget en fysisk lageropgørelse.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action RevaluationJournals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action RevaluationJournals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list of item sales for each customer during a selected time period. The report contains information on quantity, sales amount, profit, and possible discounts. It can be used, for example, to analyze a company's customer groups.
trans-unit.target: Vis en oversigt over varesalg i den valgte periode for hver debitor. Rapporten viser oplysninger om antal, salgsbeløb, avance og eventuel rabat. Du kan f.eks. bruge rapporten til at analysere en virksomheds debitorgrupper.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Customer/&Item Sales - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Customer/&Item Sales - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Worksheets - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Action19 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Verify that the VAT amounts on the VAT statements match the amounts from the G/L entries.
trans-unit.target: Kontrollér, at momsbeløb på momsangivelse svarer til beløbene fra finansposterne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action G/L - VAT Reconciliation - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action G/L - VAT Reconciliation - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit purchase lines that you have set up for recurring sales, such as a monthly replenishment order.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger købslinjer, som du har konfigureret for tilbagevendende salg, f.eks. en månedlig genbestillingsordre.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Standard Sales Codes - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Standard Sales Codes - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or set up codes that specify reasons why entries were created, such as Return, to specify why a purchase credit memo was posted.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller konfigurer koder, der angiver årsager til oprettelse af poster (f.eks. Returvare), for at angive, hvorfor en købskreditnota er bogført.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Reason Codes - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Reason Codes - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the sales line discounts that are available. These discount agreements can be for individual customers, for a group of customers, for all customers or for a campaign.
trans-unit.target: Få vist de tilgængelige salgslinjerabatter. Disse rabataftaler kan gælde for individuelle debitorer, for debitorgrupper, for alle debitorer eller for en kampagne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Sales &Line Discounts - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Sales &Line Discounts - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Set up users and define their permissions..
trans-unit.target: Konfigurer brugere, og definer deres rettigheder.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action User Setup - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action User Setup - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Posted Documents - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post financial transactions directly to general ledger accounts and other accounts, such as bank, customer, vendor, and employee accounts. Posting with a general journal always creates entries on general ledger accounts. This is true even when, for example, you post a journal line to a customer account, because an entry is posted to a general ledger receivables account through a posting group.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør økonomiske transaktioner direkte til finanskonti og andre konti, f.eks. bank-, debitor-, kreditor- og medarbejderkonti. Bogføring med en finanskladde opretter altid poster på finanskontiene. Dette gælder også, når du eksempelvis bogfører en kladdelinje til en debitorkonto, fordi der er bogført en post til finansregnskabets konto for tilgodehavender via en bogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action GeneralJournals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action GeneralJournals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open the list of posted sales invoices.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Posted Sales Invoices - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Posted Sales Invoices - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Manage employees' details and related information, such as qualifications and pictures, or register and analyze employee absence. Keeping up-to-date records about your employees simplifies personnel tasks. For example, if an employee's address changes, you register this on the employee card.
trans-unit.target: Administrer medarbejderoplysninger og relaterede oplysninger som f.eks. kvalifikationer og billeder, eller registrer og analysér medarbejderfravær. Sikring af opdaterede records om medarbejderne forenkler dine personaleopgaver. Hvis en medarbejder f.eks. skifter adresse, kan du registrere dette på medarbejderkortet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Employees - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Employees - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Report your sales to other EU countries or regions to the customs and tax authorities. If the information must be printed out on a printer, you can use the VAT- VIES Declaration Tax Auth report. The information is shown in the same format as in the declaration list from the customs and tax authorities.
trans-unit.target: Rapportér dit salg til andre EU-lande/områder til SKAT. Hvis oplysningerne skal udskrives på en printer, kan du bruge rapporten Moms - listeangivelse TS. Oplysningerne er opstillet på samme måde som i listeangivelsen fra SKAT.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action VAT - VIES Declaration &Disk - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action VAT - VIES Declaration &Disk - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list of salespeople and purchasers.
trans-unit.target: Vis en liste over sælgere og indkøbere.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Salespeople/Purchasers - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Salespeople/Purchasers - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Resources - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit detailed information for the customers that you trade with. From each customer card, you can open related information, such as sales statistics and ongoing orders, and you can define special prices and line discounts that you grant if certain conditions are met.
trans-unit.target: Få vist eller rediger detaljerede oplysninger om de debitorer, som du handler med. Fra det enkelte debitorkort kan du få adgang til relaterede oplysninger, som f.eks. salgsstatistik og igangværende ordrer, og du kan definere specialpriser og linjerabatter, som debitoren får, når bestemte betingelser er opfyldt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Customers - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Customers - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View this year's and last year's figures as an ordinary trial balance. For income statement accounts, the balances are shown without closing entries. Closing entries are listed on a fictitious date that falls between the last day of one fiscal year and the first day of the next one. The closing of the income statement accounts is posted at the end of a fiscal year. The report can be used in connection with closing a fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Vis dette og sidste års tal som en almindelig råbalance. For konti i resultatopgørelsen vises saldi uden ultimoposter. Ultimoposter anføres på en fiktiv dato mellem den sidste dag i det gamle regnskabsår og den første i det nye. Nulstilling af resultatopgørelseskonti bogføres ultimo i regnskabsåret. Rapporten kan f.eks. bruges i forbindelse med årsafslutning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Closing T&rial Balance - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Closing T&rial Balance - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list of your items and their prices, for example, to send to customers. You can create the list for specific customers, campaigns, currencies, or other criteria.
trans-unit.target: Vis en liste over dine varer samt oplysninger om priser og omkostninger på disse med henblik på at sende den til debitorerne. Du kan oprette listen til specifikke debitorer, kampagner, valutaer eller til andre formål.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Price &List - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Price &List - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Use an EU VAT number validation service to validated the VAT number of a business partner.
trans-unit.target: Brug en tjeneste til validering af EU-momsnumre til at validere en forretningspartners momsnummer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action VAT Registration No. Chec&k - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action VAT Registration No. Chec&k - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or set up detailed information about your bank account, such as which currency to use, the format of bank files that you import and export as electronic payments, and the numbering of checks.
trans-unit.target: Få vist eller konfigurer detaljerede oplysninger om din bankkonto, f.eks. hvilken valuta der skal bruges, formatet på de bankfiler, du importerer og eksporterer som elektroniske betalinger, samt nummereringen af checks.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Bank Accounts - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Bank Accounts - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action RecurringJournals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action RecurringJournals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Set up a new vendor from whom you buy goods or services.
trans-unit.target: Opret en ny kreditor, som du køber varer eller tjenester hos.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action &Vendor - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action &Vendor - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit the bill of material that specifies which items and resources are required to assemble the assembly item.
trans-unit.target: Få vist eller rediger den stykliste, der angiver, hvilke varer og ressourcer der kræves for at samle montageelementet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Assembly BOM - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Assembly BOM - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the posted bank deposit header, bank deposit header lines, bank deposit comments, and bank deposit dimensions.
trans-unit.target: Vis det bogførte bankindskuds overskrift, bankindskuds overskriftslinjer, kommentarer til bankindskud og bankindskudsdimensioner.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Posted Bank Deposits - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Posted Bank Deposits - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Reconcile entries in your bank account ledger entries with the actual transactions in your bank account, according to the latest bank statement.
trans-unit.target: Afstem poster i dine bankkontoposter med de faktiske transaktioner på din bankkonto i henhold til den seneste bankkontoudtog.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action &Bank Account Reconciliation - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action &Bank Account Reconciliation - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open the list of posted purchase invoices.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Posted Purchase Invoices - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Posted Purchase Invoices - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the different currencies that you trade in or update the exchange rates by getting the latest rates from an external service provider.
trans-unit.target: Få vist de forskellige valutaer, du handler i, eller opdater valutakurserne ved at hente de seneste kurser fra en ekstern tjenesteudbyder.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Currencies - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Currencies - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View the list of issued reminders.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Issued Reminders - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Issued Reminders - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open the list of posted purchase credit memos.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Posted Purchase Credit Memos - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Posted Purchase Credit Memos - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Purchase goods or services from a vendor.
trans-unit.target: Køb varer eller servicer fra en kreditor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action &Purchase Order - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action &Purchase Order - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action History - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View all entries for selected customers for a selected period. You can choose to have all overdue balances displayed, regardless of the period specified. You can also choose to include an aging band. For each currency, the report displays open entries and, if specified in the report, overdue entries. The statement can be sent to customers, for example, at the close of an accounting period or as a reminder of overdue balances.
trans-unit.target: Vis alle poster i den valgte periode for de valgte debitorer. Du kan vælge at få vist samtlige forfaldne saldi, uafhængigt af den angivne periode. Du kan også vælge at medtage et aldersfordelingsinterval. Rapporten viser åbne poster og, hvis det er angivet i rapporten, forfaldne poster for hver valuta. Rapporten kan f.eks. sendes ud til debitorer i forbindelse med afslutningen på en regnskabsperiode eller som en påmindelse om manglende betaling.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action S&tatement - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action S&tatement - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View if a certain general ledger account reconciles the balance on a certain date for the corresponding posting group. The report shows the accounts that are included in the reconciliation with the general ledger balance and the customer or the vendor ledger balance for each account and shows any differences between the general ledger balance and the customer or vendor ledger balance.
trans-unit.target: Vis, om en bestemt finanskonto afstemmer balancen på en bestemt dato for den tilsvarende bogføringsgruppe. Rapporten viser de konti, der medtages i afstemningen af finansbalancen og debitor- eller kreditorbalancen for hver konto, samt eventuelle forskelle mellem finansbalancen og debitor- eller kreditorbalancen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Reconcile Cust. and &Vend. Accs - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Reconcile Cust. and &Vend. Accs - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Set up the number of accounting periods, such as 12 monthly periods, within the fiscal year and specify which period is the start of the new fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Angiv antal regnskabsperioder, f.eks. 12 månedsperioder, i regnskabsåret, og angiv, hvilken periode der er starten på det nye regnskabsår.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Accounting Periods - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Accounting Periods - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action C&ustomer - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action C&ustomer - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Post the quantity and value changes to the inventory in the item ledger entries and the value entries when you post inventory transactions, such as sales shipments or purchase receipts.
trans-unit.target: Bogfør ændringen i antal og værdi for lageret i vareposterne og værdiposterne, når du bogfører lagertransaktioner som f.eks. salgsleverancer eller købsfakturaer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Post Inve&ntory Cost to G/L - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Post Inve&ntory Cost to G/L - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Calculate a supply plan to fulfill item demand with purchases or transfers.
trans-unit.target: Beregn en forsyningsplan for at opfylde varebehov via indkøb eller overførsler.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Requisition Worksheets - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Requisition Worksheets - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Open a list of journals where you can adjust the physical quantity of items on inventory.
trans-unit.target: Åbn en liste med kladder, hvor du kan justere det fysiske antal varer på lager.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action ItemJournals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action ItemJournals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Pay your vendors by filling the payment journal automatically according to payments due, and potentially export all payment to your bank for automatic processing.
trans-unit.target: Betal dine kreditorer ved at udfylde betalingskladden automatisk i henhold til de forfaldne betalinger, og eksportér eventuelt alle betalinger til din bank til automatisk behandling.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Vendor Pa&yment Journal - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Vendor Pa&yment Journal - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Action93 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View which customers purchase the most or owe the most in a selected period. Only customers that have either purchases during the period or a balance at the end of the period will be included.
trans-unit.target: Vis de debitorer, der køber mest, eller som skylder mest, i en bestemt periode. Kun de debitorer, der har køb i løbet af perioden eller en saldo ved periodens afslutning, vil blive vist i rapporten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Customer - T&op 10 List - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Customer - T&op 10 List - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Resource Journals - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Resource Journals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Manage your resources' job activities by setting up their costs and prices. The job-related prices, discounts, and cost factor rules are set up on the respective job card. You can specify the costs and prices for individual resources, resource groups, or all available resources of the company. When resources are used or sold in a job, the specified prices and costs are recorded for the project.
trans-unit.target: Administrer dine ressourcers sagsaktiviteter ved at angive deres omkostninger og priser. Reglerne for sagsrelaterede pris-, rabat- og kostfaktorer konfigureres for de respektive jobkort. Du kan angive omkostninger og priser for individuelle ressourcer, ressourcegrupper eller alle tilgængelige ressourcer i virksomheden. Når ressourcerne anvendes eller sælges i en sag, registreres de angivne priser og omkostninger for projektet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Action126 - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Action126 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View a list of all the resource registers. Every time a resource entry is posted, a register is created. Every register shows the first and last entry numbers of its entries. You can use the information in a resource register to document when entries were posted.
trans-unit.target: Vis en liste over alle ressourcejournaler. Hver gang en ressourcepost bliver bogført, oprettes der en ressourcejournal. Hver journal viser det første og sidste løbenummer for posterne i den. Du kan bruge oplysningerne i en ressourcejournal til at dokumentere, hvornår posterne er bogført.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Resource Registers - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Resource Registers - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Fixed Assets - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Record your agreements with customers to sell certain products on certain delivery and payment terms. Sales orders, unlike sales invoices, allow you to ship partially, deliver directly from your vendor to your customer, initiate warehouse handling, and print various customer-facing documents. Sales invoicing is integrated in the sales order process.
trans-unit.target: Registrer dine aftaler med debitorer for at sælge bestemte varer på bestemte leverings- og betalingsbetingelser. I modsætning til salgsfakturaer gør salgsordrer det muligt at levere delvist, levere direkte fra kreditoren til debitoren, starte lagerstedsekspedition og udskrive forskellige bilag til kunderne. Salgsfakturering er integreret i salgsordreprocessen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Sales Orders - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Small Business Owner RC - Action Sales Orders - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: View or edit detailed information for the vendors that you trade with. From each vendor card, you can open related information, such as purchase statistics and ongoing orders, and you can define special prices and line discounts that the vendor grants you if certain conditions are met.
trans-unit.target: Få vist eller rediger detaljerede oplysninger om de kreditorer, som du handler med. Fra det enkelte kreditorkort kan du få adgang til relaterede oplysninger som f.eks. købsstatistik og igangværende ordrer, og du kan definere specialpriser og linjerabatter, som kreditoren giver dig, når bestemte betingelser er opfyldt.

Du kan bogføre alle typer finansielle købstransaktioner, herunder betalinger, refusioner og finansgebyrbeløb. Bemærk, at du ikke kan bogføre varebeholdninger med en købskladde.
