trans-unit.source: Over time, data accumulates in the database and not all of it stays relevant. For example, you may have log entries, copies of companies, or ledger entries that you no longer need. This guide will help you remove unneeded data in a safe way.
trans-unit.target: Data akkumuleres med tiden i databasen, og ikke alle forbliver relevante. Du kan f.eks. have logposter, kopier af virksomheder eller finansposter, som du ikke længere har brug for. Denne vejledning kan hjælpe dig med at fjerne unødvendige data på en sikker måde.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.DataAdministration)(LookupHint=Page Data Administration Guide - Control Intro2 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Date compression cannot be undone. Before you start, we recommend that you create a backup of the database.
trans-unit.target: Datokomprimering kan ikke fortrydes. Inden du starter, anbefales det, at du opretter en sikkerhedskopi af databasen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.DataAdministration)(LookupHint=Page Data Administration Guide - Control DateCompressionWarning - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Select the dimension information that you want to retain. The compressed entries will be summarized by the dimensions you select. Selecting more dimensions will result in less compression. Dimensions used in analysis views will be retained automatically.
trans-unit.target: Vælg de dimensionsoplysninger, du vil bevare. De komprimerede poster opsummeres efter de dimensioner, du vælger. Hvis du vælger flere dimensioner, bliver der mindre komprimering. Dimensioner, der bruges i analysevisninger, bevares automatisk.

(Namespace=System.DataAdministration)(LookupHint=Page Data Administration Guide - Control RetainDimensions - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: All done. You can always re-run this guide to clean up more records. Click Finish to close the guide.

trans-unit.source: Analysis Views must be up to date before compressing ledger entries. When you click Next, the analysis views will be updated and the selected ledger entries will be compressed using the options you specified.

trans-unit.source: Companies take up a lot of space in the database. If you no longer need an evaluation company, for example, consider deleting it. Click the link below to open the list of companies.
trans-unit.target: Virksomheder optager meget plads i databasen. Hvis du ikke længere har brug for en evalueringsvirksomhed, skal du f.eks. overveje at slette den. Klik på linket nedenfor for at åbne listen over virksomheder.

trans-unit.source: Over time, ledger entries can increase the size of your database. Use date compression to summarize the entries from a specific period of time, and keep only the most important information. Before you compress data, be sure that the dates are outside the period of time that your local authorities require you to keep detailed records.
trans-unit.target: Med tiden kan finansposter øge databasens størrelse. Brug datokomprimering til at summere posterne fra en bestemt tidsperiode, og behold kun de vigtigste oplysninger. Før du komprimerer data, skal du sikre dig, at datoerne ligger uden for den periode, hvor de lokale myndigheder kræver detaljerede poster.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date when the item is planned to arrive in inventory. Forward calculation: planned receipt date = order date + vendor lead time (per the vendor calendar and rounded to the next working day in first the vendor calendar and then the location calendar). If no vendor calendar exists, then: planned receipt date = order date + vendor lead time (per the location calendar). Backward calculation: order date = planned receipt date - vendor lead time (per the vendor calendar and rounded to the previous working day in first the vendor calendar and then the location calendar). If no vendor calendar exists, then: order date = planned receipt date - vendor lead time (per the location calendar).
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor varen skal ankomme på lageret. Forlæns beregning: planlagt modtagelsesdato = ordredato + kreditors leveringstid (ifølge kreditorens kalender og afrundet til næste arbejdsdag først i kreditorens kalender og derefter lokationens kalender). Hvis der ingen kalender findes hos kreditoren: planlagt modtagelsesdato = ordredato + kreditors leveringstid (ifølge lokationens kalender). Baglæns beregning: ordredato = planlagt modtagelsesdato - kreditors leveringstid (ifølge kreditorens kalender og afrundet til den forrige arbejdsdag først i kreditorens kalender og derefter lokationens kalender). Hvis der ingen kalender findes hos kreditoren: ordredato = planlagt modtagelsesdato - kreditors leveringstid (ifølge lokations kalender).
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Purchase Order Archive Subform - Control Planned Receipt Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: By enabling this feature, you consent to your data being shared with a Microsoft service that might be outside of your organization's selected geographic boundaries and might have different compliance and security standards than Microsoft Dynamics Business Central. Your privacy is important to us, and you can choose whether to share data with the service. To learn more, follow the link below.

Dette felt sammen med feltet Komponenter på lokation i vinduet Produktionsopsætning er meget vigtigt med hensyn til, hvordan planlægningssystemet håndterer behovslinjer med/uden lokationskoder. trans-unit.source: Specifies a date formula that calculates the time it takes to get items ready to ship. The time element is used to calculate the delivery date as follows: Shipment Date + Outbound Warehouse Handling Time = Planned Shipment Date + Shipping Time = Planned Delivery Date.

Tidselementet bruges til at beregne leveringsdatoen på følgende måde: Afsendelsesdato + Udgående lagerekspeditionstid = Planlagt afsendelsesdato + Transporttid = Planlagt leveringsdato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Setup)(LookupHint=Page Inventory Setup - Control Outbound Whse. Handling Time - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how your items' cost flow is recorded and whether an actual or budgeted value is capitalized and used in the cost calculation. Your choice of costing method determines how the unit cost is calculated by making assumptions about the flow of physical items through your company. A different costing method on item cards will override this default. For more information, see "Design Details: Costing Methods" in Help.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan dine varers kostprisflow registreres, og om en faktisk eller budgetteret værdi aktiveres og bruges i kostprisberegningen. Valget af kostmetode bestemmer, hvordan kostprisen beregnes, ved at opstille forudsætninger om den fysiske varestrøm gennem virksomheden. En anden kostmetode på varekortet vil tilsidesætte denne standard. Du kan finde yderligere oplysninger i "Designdetaljer: Kostmetoder" i Hjælp.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Setup)(LookupHint=Page Inventory Setup - Control Default Costing Method - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.target: Angiver, om både hovedplan og materialebehovsplan køres, når du vælger handlingen Beregn totalplan i planlægningskladden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Setup)(LookupHint=Page Inventory Setup - Control Combined MPS/MRP Calculation - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a period of time during which you do not want the planning system to propose to reschedule existing supply order's forward. This value in this field applies to all items except for items that have a different value in the Dampener Period field on the item card. When a dampener time is set, an order is only rescheduled when the defined dampener time has passed since the order s original due date. Note: The dampener time that is applied to an item can never be higher than the value in the item's Lot Accumulation Period field. This is because the inventory build-up time that occurs during a dampener period would conflict with the build-up period defined by the item's lot accumulation period. Accordingly, the default dampener period generally applies to all items. However, if an item's lot accumulation period is shorter than the default dampener period, then the item's dampener time equals its lot accumulation period.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en tidsperiode, hvor planlægningsprogrammet ikke skal foreslå at omplanlægge eksisterende forsyningsordrer fremad. Værdien i dette felt gælder for alle varer undtagen varer, der har en anden værdi i feltet Bufferperiode på varekortet. Når der er angivet en bufferperiode, omplanlægges en ordre kun, når den definerede bufferperiode er gået siden den oprindelige forfaldsdato for ordren. Bemærk: Den buffertid, der gælder for en vare, må aldrig være højere end værdien i feltet Akkumuleringsperiode for lot for varen. Dette skyldes, at lageropbygningstiden, der forekommer under en bufferperiode, er i konflikt med den opbygningsperiode, der er defineret af varens akkumuleringsperiode for lot. Standardbufferperioden gælder derfor generelt for alle varer. Hvis en vares akkumuleringsperiode for lot er kortere end standardbufferperioden, er varens buffertid dog lig med akkumuleringsperioden for lot.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Setup)(LookupHint=Page Inventory Setup - Control Default Dampener Period - Property ToolTip)

Alle lagerreduktioner, der er bogført i en gennemsnitlig omkostningsperiode, modtager den gennemsnitlige kostpris, der er beregnet for den pågældende periode. Hvis du ændrer den gennemsnitlige omkostningsperiode, påvirker det kun åbne regnskabsår.

trans-unit.source: Specifies a date formula that calculates the time it takes to make items available in inventory after they have been received. The time element is used to calculate the expected receipt date as follows: Order Date + Lead Time Calculation = Planned Receipt Date + Inbound Warehouse Handling Time + Safety Lead Time = Expected Receipt Date.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en datoformel, der beregner den tid, det tager at gøre varerne tilgængelige på lageret, efter at de er modtaget. Tidselementet bruges til at beregne den forventede modtagelsesdato som følger: Ordredato + Leveringstid = Planlagt modtagelsesdato + Indgående lagerekspeditionstid + Sikkerhedstid = Forventet modtagelsesdato.

trans-unit.source: Specifies if value entries originating from receipt or shipment posting, but not from invoice posting are recoded in the general ledger. Expected costs represent the estimation of, for example, a purchased item's cost that you record before you receive the invoice for the item. To post expected costs, interim accounts must exist in the general ledger for the relevant posting groups. Expected costs are only managed for item transactions, not for immaterial transaction types, such as capacity and item charges.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om værdiposter, der stammer fra modtagelses- eller leveringsbogføring, men ikke fra bogføring af faktura, registreres i finans. Forventede omkostninger repræsenterer et estimat af f.eks. en købt vares kostpris, som du registrerer, før du modtager fakturaen for varen. Hvis du vil bogføre de forventede omkostninger, skal der være mellemregningskonti i finans for de relevante bogføringsgrupper. Forventede omkostninger administreres kun for vareposteringer ikke for immaterielle transaktionsarter, f.eks. kapacitets- og vareændringer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Setup)(LookupHint=Page Inventory Setup - Control Expected Cost Posting to G/L - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether a variant must be selected if variants exist for an item. This is the default setting for all items. However, the same option is available on the Item Card page for items. That setting applies to the specific item.

trans-unit.source: Specifies if item value entries are automatically adjusted when an item transaction is posted. This ensures correct inventory valuation in the general ledger, so that sales and profit statistics are up to date. The cost adjustment forwards any cost changes from inbound entries, such as those for purchases or production output, to the related outbound entries, such as sales or transfers. To minimize reduced performance during posting, select a time option to define how far back in time from the work date an inbound transaction can occur to potentially trigger adjustment of related outbound value entries. Alternatively, you can manually adjust costs at regular intervals with the Adjust Cost - Item Entries batch job.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om vareværdiposter justeres automatisk, når en varetransaktion bogføres. Dette sikrer korrekt lagerværdi i finans, så salgs- og indtjeningsstatistikkerne opdateres. Omkostningsreguleringen sender eventuelle omkostningsændringer fra indgående poster, f.eks. for køb eller produktionsafgang til de relaterede udgående poster, f.eks. salg eller overflytninger. For at minimere reduktionen af ydeevnen under bogføringen, kan du vælge en tidsindstilling til at definere, hvor langt tilbage i tid fra arbejdsdatoen en indgående transaktion må være for eventuelt at udløse regulering af relaterede udgående værdiposter. Alternativt kan du manuelt justere omkostningerne regelmæssigt med kørslen Juster kostpris - vareposter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Setup)(LookupHint=Page Inventory Setup - Control Automatic Cost Adjustment - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how costs are calculated for items using the Average costing method. Item: One average cost per item in the company is calculated. Item & Location & Variant: An average cost per item for each location and for each variant of the item in the company is calculated. This means that the average cost of this item depends on where it is stored and which variant, such as color, of the item you have selected.

Vare og lokation og variant: Der beregnes en gennemsnitlig kostpris pr. vare for hver lokation og for hver variant af varen i virksomheden. Det betyder, at den gennemsnitlige kostpris for varen afhænger af, hvor den er lagret, og hvilken variant, f.eks. farve, af varen du har valgt.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the purpose of the account. Total: Used to total a series of balances on accounts from many different account groupings. To use Total, leave this field blank. Begin-Total: A marker for the beginning of a series of accounts to be totaled that ends with an End-Total account. End-Total: A total of a series of accounts that starts with the preceding Begin-Total account. The total is defined in the Totaling field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver formålet med kontoen. I alt: Bruges til at sammentælle en række saldi på konti fra mange forskellige grupper. Lad feltet stå tomt, hvis du vil bruge I alt. Fra-Sum: En markering af begyndelsen af en række konti, der skal sammentælles og slutter med en Til-sum-konto. Til-sum: Det samlede antal konti, der starter med den foregående Fra-sum-konto. Det samlede antal er defineret i feltet Sammentælling.

trans-unit.source: This guide will help you invite an external accountant to login to your company.
trans-unit.target: Denne guide hjælper dig med at invitere en ekstern revisor til at logge på din virksomhed.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.AccountantPortal)(LookupHint=Page Invite External Accountant - Control Control12 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.target: Vælg Næste for at komme i gang.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.AccountantPortal)(LookupHint=Page Invite External Accountant - Control Control7 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: This Invite External Accountant feature allows your organization to share its data with an external party either through the use of a separate portal or through the external party's access to your organization's online services account. Microsoft has no control over the third-party's use of your data. You are responsible for ensuring that you have separate agreements in place with any such external user governing such external user's access to and use of your data.
trans-unit.target: Med funktionen Inviter ekstern revisor kan din organisation dele data med en ekstern part ved hjælp af en separat portal eller via den eksterne parts adgang til din organisations konto til onlinetjenester. Microsoft har ingen kontrol over tredjepartens brug af dine data. Du er ansvarlig for at sikre, at du har separate aftaler med enhver ekstern bruger, som håndhæver en sådan ekstern brugers adgang til og anvendelse af dine data.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.AccountantPortal)(LookupHint=Page Invite External Accountant - Control Control24 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the planned date that the shipment will be delivered at the customer's address. If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates whether the items will be available for delivery on this date. If the items are available, the planned delivery date will be the same as the requested delivery date. If not, the program calculates the date that the items are available for delivery and enters this date in the Planned Delivery Date field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den planlagte dato, hvor leverancen leveres på debitorens adresse. Hvis debitoren anmoder om en leveringsdato, beregner programmet, om varerne er disponible for levering på denne dato. Hvis varerne er disponible, er den planlagte leveringsdato den samme som den anmodede leveringsdato. Hvis ikke, beregner programmet den dato, hvor varerne er disponible for levering, og angiver denne dato i feltet Planlagt leveringsdato.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that the shipment should ship from the warehouse. trans-unit.source: Tracking changes can impact performance, which can cost you time, and increase the size of your database, which might cost you money. To reduce those costs, consider the following:

trans-unit.source: Specifies how the Amount field for each period is calculated. Straight-Line: Calculated per the number of periods, distributed by period length. Equal Per Period: Calculated per the number of periods, distributed evenly on periods. Days Per Period: Calculated per the number of days in the period. User-Defined: Not calculated. You must manually fill the Amount field for each period.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan feltet Beløb for hver periode beregnes. Lineær: Beregnet pr. antal af perioder, som fordeles efter periodelængde. (Namespace=System.Environment.Configuration)(LookupHint=Page Profile Import Wizard - Control Step2 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a period of time during which you do not want the planning system to propose to reschedule existing supply order's forward. This value in this field applies to all items except for items that have a different value in the Dampener Period field on the item card. When a dampener time is set, an order is only rescheduled when the defined dampener time has passed since the order s original due date. Note: The dampener time that is applied to an item can never be higher than the value in the item's Lot Accumulation Period field. This is because the inventory build-up time that occurs during a dampener period would conflict with the build-up period defined by the item's lot accumulation period. Accordingly, the default dampener period generally applies to all items. However, if an item's lot accumulation period is shorter than the default dampener period, then the item's dampener time equals its lot accumulation period.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en tidsperiode, hvor planlægningsprogrammet ikke skal foreslå at omplanlægge eksisterende forsyningsordrer fremad. Værdien i dette felt gælder for alle varer undtagen varer, der har en anden værdi i feltet Bufferperiode på varekortet. Når der er angivet en bufferperiode, omplanlægges en ordre kun, når den definerede bufferperiode er gået siden den oprindelige forfaldsdato for ordren. Bemærk: Den buffertid, der gælder for en vare, må aldrig være højere end værdien i feltet Akkumuleringsperiode for lot for varen. Dette skyldes, at lageropbygningstiden, der forekommer under en bufferperiode, er i konflikt med den opbygningsperiode, der er defineret af varens akkumuleringsperiode for lot. Standardbufferperioden gælder derfor generelt for alle varer. Hvis en vares akkumuleringsperiode for lot er kortere end standardbufferperioden, er varens buffertid dog lig med akkumuleringsperioden for lot.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Setup)(LookupHint=Page Manufacturing Setup - Control Default Dampener Period - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies low-level codes are dynamically assigned to each component in a product structure. Note that this may affect performance. The top final assembly level is denoted as level 0, the end item. The higher the low-level code number, the lower the item is in the hierarchy. The codes are used in the planning of component parts. When you calculate a plan, the BOM is exploded in the planning worksheet, and the gross requirements for level 0 are passed down the planning levels as gross requirements for the next planning level.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at laveste-niveau-koder tildeles dynamisk til hver komponent i en produktstruktur. Bemærk, at dette kan påvirke ydeevnen. Det højeste styklisteniveau angives som niveau 0, slutvaren. Jo højere laveste-niveau-kodenummer, jo lavere er varen i hierarkiet. Koderne bruges i planlægningen af komponentdele. Når du beregner en plan, udfoldes styklisten i planlægningskladden, og bruttobehovet for niveau 0 overføres ned i planlægningsniveauerne som bruttokrav til det næste planlægningsniveau.

trans-unit.source: Specifies a period of time during which you do not want the planning system to propose to reschedule existing supply orders forward. The dampener period limits the number of insignificant rescheduling of existing supply to a later date if that new date is within the dampener period. The dampener period function is only initiated if the supply can be rescheduled to a later date and not if the supply can be rescheduled to an earlier date. Accordingly, if the suggested new supply date is after the dampener period, then the rescheduling suggestion is not blocked. If the lot accumulation period is less than the dampener period, then the dampener period is dynamically set to equal the lot accumulation period. This is not shown in the value that you enter in the Dampener Period field. The last demand in the lot accumulation period is used to determine whether a potential supply date is in the dampener period. If this field is empty, then the value in the Default Dampener Period field in the Manufacturing Setup window applies. The value that you enter in the Dampener Period field must be a date formula, and one day (1D) is the shortest allowed period.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en tidsperiode, hvor planlægningsprogrammet ikke skal foreslå at omplanlægge eksisterende forsyningsordrer fremad. Bufferperioden begrænser antallet af ubetydelige omplanlægninger af eksisterende udbud til en senere dato, hvis den nye dato ligger inden for bufferperioden. Bufferperiodefunktionen initieres kun, hvis leveringen kan omplanlægges til en senere dato, og ikke hvis leveringen kan omplanlægges til en tidligere dato. Hvis den foreslåede nye forsyningsdato ligger efter bufferperioden, bliver omplanlægningsforslaget ikke spærret. Hvis akkumuleringsperioden for lot er mindre end bufferperioden, indstilles bufferperioden dynamisk til at svare til akkumuleringsperioden for lot. Dette vises ikke i den værdi, du angiver i feltet Bufferperiode. Den sidste efterspørgsel i akkumuleringsperioden for lot bruges til at bestemme, om en mulig forsyningsdato ligger i bufferperioden. Hvis feltet er tomt, anvendes værdien i feltet standardbufferperiode i vinduet Produktionsopsætning. Den værdi, du angiver i feltet Bufferperiode, skal være en datoformel, og én dag (1D) er den korteste tilladte periode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Item)(LookupHint=Page Item Card - Control Dampener Period - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Units per Parcel - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på det relaterede projekt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Job No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the item or resource's unit of measure, such as piece or hour.
trans-unit.target: Angiver navnet på varens eller ressourcens enhed, f.eks. styk eller time.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Unit of Measure - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a code for the location where you want the items to be placed when they are received.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en kode for den lokation, hvor varerne skal placeres efter modtagelse.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Location Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how each unit of the item or resource is measured, such as in pieces or hours. By default, the value in the Base Unit of Measure field on the item or resource card is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan hver enhed af varen eller ressourcen måles, f.eks. i enheder eller timer. Som standard indsættes værdien i feltet Basisenhed på kortet vare eller ressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Unit of Measure Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of units of the item, general ledger account, or item charge on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af enheder af varen, finanskontoen eller varegebyret på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the bin where the items are picked or put away.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den placering, hvor varerne plukkes eller lægges på lager.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Bin Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the net weight of one unit of the item. In the sales statistics window, the net weight on the line is included in the total net weight of all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nettovægten af én enhed af varen. I vinduet Salgsstatistik medtages nettovægten på linjen i den samlede nettovægt for alle linjer i det aktuelle salgsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Net Weight - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Net Weight - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item ledger entry that the document or journal line is applied to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den varepost, som dette dokument eller denne kladdelinje udlignes på.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Appl.-to Item Entry - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varianten af varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Variant Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the return receipt posted
trans-unit.target: Angiver en beskrivelse af den bogførte returvaremodtagelse.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity from the line that has been posted as received but that has not yet been posted as invoiced.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet fra den linje, der er bogført som modtaget, men som endnu ikke er bogført som faktureret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Return Qty. Rcd. Not Invd. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Item Reference No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the volume of one unit of the item. In the sales statistics window, the volume of one unit of the item on the line is included in the total volume of all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver mængden af én enhed af varen. I vinduet Salgsstatistik indgår mængden af én enhed af varen på linjen i den samlede mængde for alle linjer i det aktuelle salgsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Unit Volume - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies when items on the document are shipped or were shipped. A shipment date is usually calculated from a requested delivery date plus lead time.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvornår varerne på bilaget er sendt eller leveret. En afsendelsesdato beregnes normalt ud fra en ønsket leveringsdato plus leveringstiden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Shipment Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the involved entry or record, according to the specified number series.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den tilknyttede post eller record i overensstemmelse med den angivne nummerserie.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the gross weight of one unit of the item. In the sales statistics window, the gross weight on the line is included in the total gross weight of all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bruttovægten af en enhed af varen. I vinduet Salgsstatistik medtages bruttovægten på linjen i den samlede bruttovægt af alle linjer i det aktuelle salgsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Gross Weight - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Gross Weight - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies information in addition to the description.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Description 2 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item on the line have been posted as invoiced.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af den pågældende vare der allerede er blevet bogført som faktureret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Return Receipt Subform - Control Quantity Invoiced - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether this line is a billable line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om denne linje er en fakturerbar linje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Contract Line - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount amount that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det rabatbeløb, der ydes på varen, på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Line Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether the Usage Link field applies to the project planning line. When this check box is selected, usage entries are linked to the project planning line. Selecting this check box creates a link to the project planning line from places where usage has been posted, such as the project journal or a purchase line. You can select this check box only if the line type of the project planning line is Budget or Both Budget and Billable.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om feltet Anvendelseslink gælder for projektplanlægningslinjen. Når dette afkrydsningsfelt er markeret, knyttes forbrugsposter til projektplanlægningslinjen. Når du markerer dette afkrydsningsfelt, oprettes et link til projektplanlægningslinjen fra de områder, hvor forbruget er blevet bogført, f.eks. projektkladden eller en købslinje. Du kan kun markere dette afkrydsningsfelt, hvis projektplanlægningslinjens type er Budget eller Både budget og Fakturerbar.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Usage Link - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the lot number that is applied to the posted item if the planning line was created from the posting of a project journal line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det lotnummer, der er anvendt til den bogførte vare, hvis planlægningslinjen blev oprettet fra bogføringen af en projektkladdelinje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Lot No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of planning line.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Line Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount in the local currency that will be posted to the project ledger.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb i den lokale valuta, som vil blive bogført for projektposten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Remaining Line Amount (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price, in LCY, of one unit of the item or resource. You can enter a price manually or have it entered according to the Price/Profit Calculation field on the related card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver prisen for én enhed af varen eller ressourcen i RV. Du kan angive en pris manuelt eller få den angivet i henhold til feltet Avancepct.beregning på det dertilhørende kort.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Unit Price (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity of the item you have picked for the project planning line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af den vare, du har plukket for projektplanlægningslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Qty. Picked - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the entry number of the project planning line that the sales line is linked to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver løbenummeret på den projektplanlægningslinje, som salgslinjen er tilknyttet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Job Contract Entry No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of account to which the planning line relates.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den kontotype, som planlægningslinjen vedrører.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på det relaterede projekt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Job No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the entry type of the project ledger entry associated with the planning line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver projektfinanspostens type, som er knyttet til planlægningslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Ledger Entry Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the item's product type to link transactions made for this item with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varens produkttype for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne vare, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle bogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Gen. Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a location code for an item.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en lokationskode for en vare.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Location Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that an entry has been created by Business Central and is related to a project ledger entry. The check box is selected automatically.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at der er oprettet en post af Business Central, og at den er relateret til en projektpost. Afkrydsningsfeltet markeres automatisk.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control System-Created Entry - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity that remains to be invoiced. It is calculated as Quantity - Qty. Invoiced.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal, der mangler at blive faktureret. Det beregnes som Antal - Faktureret antal.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Qty. to Invoice - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how each unit of the item or resource is measured, such as in pieces or hours. By default, the value in the Base Unit of Measure field on the item or resource card is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan hver enhed af varen eller ressourcen måles, f.eks. i enheder eller timer. Som standard indsættes værdien i feltet Basisenhed på kortet vare eller ressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Unit of Measure Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount in the local currency that has been posted to the project ledger. This field is only filled in if the Apply Usage Link check box selected on the project card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb i den lokale valuta, der er bogført for projektposten. Dette felt udfyldes kun, hvis afkrydsningsfeltet Anvend anvendelseslink er markeret på projektkortet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Posted Line Amount (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity of the item that is reserved for the project planning line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal af varen, der er reserveret til projektplanlægningslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Reserved Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount percentage that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den rabatprocent, der tildeles varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Line Discount % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of units of the resource, item, or general ledger account that should be specified on the planning line. If you later change the No., the quantity you have entered remains on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af enheder for den ressource-, vare- eller finanskonto, der skal angives for planlægningsfilen. Hvis du senere ændrer nummeret, vil det angivne antal blive bevaret på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the ID of the user who posted the entry, to be used, for example, in the change log.
trans-unit.target: Angiver id'et for den bruger, der har bogført posten, der skal bruges, f.eks. i ændringsloggen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control User ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total price in the project currency on the planning line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den samlede pris i projektets valuta på planlægningslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Total Price - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the bin where the selected item will be put away or picked in warehouse and inventory processes. If you specify a bin code in the To-Project Bin Code field on the Location page, that bin will be suggested when you choose the location.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den placering, hvor den valgte vare vil blive lagt på lager eller plukkes på lagersted- og lagerprocesser. Hvis du angiver en placeringskode i feltet Til-projekt placeringskode på siden Lokation, foreslås denne placering, når du vælger lokationen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Bin Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining total cost (LCY) for the planning line. The amount is in the local currency.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det resterende kostbeløb i RV for planlægningslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Remaining Total Cost (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price of one unit of the item or resource. You can enter a price manually or have it entered according to the Price/Profit Calculation field on the related card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver prisen for én enhed af varen eller ressourcen. Du kan angive en pris manuelt eller få den angivet i henhold til feltet Avancepct.beregning på det dertilhørende kort.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Unit Price - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity you want to transfer to the sales invoice or credit memo. The value in this field is calculated as Quantity - Qty. Transferred to Invoice.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal, du vil overflytte til salgsfakturaen eller kreditnotaen. Værdien i dette felt beregnes som Antal - Antal overført til faktura.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Qty. to Transfer to Invoice - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total cost that has been posted to the project ledger, if the Usage Link check box has been selected.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det kostbeløb, der er bogført for projektposten, hvis afkrydsningsfeltet Anvendelseslink er markeret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Posted Total Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether or not a reservation can be made for items on the current line. The field is not applicable if the Type field is set to Resource, Cost, or G/L Account.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om der kan foretages reservation af varer på den aktuelle linje. Feltet er ikke relevant, hvis feltet Type er angivet til Ressource, Omkostning eller Finanskonto.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control ReserveName - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost, in the local currency, of one unit of the selected item or resource.
trans-unit.target: Angiver omkostningen i den lokale valuta for en enhed af den vare eller ressource, der er valgt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Direct Unit Cost (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining quantity of the resource, item, or G/L Account that remains to complete a project. The quantity is calculated as the difference between Quantity and Qty. Posted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det restantal for den ressource, vare eller finanskonto, hvor et projekt endnu ikke er fuldført. Antallet beregnes som differencen mellem Antal og Bogført antal.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Remaining Qty. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity expressed in the base units of measure.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Quantity (Base) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total price on the planning line. The total price is in the local currency.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den samlede pris på planlægningslinjen. Den samlede pris vises i den lokale valuta.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Total Price (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that is planned to deliver the item connected to the project planning line. For a resource, the planned delivery date is the date that the resource performs services with respect to the project.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, der er planlagt til levering af varen i forbindelse med projektplanlægningslinjen. For en ressource er den planlagte leveringsdato den dato, hvor ressourcen udfører servicer i forhold til projektet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Planned Delivery Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the entry number of the project ledger entry associated with the project planning line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver projektpostens nummer, som er knyttet til projektplanlægningslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Ledger Entry No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the planning line's entry number.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Line No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date of the planning line. You can use the planning date for filtering the totals of the project, for example, if you want to see the scheduled usage for a specific month of the year.
trans-unit.target: Angiver datoen for planlægningslinjen. Du kan bruge planlægningsdatoen til at filtrere summerne for projektet, f.eks. hvis du vil have vist det planlagte forbrug for en specifik måned i året.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Planning Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the method that will be used for price calculation in the item journal line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den metode, der skal bruges til priskalkulation på varekladdelinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Price Calculation Method - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varianten af varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Variant Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the resource, item, or G/L account to which this entry applies. You can change the description.
trans-unit.target: Angiver navnet på den ressource, vare eller finanskonto, som posten vedrører. Du kan ændre beskrivelsen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount in the local currency that will be posted to the project ledger.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb i den lokale valuta, som vil blive bogført for projektposten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Line Amount (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount that will be posted to the project ledger.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb, som vil blive bogført i projektfinansposterne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Line Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the base quantity of the item you have picked for the project planning line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver basis antallet af den vare, du har plukket for projektplanlægningslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Qty. Picked (Base) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies which work type the resource applies to. Prices are updated based on this entry.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvilken arbejdstype ressourcen udlignes med. Priserne opdateres ud fra denne post.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Work Type Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining total cost for the planning line. The total cost is in the project currency, which comes from the Currency Code field in the Project Card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det resterende kostbeløb for planlægningslinjen. Kostbeløbet er angivet i projektets valuta, som stammer fra feltet Valutakode på projektkortet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Remaining Total Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost of one unit of the item or resource on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver omkostningen, på én enhed af varen eller ressourcen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Unit Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total cost for the planning line. The total cost is in the project currency, which comes from the Currency Code field in the Project Card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kostbeløbet for planlægningslinjen. Kostbeløbet er angivet i projektets valuta, som hentes fra feltet Valutakode på projektkortet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Total Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount that will be posted to the project ledger.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb, som vil blive bogført i projektfinansposterne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Remaining Line Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that will be used to find the exchange rate for the currency in the Currency Date field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, der bruges til at finde valutakursen for valutaen i feltet Valutadato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Currency Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity that has been posted to the project ledger, if the Usage Link check box has been selected.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal, der er blevet bogført til projektposten, hvis afkrydsningsfeltet Anvendelseslink er markeret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Archive Lines - Control Qty. Posted - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total cost for the planning line. The amount is in the local currency.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kostbeløbet for planlægningslinjen. Beløbet er anført i den lokale valuta.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the account to which the resource, item or general ledger account is posted, depending on your selection in the Type field.

trans-unit.source: Specifies how consumption of the item (component) is calculated and handled in production processes. Manual: Enter and post consumption in the consumption journal manually. Forward: Automatically posts consumption according to the production order component lines when the first operation starts. Backward: Automatically calculates and posts consumption according to the production order component lines when the production order is finished. Pick + Forward / Pick + Backward: Variations with warehousing.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan forbruget af varen (komponenten) beregnes og håndteres i produktionsprocesserne. Manuelt: Angiv og bogfør forbrug i forbrugskladden manuelt. Fremad: Bogfører automatisk forbrug ifølge produktionsordrekomponentlinjerne, når den første handling starter. Baglæns: Beregner og bogfører automatisk forbrug ifølge produktionsordrekomponentlinjerne, når produktionsordren er færdig. Pluk + Fremad / Pluk + Baglæns: Variationer med lagersted.

trans-unit.source: Specifies a window to reconcile unpaid documents automatically with their related bank transactions by importing a bank statement feed or file. In the payment reconciliation journal, incoming or outgoing payments on your bank are automatically, or semi-automatically, applied to their related open customer or vendor ledger entries. Any open bank account ledger entries related to the applied customer or vendor ledger entries will be closed when you choose the Post Payments and Reconcile Bank Account action. This means that the bank account is automatically reconciled for payments that you post with the journal.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et tidsrum for afstemning af ubetalte bilag automatisk med deres relaterede banktransaktioner ved at importere et bankkontoudtog eller en fil. I betalingsudligningskladden udlignes indgående eller udgående betalinger for din bank automatisk eller delvist automatisk med deres relaterede åbne debitor- eller kreditorposter. Alle åbne bankkontoposter i forhold til de udlignede debitor- eller kreditorposter bliver lukket, når du vælger handlingen Bogfør betalinger og Afstem bankkontoen. Det betyder, at bankkontoen automatisk afstemmes for de betalinger, som du bogfører med kladden.
