trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Source Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 7, which is one of dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 7, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Shortcut Dimension 7 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total of the ledger entries that represent debits.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det samlede antal poster, der repræsenterer debiteringer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Debit Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a reference to a combination of dimension values. The actual values are stored in the Dimension Set Entry table.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en reference til en kombination af dimensionsværdier. De faktiske værdier gemmes i tabellen Dimensionsgruppepost.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Dimension Set ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the entry.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Description - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Posting Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether the entry has been part of a reverse transaction (correction) made by the Reverse function.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om posten er indgået i en tilbageføringstransaktion (rettelse) foretaget med funktionen Tilbagefør.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Reversed - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the posting date of the related fixed asset transaction, such as a depreciation.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bogføringsdatoen for den relaterede transaktion for anlægsaktiver, f.eks. afskrivning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control FA Posting Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 5, which is one of dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 5, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Shortcut Dimension 5 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 6, which is one of dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 6, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Shortcut Dimension 6 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of depreciation days that were used for calculating depreciation for the fixed asset entry.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal afskrivningsdage, som blev benyttet til beregning af afskrivningen på anlægsposten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control No. of Depreciation Days - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number on the entry.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Document No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the entry amount in currency.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 3, which is one of dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 3, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Shortcut Dimension 3 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 8, which is one of dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 8, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Shortcut Dimension 8 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of account that a balancing entry is posted to, such as BANK for a cash account.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den kontotype, som en udlignende post bogføres til, f.eks. BANK for en kassekonto.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page FA Ledger Entries Preview - Control Bal. Account Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 2, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 2, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Shortcut Dimension 2 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Incl. VAT field on all lines in the document minus any discount amount in the Invoice Discount Amount field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver summen af værdien i feltet Linjebeløb inkl. moms på alle linjer i bilaget minus eventuelle rabatbeløb i feltet Fakturarabatbeløb.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Total Amount Incl. VAT - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Total Amount Incl. VAT - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the line discount percentage of the project ledger entry that is related to the purchase line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver linjerabatprocentdelen for den projektfinanspost, der er relateret til købslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Job Line Discount % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount amount that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det rabatbeløb, der ydes på varen, på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Line Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the IC partner. If the line is being sent to one of your intercompany partners, this field is used together with the IC Partner Ref. Type field to indicate the item or account in your partner's company that corresponds to the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den koncernspecifikke partner. Hvis denne linje sendes til en af dine koncerninterne partnere, bruges dette felt sammen med feltet Ref.type for IC-partner for at angive den vare eller den konto i partnerens regnskab, der svarer til linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control IC Partner Reference - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the intercompany partner that the transaction is related to if the entry was created from an intercompany transaction.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den koncerninterne partner, som transaktionen er relateret til, hvis posten blev oprettet fra en koncernintern transaktion.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control IC Partner Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code explaining why the item was returned.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den kode, der forklarer, hvorfor varen blev returneret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Return Reason Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 1, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 1, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Shortcut Dimension 1 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of units per parcel of the item. In the purchase statistics window, the number of units per parcel on the line helps to determine the total number of units for all the lines for the particular purchase document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af enheder pr. kolli af varen. I vinduet Købsstatistik kan du bruge antallet af enheder pr. kolli til at fastlægge det samlede antal enheder for alle linjer i det aktuelle købsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Units per Parcel - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies an insurance number if you have selected the Acquisition Cost option in the FA Posting Type field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et forsikringsnummer, hvis du har valgt indstillingen Anskaffelsespris i feltet Anlægsbogføringstype.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Insurance No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of VAT amounts on all lines in the document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver summen af momsbeløb på alle linjer i bilaget.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Total VAT Amount - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Total VAT Amount - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price for one unit of the item.
trans-unit.target: Angiver pris for en enhed af varen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Unit Price (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the vendor's VAT specification to link transactions made for this vendor with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kreditorens momsspecifikation for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne kreditoren, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle momsbogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control VAT Bus. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the FA posting type if you have selected Fixed Asset in the Type field for this line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver anlægsbogføringstypen, hvis du har valgt Anlægsaktiv i feltet Type for denne linje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control FA Posting Type - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project. If you fill in this field and the Project Task No. field, then a project ledger entry will be posted together with the purchase line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på det relaterede projekt. Hvis du udfylder dette felt og feltet Projektopgavenr., bogføres der en projektfinanspost sammen med købslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Job No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the unit of measure for the item, such as 1 bottle or 1 piece.
trans-unit.target: Angiver enhedsbetegnelsen for varen, f.eks. 1 flaske eller 1 stk.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Unit of Measure - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that this item is a catalog item.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at varen er en katalogvare.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Nonstock - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of a fixed asset with the Budgeted Asset check box selected. When you post the journal or document line, an additional entry is created for the budgeted fixed asset where the amount has the opposite sign.
trans-unit.target: Angivet nummeret for et anlægsaktiv, hvor afkrydsningsfeltet Budgetanlæg er markeret. Når du bogfører kladde- eller bilagslinje, oprettes en ekstra post for det budgetterede anlægsaktiv, hvor beløbet har det modsatte fortegn.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Budgeted FA No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the gross amount of the line, in the local currency.
trans-unit.target: Angiver linjens bruttobeløb angivet i den lokale valuta.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Job Total Price (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the item's product type to link transactions made for this item with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varens produkttype for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne vare, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle bogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Gen. Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the location where the items on the line will be located.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den lokation, hvor varerne på linjen bliver placeret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Location Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item charge will be assigned to the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af varegebyret bliver tildelt linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Qty. to Assign - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the depreciation book to which the line will be posted if you have selected Fixed Asset in the Type field for this line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den afskrivningsprofil, linjen skal bogføres til, hvis du har valgt Anlægsaktiv i feltet Type for denne linje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Depreciation Book Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT product posting group. Links business transactions made for the item, resource, or G/L account with the general ledger, to account for VAT amounts resulting from trade with that record.
trans-unit.target: Angiver momsproduktbogføringsgruppen. Knytter forretningstransaktioner for varen, ressourcen eller finanskontoen til finansregnskabet for at gøre rede for momsbeløbet som følge af handlen med den pågældende record.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control VAT Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how each unit of the item or resource is measured, such as in pieces or hours. By default, the value in the Base Unit of Measure field on the item or resource card is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan hver enhed af varen eller ressourcen måles, f.eks. i enheder eller timer. Som standard indsættes værdien i feltet Basisenhed på kortet vare eller ressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Unit of Measure Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of planning line that was created when the project ledger entry is posted from the purchase line. If the field is empty, no planning lines were created for this entry.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvilken type planlægningslinje, der blev oprettet, da projektfinansposten blev bogført fra købslinjen. Hvis feltet er tomt, er der ikke oprettet planlægningslinjer for denne post.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Job Line Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tax group that is used to calculate and post sales tax.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den skattegruppe, der bruges til at beregne og bogføre salgsmoms.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Tax Group Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Excl. VAT field on all lines in the document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver summen af værdien i feltet Linjebeløb ekskl. moms på alle linjer i bilaget.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control AmountBeforeDiscount - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control AmountBeforeDiscount - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how much of the item charge that has been assigned.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor meget af varegebyret som er blevet tildelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Qty. Assigned - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount percentage that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den rabatprocent, der tildeles varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Line Discount % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of units of the item specified on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af varen der skal angives på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of transaction that will be posted with the document line. If you select Comment, then you can enter any text in the Description field, such as a message to a customer.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den transaktionstype, der vil blive bogført med bilagslinjen. Hvis du vælger Bemærkning, kan du skrive hvad som helst i feltet Beskrivelse, f.eks. en besked til en debitor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a discount percentage that is applied to the invoice, based on purchase lines where the Allow Invoice Disc. field is selected. The percentage and criteria are defined in the Vendor Invoice Discounts page, but you can enter or change the percentage manually.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en rabatprocent, der er knyttet til fakturaen, baseret på købslinjer, hvor feltet Tillad fakturarabat er markeret. Procenten og kriterierne defineres på siden kreditorfakturarabatter, men du kan indsætte eller ændre procentdelen manuelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Invoice Disc. Pct. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Invoice Disc. Pct. - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the bin where the items are picked or put away.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den placering, hvor varerne plukkes eller lægges på lager.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Bin Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tax area that is used to calculate and post sales tax.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det skatteområde, der bruges til at beregne og bogføre salgsmoms.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Tax Area Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the net weight of one unit of the item. In the purchase statistics window, the net weight on the line is included in the total net weight of all the lines for the particular purchase document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nettovægten af én enhed af varen. I vinduet Købsstatistik medtages nettovægten på linjen i den samlede nettovægt for alle linjer i det aktuelle købsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Net Weight - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Net Weight - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a discount amount that is deducted from the value of the Total Incl. VAT field, based on purchase lines where the Allow Invoice Disc. field is selected. You can enter or change the amount manually.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et rabatbeløb, der trækkes fra værdien i feltet I alt inkl. moms baseret på købslinjer, hvor feltet Tillad fakturarabat er markeret. Du kan indsætte eller ændre beløbet manuelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Invoice Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Invoice Discount Amount - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the purchase is subject to use tax. Use tax is a sales tax that is paid on items that are purchased by a company and are used by that company instead of being sold to a customer.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at købet er omfattet af forbrugsafgift. Forbrugsafgift er moms, der betales for varer, som købes af en virksomhed og bruges af virksomheden i stedet for blive solgt til en debitor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Use Tax - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the invoice line is included when the invoice discount is calculated.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om fakturalinjen bliver medtaget, når fakturarabatten beregnes.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Allow Invoice Disc. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item ledger entry that the document or journal line is applied -to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret af den varepost, som dette bilag eller denne kladdelinje udlignes på.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Appl.-to Item Entry - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the blanket order that the record originates from.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den rammeordre, hvorfra recorden stammer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Blanket Order No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the percentage of the item's last purchase cost that includes indirect costs, such as freight that is associated with the purchase of the item.
trans-unit.target: Angiver procentdelen af varens sidste købspris, der omfatter indirekte omkostninger, såsom fragt, der er knyttet til købet af varen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Indirect Cost % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the line discount amount of the project ledger entry that is related to the purchase line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver linjerabatbeløbet for den projektfinanspost, der er relateret til købslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Job Line Disc. Amount (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if depreciation was calculated until the FA posting date of the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om afskrivningen er beregnet op til linjens anlægsbogføringsdato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Depr. until FA Posting Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sales price per unit that applies to the item or general ledger expense that will be posted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver salgsprisen pr. enhed, der gælder for den vare eller finansudgift, der bogføres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Job Unit Price (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varianten af varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Variant Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the entry of the product to be purchased. To add a non-transactional text line, fill in the Description field only.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en beskrivelse af posten for det produkt, der skal købes. Hvis du vil tilføje en ikke-transaktionsbaseret tekstlinje, skal du kun udfylde feltet Beskrivelse.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if, when this line was posted, the additional acquisition cost posted on the line was depreciated in proportion to the amount by which the fixed asset had already been depreciated.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om den ekstra anskaffelsespris, der er bogført på linjen, blev afskrevet (da denne linje blev bogført) i forhold til det beløb, som anlægget allerede var afskrevet med.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Depr. Acquisition Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the allocation account number that will be used to distribute the amounts during the posting process.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det allokeringskontonummer, der skal bruges til at fordele beløbene under bogføringsprocessen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Cr. Memo Subform - Control Allocation Account No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Job Contract Entry No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of account to which the planning line relates.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den kontotype, som planlægningslinjen vedrører.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på det relaterede projekt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Job No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the location from where inventory items to the customer on the sales document are to be shipped by default.
trans-unit.target: Angiver placeringen, hvorfra lagervarer til debitoren på salgsbilaget skal sendes som standard.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Location Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity that remains to be invoiced. It is calculated as Quantity - Qty. Invoiced.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal, der mangler at blive faktureret. Det beregnes som Antal - Faktureret antal.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Qty. to Invoice - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how each unit of the item or resource is measured, such as in pieces or hours. By default, the value in the Base Unit of Measure field on the item or resource card is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan hver enhed af varen eller ressourcen måles, f.eks. i enheder eller timer. Som standard indsættes værdien i feltet Basisenhed på kortet vare eller ressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Unit of Measure Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount in the local currency that has been posted to the project ledger. This field is only filled in if the Apply Usage Link check box selected on the project card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb i den lokale valuta, der er bogført for projektposten. Dette felt udfyldes kun, hvis afkrydsningsfeltet Anvend anvendelseslink er markeret på projektkortet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Posted Line Amount (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity of the item that is reserved for the project planning line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal af varen, der er reserveret til projektplanlægningslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Reserved Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity that been posted through a sales invoice.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal, der er blevet bogført gennem en salgsfaktura.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Qty. Invoiced - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount percentage that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den rabatprocent, der tildeles varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Line Discount % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of item units, resource hours, general ledger account payments, or cost that have been shipped to the customer.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af vareenheder, ressourcetimer, finanskontobetalinger eller omkostninger, der er leveret til debitoren.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total price in the project currency on the planning line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den samlede pris i projektets valuta på planlægningslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Total Price - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the bin where the selected item will be put away or picked in warehouse and inventory processes. If you specify a bin code in the To-Project Bin Code field on the Location page, that bin will be suggested when you choose the location.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den placering, hvor den valgte vare vil blive lagt på lager eller plukkes på lagersted- og lagerprocesser. Hvis du angiver en placeringskode i feltet Til-projekt placeringskode på siden Lokation, foreslås denne placering, når du vælger lokationen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Bin Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining total cost (LCY) for the planning line. The amount is in the local currency.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det resterende kostbeløb i RV for planlægningslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Remaining Total Cost (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price of one unit of the item or resource. You can enter a price manually or have it entered according to the Price/Profit Calculation field on the related card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver prisen for én enhed af varen eller ressourcen. Du kan angive en pris manuelt eller få den angivet i henhold til feltet Avancepct.beregning på det dertilhørende kort.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Unit Price - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity you want to transfer to the sales invoice or credit memo. The value in this field is calculated as Quantity - Qty. Transferred to Invoice.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal, du vil overflytte til salgsfakturaen eller kreditnotaen. Værdien i dette felt beregnes som Antal - Antal overført til faktura.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Qty. to Transfer to Invoice - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total cost that has been posted to the project ledger, if the Usage Link check box has been selected.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det kostbeløb, der er bogført for projektposten, hvis afkrydsningsfeltet Anvendelseslink er markeret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Posted Total Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost, in the local currency, of one unit of the selected item or resource.
trans-unit.target: Angiver omkostningen i den lokale valuta for en enhed af den vare eller ressource, der er valgt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Direct Unit Cost (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining quantity of the resource, item, or G/L Account that remains to complete a project. The quantity is calculated as the difference between Quantity and Qty. Posted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det restantal for den ressource, vare eller finanskonto, hvor et projekt endnu ikke er fuldført. Antallet beregnes som differencen mellem Antal og Bogført antal.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Remaining Qty. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity expressed in the base units of measure.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Quantity (Base) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total price on the planning line. The total price is in the local currency.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den samlede pris på planlægningslinjen. Den samlede pris vises i den lokale valuta.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Total Price (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that is planned to deliver the item connected to the project planning line. For a resource, the planned delivery date is the date that the resource performs services with respect to the project.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, der er planlagt til levering af varen i forbindelse med projektplanlægningslinjen. For en ressource er den planlagte leveringsdato den dato, hvor ressourcen udfører servicer i forhold til projektet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Planned Delivery Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the project planning line quantity that you want to supply by assembly.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af antallet af projektplanlægningslinjer, som du vil forsyne via montage.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Qty. to Assemble - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the planning line's entry number.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Line No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date of the planning line. You can use the planning date for filtering the totals of the project, for example, if you want to see the scheduled usage for a specific month of the year.
trans-unit.target: Angiver datoen for planlægningslinjen. Du kan bruge planlægningsdatoen til at filtrere summerne for projektet, f.eks. hvis du vil have vist det planlagte forbrug for en specifik måned i året.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Planning Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varianten af varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Variant Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of project planning line.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount in the local currency that will be posted to the project ledger.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb i den lokale valuta, som vil blive bogført for projektposten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Line Amount (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount that will be posted to the project ledger.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb, som vil blive bogført i projektfinansposterne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Line Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining total cost for the planning line. The total cost is in the project currency, which comes from the Currency Code field in the Project Card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det resterende kostbeløb for planlægningslinjen. Kostbeløbet er angivet i projektets valuta, som stammer fra feltet Valutakode på projektkortet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Remaining Total Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies, in local currency, the sales amount that was invoiced for this planning line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det salgsbeløb i den lokale valuta, som blev faktureret for denne planlægningslinje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Invoiced Amount (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost of one unit of the item or resource on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver omkostningen, på én enhed af varen eller ressourcen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Unit Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total cost for the planning line. The total cost is in the project currency, which comes from the Currency Code field in the Project Card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kostbeløbet for planlægningslinjen. Kostbeløbet er angivet i projektets valuta, som hentes fra feltet Valutakode på projektkortet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Total Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount that will be posted to the project ledger.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb, som vil blive bogført i projektfinansposterne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Remaining Line Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity that has been posted to the project ledger, if the Usage Link check box has been selected.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal, der er blevet bogført til projektposten, hvis afkrydsningsfeltet Anvendelseslink er markeret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Qty. Posted - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total cost for the planning line. The amount is in the local currency.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kostbeløbet for planlægningslinjen. Beløbet er anført i den lokale valuta.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Total Cost (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the currency that is used on the entry.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den valuta, der er brugt i posten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Currency Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the account to which the resource, item or general ledger account is posted, depending on your selection in the Type field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den konto, som ressourcen, varen eller finanskontoen er bogført på, afhængigt af hvad du har valgt i feltet Type.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the serial number that is applied to the posted item if the planning line was created from the posting of a project journal line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det serienummer, der er anvendt til den bogførte vare, hvis planlægningslinjen blev oprettet fra bogføringen af en projektkladdelinje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Serial No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies information in addition to the description.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Description 2 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a document number for the planning line.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Document No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project task.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den relaterede projektopgave.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Job Task No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total cost (LCY) that has been posted to the project ledger, if the Usage Link check box has been selected.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det kostbeløb (RV), der er bogført for projektposten, hvis afkrydsningsfeltet Anvendelseslink er markeret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Posted Total Cost (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount that has been posted to the project ledger. This field is only filled in if the Apply Usage Link check box selected on the project card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb, der er bogført for projektfinansposten. Dette felt udfyldes kun, hvis afkrydsningsfeltet Anvend anvendelseslink er markeret på projektkortet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Posted Line Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost, in LCY, of one unit of the item or resource on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver omkostningen, i RV, på én enhed af varen eller ressourcen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Get Job Planning Lines - Control Unit Cost (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code you want to assign to this tax group.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den kode, der skal bruges til denne skattegruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.SalesTax)(LookupHint=Page Tax Groups - Control Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the description of the tax group. For example, if the tax group code is ALCOHOL, you could enter the description Alcoholic beverages.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en beskrivelse af skattegruppen. Hvis skattegruppekoden f.eks. er ALKOHOL, kan du skrive Alkoholiske drikke.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.SalesTax)(LookupHint=Page Tax Groups - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the address for the remit-to code.
trans-unit.target: Angiver adressen på overførsel til koden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Remit-to Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the correcting entry that replaced the original entry in the reverse transaction.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den korrigerende post, der erstattede den oprindelige post i den tilbageførte transaktion.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Reversed by Entry No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount of the original entry.
trans-unit.target: Angiver beløbet for den oprindelige post.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Original Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount that you can obtain if the entry is applied to before the payment discount date.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den rabat, som du kan opnå, hvis posten bliver udlignet inden kontantrabatdatoen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Original Pmt. Disc. Possible - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the bank account to transfer the amount to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den bankkonto, som beløbet skal overføres til.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control RecipientBankAcc - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the global dimension that is linked to the record or entry for analysis purposes. Two global dimensions, typically for the company's most important activities, are available on all cards, documents, reports, and lists.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den globale dimension, der er knyttet til recorden eller posten med henblik på analyse. To globale dimensioner, typiske for virksomhedens vigtigste aktiviteter, er tilgængelige på alle kort, bilag, rapporter og lister.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Global Dimension 1 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the intercompany partner that the transaction is related to if the entry was created from an intercompany transaction.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den koncerninterne partner, som transaktionen er relateret til, hvis posten blev oprettet fra en koncernintern transaktion.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control IC Partner Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the global dimension that is linked to the record or entry for analysis purposes. Two global dimensions, typically for the company's most important activities, are available on all cards, documents, reports, and lists.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den globale dimension, der er knyttet til recorden eller posten med henblik på analyse. To globale dimensioner, typiske for virksomhedens vigtigste aktiviteter, er tilgængelige på alle kort, bilag, rapporter og lister.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Global Dimension 2 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a document number that refers to the customer's or vendor's numbering system.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et bilagsnummer, som bliver brugt i debitors eller kreditors nummereringssystem.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control External Document No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the vendor account that the entry is linked to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den kreditorkonto, som posten er tilknyttet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Vendor No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the running balance in LCY.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den løbende saldo i RV.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control RunningBalanceLCY - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control RunningBalanceLCY - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date at which the vendor ledger entry was closed.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor kreditorposten blev lukket.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Closed at Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date on which the amount in the entry must be paid for a payment discount to be granted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor beløbet i posten skal være betalt, for at der kan opnås kontantrabat.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Pmt. Discount Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining payment discount which can be received if the payment is made before the payment discount date.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den tilbageværende kontantrabat, som kan opnås, hvis betalingen finder sted inden forfaldsdatoen for kontantrabatten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Remaining Pmt. Disc. Possible - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount that remains to be applied to before the entry is totally applied to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb, som mangler at blive udlignet, inden posten udlignes fuldstændigt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Remaining Amt. (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date when the vendor's invoice was received.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor kreditorens faktura blev modtaget.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Invoice Received Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the general ledger, customer, vendor, or bank account that the balancing entry is posted to, such as a cash account for cash purchases.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det finanskonto-, debitor-, kreditor- eller bankkontonummer, som udligningsposten bogføres til, f.eks. en kassekonto ved kontantkøb.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Bal. Account No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the reason code, a supplementary source code that enables you to trace the entry.
trans-unit.target: Angiver årsagskoden som et supplerende kildespor, der hjælper til at spore posten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Reason Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the maximum tolerated amount the entry can differ from the amount on the invoice or credit memo.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det maksimalt tilladte beløb, som posten kan afvige fra det beløb, der er angivet på fakturaen eller kreditnotaen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Max. Payment Tolerance - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the original entry that was undone by the reverse transaction.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den oprindelige post, der blev annulleret ved tilbageførselstransaktionen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Reversed Entry No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document type that the vendor entry belongs to.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Document Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the entry was created as a result of exporting a payment journal line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at posten blev oprettet ved eksport af en betalingskladdelinje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Exported to Payment File - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total of the ledger entries that represent credits.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det samlede antal poster, der repræsenterer krediteringer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Credit Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount that the entry originally consisted of, in LCY.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beløb, posten oprindeligt bestod af, i RV.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Original Amt. (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the ID of the user who posted the entry, to be used, for example, in the change log.
trans-unit.target: Angiver id'et for den bruger, der har bogført posten, der skal bruges, f.eks. i ændringsloggen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control User ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 4, which is one of dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 4, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Payables)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Ledger Entries - Control Shortcut Dimension 4 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the source code that specifies where the entry was created.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date when the item is planned to arrive in inventory. Forward calculation: planned receipt date = order date + vendor lead time (per the vendor calendar and rounded to the next working day in first the vendor calendar and then the location calendar). If no vendor calendar exists, then: planned receipt date = order date + vendor lead time (per the location calendar). Backward calculation: order date = planned receipt date - vendor lead time (per the vendor calendar and rounded to the previous working day in first the vendor calendar and then the location calendar). If no vendor calendar exists, then: order date = planned receipt date - vendor lead time (per the location calendar).
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor varen skal ankomme på lageret. Forlæns beregning: planlagt modtagelsesdato = ordredato + kreditors leveringstid (ifølge kreditorens kalender og afrundet til næste arbejdsdag først i kreditorens kalender og derefter lokationens kalender). Hvis der ingen kalender findes hos kreditoren: planlagt modtagelsesdato = ordredato + kreditors leveringstid (ifølge lokationens kalender). Baglæns beregning: ordredato = planlagt modtagelsesdato - kreditors leveringstid (ifølge kreditorens kalender og afrundet til den forrige arbejdsdag først i kreditorens kalender og derefter lokationens kalender). Hvis der ingen kalender findes hos kreditoren: ordredato = planlagt modtagelsesdato - kreditors leveringstid (ifølge lokations kalender).
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Purch Return Order Arc Subform - Control Planned Receipt Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the purpose of the account. Total: Used to total a series of balances on accounts from many different account groupings. To use Total, leave this field blank. Begin-Total: A marker for the beginning of a series of accounts to be totaled that ends with an End-Total account. End-Total: A total of a series of accounts that starts with the preceding Begin-Total account. The total is defined in the Totaling field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver formålet med kontoen. I alt: Bruges til at sammentælle en række saldi på konti fra mange forskellige grupper. Lad feltet stå tomt, hvis du vil bruge I alt. Fra-Sum: En markering af begyndelsen af en række konti, der skal sammentælles og slutter med en Til-sum-konto. Til-sum: Det samlede antal konti, der starter med den foregående Fra-sum-konto. On the Actions tab, in the Question group, choose Update Questions to auto populate the question list based on the fields in the table on which the question area is based. You can modify the text to be more meaningful to the person responsible for filling out the questionnaire. For example, you could rewrite the Name? question as What is the name of your company?

trans-unit.source: This feature utilizes Power Automate. By continuing you are affirming that you understand that the data handling and compliance standards of Power Automate may not be the same as those provided by Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. If you want to use Power Automate, you need to agree to its Privacy Notice. Otherwise, the change of environment has no effect.

Hvis du fortsætter, bekræfter du, at du forstår, at databehandlings- og overholdelsesstandarden for Power Automate ikke er de samme som dem, der er angivet af Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Hvis du vil bruge Power Automate, skal du acceptere den tilhørende meddelelse om beskyttelse af personlige oplysninger. Ellers har miljøændringen ingen effekt.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the original document you received from the vendor. You can require the document number for posting, or let it be optional. By default, it's required, so that this document references the original. Making document numbers optional removes a step from the posting process. For example, if you attach the original invoice as a PDF, you might not need to enter the document number. To specify whether document numbers are required, in the Purchases & Payables Setup window, select or clear the Ext. Doc. No. Mandatory field.

Det er påkrævet som standard, så dette bilag refererer til originalen. Det fjerner et trin fra bogføringsprocessen at gøre bilagsnumre valgfri. Hvis du f.eks. vedhæfter den oprindelige faktura som en PDF-fil, behøver du måske ikke at angive bilagsnummeret. I vinduet Købsopsætning kan du vælge, om bilagsnumre er påkrævet ved at vælge eller rydde markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet Eksternt bilagsnr. obl.

(Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Done - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Power BI is a collection of software services, apps, and connectors that work together to turn your unrelated sources of data into coherent, visually immersive, and interactive insights.
trans-unit.target: Power BI er en samling softwareservices, apps og forbindelser, der arbejder sammen om at omdanne dine ikke-relaterede datakilder til sammenhængende, visuelt moderne og interaktive indsigter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para0.1.1 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Now you are ready to display your Power BI reports inside Business Central.
trans-unit.target: Du er nu klar til at få vist dine Power BI-rapporter inde i Business Central.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para4.1.1 - Property InstructionalText)
(Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para4.1.1 - Property Caption)

(Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control EmptySpace4 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Welcome to Power BI Report Setup
trans-unit.target: Velkommen til konfiguration af Power BI-rapport
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para0.1 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: To display Power BI reports inside Business Central on-premises, you'll first need a registered application for Business Central in Microsoft Entra ID.
trans-unit.target: Hvis du vil have vist Power BI-rapporter Business Central i det lokale miljø, skal du først bruge en registreret applikation til Business Central i Microsoft Entra ID.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para1.1.1 - Property Caption)
(Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Step2 - Property Caption)
(Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control EmptySpace3 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: To set up your reports correctly, we need to ensure that you have a license for Power BI. If you don't have a license yet, you can get one at the following link.
trans-unit.target: Hvis du vil konfigurere rapporter korrekt, skal du sikre dig, at du har en licens til Power BI. Hvis du ikke har en licens endnu, kan du få én på følgende link.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para2.1.1 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Business Central will now upload a demo report for you to Power BI. This will take a few minutes, so we will do it in the background.
trans-unit.target: Business Central vil nu sende en demorapport for dig til Power BI. Det tager et par minutter, så vi gør det i baggrunden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para3.1.1 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: This setup helps you configure Business Central to display your existing Power BI reports inside various pages that include a Power BI report part.
trans-unit.target: Denne konfiguration hjælper dig med at konfigurere Business Central til at vise dine eksisterende Power BI-rapporter på forskellige sider, der indeholder en Power BI-rapportdel.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para0.1.2 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Choose Finish to close this setup.
trans-unit.target: Vælg Udfør for at lukke denne konfiguration.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para4.1.3 - Property InstructionalText)
(Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para4.1.3 - Property Caption)
(Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Step1 - Property Caption)
(Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Intro - Property Caption)
(Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para2.1 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: This feature utilizes Microsoft Power BI. By continuing you are affirming that you understand that the data handling and compliance standards of Microsoft Power BI may not be the same as those provided by Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Please consult the documentation for Power BI to learn more.
trans-unit.target: Denne funktion udnytter Microsoft Power BI. Hvis du fortsætter, bekræfter du, at det er muligt at forstå, at databehandlings- og overholdelsesstandarderne i Microsoft Power BI ikke er de samme som i Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Yderligere oplysninger finder du i dokumentationen til Power BI.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para2.1.4 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Some list pages, such as Items and Customers, allow you to display Power BI reports in the FactBox pane. Personalize the FactBox pane on these pages to show the Power BI Report part. Then, choose the reports you want to display.
trans-unit.target: Nogle listesider, f.eks. Varer og Kunder, giver dig mulighed for at få vist Power BI-rapporter i faktaboksruden. Tilpas faktaboksruden på disse sider for at få vist Power BI-rapportdelen. Vælg derefter de rapporter, du vil have vist.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para4.1.4 - Property InstructionalText)
(Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para4.1.4 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: If you already have a license for Power BI, choose Next to go to the next step.
trans-unit.target: Hvis du allerede har en licens til Power BI, skal du vælge Næste for at gå til næste trin.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para2.1.3 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: While we upload the report, you can continue your work, and even start using Power BI in Business Central. When the upload has completed, the new report will be available for displaying on pages.
trans-unit.target: Mens vi uploader rapporten, kan du fortsætte dit arbejde og også begynde at bruge Power BI i Business Central. Når uploaden er fuldført, kan den nye rapport vises på siderne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para3.1.2 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Once an Microsoft Entra application has been registered, you're ready to continue with this setup. During setup, you'll provide information about the Microsoft Entra application. Choose Next to continue.
trans-unit.target: Når en Microsoft Entra-applikation er registreret, er du klar til at fortsætte med denne opsætning. Under opsætningen giver du oplysninger om Microsoft Entra-applikationen. Vælg Næste for at fortsætte.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para1.1.2 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Choose Next to start uploading the demo report.
trans-unit.target: Vælg Næste for at starte uploaden af demorapporten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para3.1.3 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.target: Opret forbindelse med Microsoft Entra ID
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Integration.PowerBI)(LookupHint=Page Power BI Embed Setup Wizard - Control Para1.1 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Your demo report is being uploaded, and you will see it in your Power BI workspace shortly.
trans-unit.target: Din demorapport er ved at blive uploadet, og den vises snart i dit Power BI-arbejdsområde.

trans-unit.target: Angiver det refererede varenummer. Hvis du indtaster en reference mellem dit og din kreditors og debitors varenummer, vil dette nummer tilsidesætte standardvarenummeret, når du angiver referencenummeret på et salgs- eller købsbilag.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number assigned to the contact in the Customer, Vendor, or Bank Account table. This field is only valid for contacts recorded as customer, vendor or bank accounts.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det nummer, som er tildelt til kontakten i tabellen Debitor, Kreditor eller Bankkonto. Feltet er kun relevant for kontakter, der er registreret som debitorer, kreditorer eller bankkonti.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.BusinessRelation)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Link - Control No. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.BusinessRelation)(LookupHint=Page Vendor Link - Control No. - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a url address. Use this field to provide a url address to a location that Specifies information about the question. For example, you could provide the address of a page that Specifies information about setup considerations that the person answering the questionnaire should consider.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en url-adresse. Brug dette felt til at anføre en url-adresse til en placering, der angiver oplysninger om spørgsmålet. Du kunne f.eks. anføre adressen på en side, som angiver oplysninger om konfigurationsovervejelser, som den person, der besvarer spørgeskemaet, skal overveje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Config. Question Subform - Control Reference - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a question that is to be answered on the setup questionnaire. On the Actions tab, in the Question group, choose Update Questions to auto populate the question list based on the fields in the table on which the question area is based. You can modify the text to be more meaningful to the person responsible for filling out the questionnaire. For example, you could rewrite the Name? question as What is the name of your company?
trans-unit.target: Angiver et spørgsmål, som skal besvares på konfigurationsspørgeskemaet. Under fanen Handlinger i gruppen Spørgsmål skal du vælge Opdater spørgsmål for automatisk at udfylde spørgsmålslisten baseret på felterne i den tabel, som spørgsmålsområdet er baseret på. Du kan redigere teksten, så den bliver mere meningsfuld for den person, der har ansvaret for at udfylde spørgeskemaet. Du kunne f.eks. omskrive spørgsmålet Navn? til Hvad hedder din virksomhed?
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Config. Question Subform - Control Question - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the answer to the question. The answer to the question should match the format of the answer option and must be a value that the database supports. If it does not, then there will be an error when you apply the answer.
trans-unit.target: Angiver svaret på spørgsmålet. Svaret på spørgsmålet skal svare til formatet for svarindstillingen og skal være en værdi, der understøttes i databasen. Hvis dette ikke er tilfældet, vil der opstå en fejl, når du anvender svaret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Config. Question Subform - Control Answer - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the origin of the question.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Config. Question Subform - Control Question Origin - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the format that the answer to the question needs to meet. For example, if you have a question about a name that needs to be answered, according to the name field format and data type set up in the database, the answer option can specify Text.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det format, som svaret på spørgsmålet skal overholde. Hvis du f.eks. har et spørgsmål om et navn, der skal besvares i overensstemmelse med navnefeltsformatet og datatypen i databasen, kan svarindstillingen angive Tekst.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Config. Question Subform - Control Answer Option - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the field that is supporting the setup questionnaire area. The name comes from the Name property of the field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver navnet på det felt, der understøtter området for konfigurationsspørgeskemaet. Navnet kommer fra feltets navneegenskab.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Config. Question Subform - Control Field Name - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the involved entry or record, according to the specified number series.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Config. Question Subform - Control No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.target: Angiver titlen på det felt, der understøtter området for konfigurationsspørgeskemaet. Titlen kommer fra feltets titelegenskab.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Config. Question Subform - Control Field Caption - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the ID of the field from the table that the question area manages.
trans-unit.target: Angiver id'et for feltet fra den tabel, som spørgsmålsområdet administrerer.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Environment.Configuration)(LookupHint=Page Control Add-ins - Control Version - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the description of the Client Control Add-in.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Environment.Configuration)(LookupHint=Page Control Add-ins - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the category of the add-in. There are four categories: DotNet Control Add-in, DotNet Interoperability, Javascript Control Add-in and Language Resource.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kategorien for tilføjelsesprogrammet. Der er fire kategorier: DotNet Control-tilføjelsesprogrammet, DotNet-interoperabilitet, tilføjelsesprogrammet Javascript-kontrol og sprogressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Environment.Configuration)(LookupHint=Page Control Add-ins - Control Category - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the Client Control Add-in that is registered on the Business Central Server.
trans-unit.target: Angiver navnet på klientens tilføjelseskontrolelement, som er registreret på Business Central Server.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Environment.Configuration)(LookupHint=Page Control Add-ins - Control Add-in Name - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the public key token that is associated with the Add-in.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det offentlige nøgletoken, der er tilknyttet tilføjelsesprogrammet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Environment.Configuration)(LookupHint=Page Control Add-ins - Control Public Key Token - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the warehouse document number of the journal line.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that you want the vendor to deliver your order. The field is used to calculate the latest date you can order, as follows: requested receipt date - lead time calculation = order date. If you do not need delivery on a specific date, you can leave the field blank.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor du har bedt kreditoren om at levere din ordre. Værdien i feltet bruges til at beregne, hvilken dato du senest kan bestille, således: anmodet modtagelsesdato - beregnet leveringstid = ordredato. Hvis det ikke er nødvendigt med levering på en bestemt dato, kan du lade feltet stå tomt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Blanket Purch. Order Arch.Sub. - Control Requested Receipt Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date when the item is planned to arrive in inventory. Forward calculation: planned receipt date = order date + vendor lead time (per the vendor calendar and rounded to the next working day in first the vendor calendar and then the location calendar). If no vendor calendar exists, then: planned receipt date = order date + vendor lead time (per the location calendar). Backward calculation: order date = planned receipt date - vendor lead time (per the vendor calendar and rounded to the previous working day in first the vendor calendar and then the location calendar). If no vendor calendar exists, then: order date = planned receipt date - vendor lead time (per the location calendar).
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor varen skal ankomme på lageret. Forlæns beregning: planlagt modtagelsesdato = ordredato + kreditors leveringstid (ifølge kreditorens kalender og afrundet til næste arbejdsdag først i kreditorens kalender og derefter lokationens kalender). Hvis der ingen kalender findes hos kreditoren: planlagt modtagelsesdato = ordredato + kreditors leveringstid (ifølge lokationens kalender). Baglæns beregning: ordredato = planlagt modtagelsesdato - kreditors leveringstid (ifølge kreditorens kalender og afrundet til den forrige arbejdsdag først i kreditorens kalender og derefter lokationens kalender). Hvis der ingen kalender findes hos kreditoren: ordredato = planlagt modtagelsesdato - kreditors leveringstid (ifølge lokations kalender).
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Archive)(LookupHint=Page Blanket Purch. Order Arch.Sub. - Control Planned Receipt Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a window to reconcile unpaid documents automatically with their related bank transactions by importing a bank statement feed or file. In the payment reconciliation journal, incoming or outgoing payments on your bank are automatically, or semi-automatically, applied to their related open customer or vendor ledger entries. Any open bank account ledger entries related to the applied customer or vendor ledger entries will be closed when you choose the Post Payments and Reconcile Bank Account action. This means that the bank account is automatically reconciled for payments that you post with the journal.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et tidsrum for afstemning af ubetalte bilag automatisk med deres relaterede banktransaktioner ved at importere et bankkontoudtog eller en fil. I betalingsudligningskladden udlignes indgående eller udgående betalinger for din bank automatisk eller delvist automatisk med deres relaterede åbne debitor- eller kreditorposter. Alle åbne bankkontoposter i forhold til de udlignede debitor- eller kreditorposter bliver lukket, når du vælger handlingen Bogfør betalinger og Afstem bankkontoen. Det betyder, at bankkontoen automatisk afstemmes for de betalinger, som du bogfører med kladden.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the planned date that the shipment will be delivered at the customer's address. If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates whether the items will be available for delivery on this date. If the items are available, the planned delivery date will be the same as the requested delivery date. If not, the program calculates the date that the items are available for delivery and enters this date in the Planned Delivery Date field.

Hvis debitoren anmoder om en leveringsdato, beregner programmet, om varerne er disponible for levering på denne dato. Hvis varerne er disponible, er den planlagte leveringsdato den samme som den anmodede leveringsdato. Hvis ikke, beregner programmet den dato, hvor varerne er disponible for levering, og angiver denne dato i feltet Planlagt leveringsdato.
