trans-unit.source: Specifies a period of time during which you do not want the planning system to propose to reschedule existing supply orders forward. The dampener period limits the number of insignificant rescheduling of existing supply to a later date if that new date is within the dampener period. The dampener period function is only initiated if the supply can be rescheduled to a later date and not if the supply can be rescheduled to an earlier date. Accordingly, if the suggested new supply date is after the dampener period, then the rescheduling suggestion is not blocked. If the lot accumulation period is less than the dampener period, then the dampener period is dynamically set to equal the lot accumulation period. This is not shown in the value that you enter in the Dampener Period field. The last demand in the lot accumulation period is used to determine whether a potential supply date is in the dampener period. If this field is empty, then the value in the Default Dampener Period field in the Manufacturing Setup window applies. The value that you enter in the Dampener Period field must be a date formula, and one day (1D) is the shortest allowed period.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en tidsperiode, hvor planlægningsprogrammet ikke skal foreslå at omplanlægge eksisterende forsyningsordrer fremad. Bufferperioden begrænser antallet af ubetydelige omplanlægninger af eksisterende udbud til en senere dato, hvis den nye dato ligger inden for bufferperioden. Bufferperiodefunktionen initieres kun, hvis leveringen kan omplanlægges til en senere dato, og ikke hvis leveringen kan omplanlægges til en tidligere dato. Hvis den foreslåede nye forsyningsdato ligger efter bufferperioden, bliver omplanlægningsforslaget ikke spærret. Hvis akkumuleringsperioden for lot er mindre end bufferperioden, indstilles bufferperioden dynamisk til at svare til akkumuleringsperioden for lot. Dette vises ikke i den værdi, du angiver i feltet Bufferperiode. Den sidste efterspørgsel i akkumuleringsperioden for lot bruges til at bestemme, om en mulig forsyningsdato ligger i bufferperioden. Hvis feltet er tomt, anvendes værdien i feltet standardbufferperiode i vinduet Produktionsopsætning. Den værdi, du angiver i feltet Bufferperiode, skal være en datoformel, og én dag (1D) er den korteste tilladte periode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Item)(LookupHint=Page Item Templ. Card - Control Dampener Period - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total Recognized Sales amount that was last posted to the general ledger for the project. The Recognized Sales G/L amount for the project is the sum of the Recognized Sales Project WIP G/L Entries.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det samlede realiserede salgsbeløb, som senest blev bogført i finansmodulet for projektet. Det realiserede salgsfinansbeløb for projektet er summen af det realiserede salg i finansposterne i det igangværende arbejde for projektet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.WIP)(LookupHint=Page Job WIP Cockpit - Control Recog. Sales G/L Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total WIP sales amount that was last calculated for the project. It is calculated as the value in the WIP Sales field minus the value in the Recognized Sales field in the Project G/L WIP Entries window. For projects that use the Cost Value or Cost of Sales WIP methods, the WIP sales amount is normally 0.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det samlede salgsbeløb for igangværende arbejde, som senest blev beregnet for projektet. Det er beregnet som værdien i feltet Igangværende arbejder salg minus værdien i feltet Realiseret salg i vinduet Projektfinansposter for igangværende arbejde. I de sager, hvor VIA-metoderne Kostværdi eller Salgsomkostning benyttes, er VIA-salgsbeløbet normalt 0.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.WIP)(LookupHint=Page Job WIP Cockpit - Control Total WIP Sales G/L Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the Recognized Cost amount that was last calculated for the project. The Recognized Cost Amount for the project is the sum of the Recognized Cost Project WIP Entries.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det realiserede omkostningsbeløb, der sidst blev beregnet for projektet. Det realiserede omkostningsbeløb for projektet er summen af realiserede omkostninger i projektets poster for igangværende arbejde.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.WIP)(LookupHint=Page Job WIP Cockpit - Control Recog. Costs Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total WIP Cost amount that was last posted to the G/L for the project. The WIP Cost Amount for the project is the value WIP Cost Project WIP G/L Entries less the value of the Recognized Cost Project WIP G/L Entries. For projects with WIP Methods of Sales Value or Percentage of Completion, the WIP Cost Amount is normally 0.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det samlede kostbeløb for igangværende arbejde, som sidst blev bogført til finans for projektet. Kostbeløbet for igangværende arbejde for projektet er værdien af omkostningerne for igangværende arbejde i finansposterne for igangværende arbejde for projektet minus værdien af de realiserede omkostninger i finansposterne for igangværende arbejde for projektet. I de sager, hvor metoderne Salgsværdi eller Færdiggørelsesgrad for igangværende arbejde benyttes, er kostbeløbet for igangværende arbejde normalt 0.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.WIP)(LookupHint=Page Job WIP Cockpit - Control Total WIP Cost G/L Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: The Trial Balance page shows a simplified version of the Trial Balance chart. It shows the first nine rows from the rows definition, and the first two columns defined for the column definition in reverse order. The second column is on the left, and the first column is on the right. You can set the order of the columns on the Column Definitions page.
trans-unit.target: På siden Råbalance vises en forenklet version af diagrammet Råbalance. Det viser de første ni rækker fra rækkedefinitionen og de første to kolonner, der er defineret for kolonnedefinitionen i omvendt rækkefølge. trans-unit.source: Specifies text that describes the entry.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the order address of the related vendor.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bestillingsadressen for den relaterede kreditor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Order Address Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the work center number of the journal line.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Work Center No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date when you can expect to receive the items.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor du kan forvente at modtage varerne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Due Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether the items on the line have been approved for purchase.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om varerne på linjen er blevet godkendt til køb.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Confirmed - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost of one unit of the selected item or resource.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kostprisen pr. enhed af den valgte vare eller ressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Direct Unit Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the currency code for the requisition lines.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Currency Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the involved entry or record, according to the specified number series.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den tilknyttede post eller record i overensstemmelse med den angivne nummerserie.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the ID of the user who is ordering the items on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver id'et på den bruger, der bestiller varerne på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Requester ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies additional text describing the entry, or a remark about the requisition worksheet line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver ekstra tekst til beskrivelse af posten eller en bemærkning om indkøbskladdelinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Description 2 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether to accept the action message proposed for the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om den aktionsmeddelelse, som foreslås for linjen, skal godkendes.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Accept Action Message - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related production order.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den relaterede produktionsordre.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Prod. Order No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the journal batch of the subcontracting worksheet.
trans-unit.target: Angiver navnet på kladdekørslen for underleverandørkladden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control CurrentJnlBatchName - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control CurrentJnlBatchName - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a code for an alternate shipment address if you want to ship to another address than the one that has been entered automatically. This field is also used in case of drop shipment.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en kode for en alternativ leveringsadresse, hvis du vil sende til en anden adresse end den, der er indsat automatisk. Dette felt bruges også i tilfælde af direkte levering.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Journal)(LookupHint=Page Subcontracting Worksheet - Control Ship-to Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many times a job queue task should be rerun after a job queue fails to run. This is useful for situations in which a task might be unresponsive. For example, a task might be unresponsive because it depends on an external resource that is not always available.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange gange en opgave i køen skal køres igen, når en jobkø ikke kan køres. Dette er nyttigt i situationer, hvor en opgave ikke reagerer. En opgave reagerer f.eks. ikke, når den er afhængig af en ekstern ressource, der ikke altid er tilgængelig.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Maximum No. of Attempts to Run - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Control33 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the job queue entry runs on Thursdays.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at jobkøposten skal køres på torsdage.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Run on Thursdays - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the job queue entry runs on Sundays.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at jobkøposten skal køres på søndage.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Run on Sundays - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the ID of the object that is to be run for this job. You can select an ID that is of the object type that you have specified in the Object Type to Run field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver id'et for det objekt, der skal aktiveres for denne opgave. Du kan vælge et id af den objekttype, du har angivet i feltet Objekttype, der skal aktiveres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Object ID to Run - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date and time when the job queue entry was last set to Ready and sent to the job queue.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato og det klokkeslæt, hvor jobkøposten senest blev angivet til Klar og sendt til jobkøen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Last Ready State - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the priority of the job within the job queue category. Only relevant when job queue category code is specified.
trans-unit.target: Angiver prioriteten for jobbet i jobkøkategorien. Kun relevant, når jobkøens kategorikode er angivet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Priority Within Category - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many seconds to wait before re-running this job queue task in the event of a failure.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange sekunder du skal vente, før du kører dette jobs jobkø igen i tilfælde af en fejl.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Rerun Delay (sec.) - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Report Parameters - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether options on the report request page have been set for scheduled report job. If the check box is selected, then options have been set for the scheduled report.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om indstillingerne på rapportanmodningssiden er indstillet for en planlagt rapportopgave. Hvis afkrydsningsfeltet er markeret, er indstillingerne angivet for den planlagte rapport.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Report Request Page Options - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control General - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the maximum time that the job queue entry is allowed to run.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den maksimale tid, som jobkøposten må køre.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Timeout - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the job queue entry runs on Tuesdays.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at jobkøposten skal køres på tirsdage.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Run on Tuesdays - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the ID of the user who posted the entry, to be used, for example, in the change log.
trans-unit.target: Angiver id'et for den bruger, der har bogført posten, der skal bruges, f.eks. i ændringsloggen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control User ID - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Control22 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the output of the scheduled report.
trans-unit.target: Angiver resultatet af den planlagte rapport.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Report Output Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the job queue entry runs on Mondays.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at jobkøposten skal køres på mandage.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Run on Mondays - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Recurrence - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of minutes that pass before a recurring job that has the status On Hold With Inactivity Timeout is automatically restated. The value cannot be less than five minutes.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af minutter, der går, før et gentaget job, der har status Afvent med inaktivitetstimeout, ombrydes automatisk. Værdien må ikke være mindre end fem minutter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Inactivity Timeout Period - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a text string that is used as a parameter by the job queue when it is run.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en tekststreng, der anvendes som en parameter til jobkøen, når den aktiveres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Parameter String - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the object that is selected in the Object ID to Run field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver navnet på det objekt, der er valgt i feltet Objekt-id, der skal aktiveres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Object Caption to Run - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the job queue entry. You can edit and update the description on the job queue entry card. The description is also displayed in the Job Queue Entries window, but it cannot be updated there.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en beskrivelse af jobkøposten. Du kan redigere og opdatere beskrivelsen af jobkøpostkortet. Beskrivelsen vises også i vinduet Jobkøposter, men kan ikke opdateres der.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the job queue entry runs on Wednesdays.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at jobkøposten skal køres på onsdage.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Run on Wednesdays - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the job queue entry is recurring. If the Recurring Job check box is selected, then the job queue entry is recurring. If the check box is cleared, the job queue entry is not recurring. After you specify that a job queue entry is a recurring one, you must specify on which days of the week the job queue entry is to run. Optionally, you can also specify a time of day for the job to run and how many minutes should elapse between runs.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om jobkøposten gentages. Hvis afkrydsningsfeltet Gentaget opgave er markeret, gentages jobkøposten. Hvis afkrydsningsfeltet er ryddet, gentages jobkøposten ikke. Efter du har angivet, at en jobkøpost skal gentages, skal du angive, hvilke dage i ugen jobkøposten skal køres. Du kan også angive et tidspunkt på dagen for jobkørslen, og hvor mange minutter der skal gå mellem kørslerne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Recurring Job - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the latest time of the day that the recurring job queue entry is to be run.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det seneste tidspunkt på dagen, hvor den gentagne jobkøpost skal køres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Ending Time - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the job queue entry runs on Saturdays.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at jobkøposten skal køres på lørdage.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Run on Saturdays - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Control31 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the status of the job queue entry. When you create a job queue entry, its status is set to On Hold. You can set the status to Ready and back to On Hold. Otherwise, status information in this field is updated automatically.
trans-unit.target: Angiver status for jobkøposten. Når du opretter en jobkøpost, angives dens status til Afvent. Du kan indstille status til Klar og tilbage til Afvent. Ellers opdateres statusoplysningerne i dette felt automatisk.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Status - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the earliest date and time when the job queue entry should be run. The format for the date and time must be month/day/year hour:minute, and then AM or PM. For example, 3/10/2021 12:00 AM.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den tidligste dato og det tidligste klokkeslæt, hvor jobkøposten skal køres. Formatet for dato og klokkeslæt skal være måned/dag/år-time:minut. For eksempel 3/10/2021-12:00.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Earliest Start Date/Time - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the job queue category to which the job queue entry belongs. Choose the field to select a code from the list.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den jobkøkategori, som jobkøposten tilhører. Vælg feltet for at vælge en kode fra listen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Job Queue Category Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the minimum number of minutes that are to elapse between runs of a job queue entry. The value cannot be less than one minute. This field only has meaning if the job queue entry is set to be a recurring job. If you use a no. of minutes between runs, the date formula setting is cleared.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det mindste antal minutter, der skal forløbe mellem kørslerne af en jobkøpost. Dette felt har kun betydning, hvis jobkøposten er indstillet til at være et gentagelsesjob. Hvis du bruger et antal minutter mellem kørslerne, ryddes datoformelindstillingen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control No. of Minutes between Runs - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date formula that is used to calculate the next time the recurring job queue entry will run. If you use a date formula, all other recurrence settings are cleared.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den datoformel, der bruges til at beregne næste gang, hvor køen med tilbagevendende job skal køres. Hvis du bruger en datoformel, ryddes alle andre gentagelsesindstillinger.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Next Run Date Formula - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date and time when the job queue entry is to expire, after which the job queue entry will not be run. The format for the date and time must be month/day/year hour:minute, and then AM or PM. For example, 3/10/2021 12:00 AM.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato og det klokkeslæt, hvor jobkøposten skal udløbe, hvorefter jobkøposten ikke kan køres. Formatet for dato og klokkeslæt skal være måned/dag/år-time:minut. For eksempel 3/10/2021-12:00.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Expiration Date/Time - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the job queue entry runs on Fridays.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at jobkøposten skal køres på fredage.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Run on Fridays - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the earliest time of the day that the recurring job queue entry is to be run.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det tidligste tidspunkt på dagen, hvor den gentagne jobkøpost skal køres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Starting Time - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of the object, report or codeunit, that is to be run for the job queue entry. After you specify a type, you then select an object ID of that type in the Object ID to Run field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den objekttype, rapport eller codeunit, der skal aktiveres for jobkøposten. Når du har angivet en type, skal du vælge et objekt-id for den pågældende type i feltet Objekt-id, der skal aktiveres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Object Type to Run - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the printer to use to print the scheduled report.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvilken printer der skal bruges til at udskrive den planlagte rapport.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entry Card - Control Printer Name - Property ToolTip)

(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Reminder)(LookupHint=Page Reminder Statistics - Control VatAmount - Property Caption)

(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Reminder)(LookupHint=Page Reminder Statistics - Control Cust."Balance (LCY)" - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that you want the vendor to deliver to the ship-to address. The value in the field is used to calculate the latest date you can order the items to have them delivered on the requested receipt date. If you do not need delivery on a specific date, you can leave the field blank.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, som du har bedt kreditoren om at levere ordren på til leveringsadressen. Værdien i feltet bruges til at beregne, hvilken dato du senest kan bestille varerne, hvis de skal være leveret på den ønskede modtagelsesdato. Hvis det ikke er nødvendigt med levering på en bestemt dato, kan du lade feltet stå tomt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Rcpt. Subform - Control Requested Receipt Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date when the item is planned to arrive in inventory. Forward calculation: planned receipt date = order date + vendor lead time (per the vendor calendar and rounded to the next working day in first the vendor calendar and then the location calendar). If no vendor calendar exists, then: planned receipt date = order date + vendor lead time (per the location calendar). Backward calculation: order date = planned receipt date - vendor lead time (per the vendor calendar and rounded to the previous working day in first the vendor calendar and then the location calendar). If no vendor calendar exists, then: order date = planned receipt date - vendor lead time (per the location calendar).
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor varen skal ankomme på lageret. Forlæns beregning: planlagt modtagelsesdato = ordredato + kreditors leveringstid (ifølge kreditorens kalender og afrundet til næste arbejdsdag først i kreditorens kalender og derefter lokationens kalender). Hvis der ingen kalender findes hos kreditoren: planlagt modtagelsesdato = ordredato + kreditors leveringstid (ifølge lokationens kalender). Baglæns beregning: ordredato = planlagt modtagelsesdato - kreditors leveringstid (ifølge kreditorens kalender og afrundet til den forrige arbejdsdag først i kreditorens kalender og derefter lokationens kalender). Hvis der ingen kalender findes hos kreditoren: ordredato = planlagt modtagelsesdato - kreditors leveringstid (ifølge lokations kalender).
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Rcpt. Subform - Control Planned Receipt Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of transaction that was posted with the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver typen for den transaktion, der blev bogført med linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Rcpt. Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Rcpt. Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the bin where the items are picked or put away.

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item on the line have been received and not yet invoiced.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the net weight of one unit of the item. In the purchase statistics window, the net weight on the line is included in the total net weight of all the lines for the particular purchase document.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the time it takes to make items part of available inventory, after the items have been posted as received.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item ledger entry that the document or journal line is applied to.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the item or service on the line.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Rcpt. Subform - Control Item Reference No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the volume of one unit of the item. In the purchase statistics window, the volume of one unit of the item on the line is included in the total volume of all the lines for the particular purchase document.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the gross weight of one unit of the item. In the purchase statistics window, the gross weight on the line is included in the total gross weight of all the lines for the particular purchase document.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that the vendor has promised to deliver the order.

trans-unit.source: Specifies information in addition to the description.

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item on the line have been posted as invoiced.

trans-unit.source: Specifies that an XML schema file has been loaded for the line.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Xml)(LookupHint=Page XML Schemas - Control XSD.HASVALUE - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Xml)(LookupHint=Page XML Schemas - Control XSD.HASVALUE - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a code for the XML schema.

trans-unit.target: Angiver navneområdet for den XML-skemafil, der er indlæst for linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Xml)(LookupHint=Page XML Schemas - Control Target Namespace - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the description of the XML schema file that has been loaded for the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver beskrivelsen af den XML-skemafil, der er indlæst for linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Xml)(LookupHint=Page XML Schemas - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 2, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Shortcut Dimension 2 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Incl. VAT field on all lines in the document minus any discount amount in the Invoice Discount Amount field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver summen af værdien i feltet Linjebeløb inkl. moms på alle linjer i bilaget minus eventuelle rabatbeløb i feltet Fakturarabatbeløb.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Total Amount Incl. VAT - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount amount that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det rabatbeløb, der ydes på varen, på linjen.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purch. Invoice Subform - Control VAT % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the intercompany partner that the transaction is related to if the entry was created from an intercompany transaction.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den koncerninterne partner, som transaktionen er relateret til, hvis posten blev oprettet fra en koncernintern transaktion.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code explaining why the item was returned.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 1, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Shortcut Dimension 1 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of units per parcel of the item. In the purchase statistics window, the number of units per parcel on the line helps to determine the total number of units for all the lines for the particular purchase document.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the insurance number on the purchase invoice line.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT specification of the involved customer or vendor to link transactions made for this record with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den involverede debitors eller kreditors momsspecifikation for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne record, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle momsbogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purch. Invoice Subform - Control VAT Bus. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the posting type, if Account Type field contains Fixed Asset.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bogføringstypen, hvis feltet Kontotype indeholder Anlægsaktiv.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project.

trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan hver enhed af varen eller ressourcen måles, f.eks. i enheder eller timer. Som standard indsættes værdien i feltet Basisenhed på kortet vare eller ressource.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purch. Invoice Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property Caption)

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Tax Area Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the net weight of one unit of the item. In the purchase statistics window, the net weight on the line is included in the total net weight of all the lines for the particular purchase document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nettovægten af én enhed af varen. I vinduet Købsstatistik medtages nettovægten på linjen i den samlede nettovægt for alle linjer i det aktuelle købsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Net Weight - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Net Weight - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a discount amount that is deducted from the value of the Total Incl. VAT field, based on purchase lines where the Allow Invoice Disc. field is selected.

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether the invoice line could have been included in an invoice discount calculation.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item ledger entry that the document or journal line is applied to.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the gross weight of one unit of the item. In the purchase statistics window, the gross weight on the line is included in the total gross weight of all the lines for the particular purchase document.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project task.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the original document you received from the vendor. You can require the document number for posting, or let it be optional. By default, it's required, so that this document references the original. Making document numbers optional removes a step from the posting process. For example, if you attach the original invoice as a PDF, you might not need to enter the document number. To specify whether document numbers are required, in the Purchases & Payables Setup window, select or clear the Ext. Doc. No. Mandatory field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bilagsnummeret for det oprindelige bilag, du modtog fra kreditoren. Du kan kræve bilagsnummeret til bogføring, eller du kan lade det være valgfrit. Det er påkrævet som standard, så dette bilag refererer til originalen. Det fjerner et trin fra bogføringsprocessen at gøre bilagsnumre valgfri. Hvis du f.eks. vedhæfter den oprindelige faktura som en PDF-fil, behøver du måske ikke at angive bilagsnummeret. I vinduet Købsopsætning kan du vælge, om bilagsnumre er påkrævet ved at vælge eller rydde markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet Eksternt bilagsnr. obl.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the original document you received from the vendor. You can require the document number for posting, or let it be optional. By default, it's required, so that this document references the original. Making document numbers optional removes a step from the posting process. For example, if you attach the original invoice as a PDF, you might not need to enter the document number. To specify whether document numbers are required, in the Purchases & Payables Setup window, select or clear the Ext. Doc. No. Mandatory field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bilagsnummeret for det oprindelige bilag, du modtog fra kreditoren. Du kan kræve bilagsnummeret til bogføring, eller du kan lade det være valgfrit. Det er påkrævet som standard, så dette bilag refererer til originalen. Det fjerner et trin fra bogføringsprocessen at gøre bilagsnumre valgfri. Hvis du f.eks. vedhæfter den oprindelige faktura som en PDF-fil, behøver du måske ikke at angive bilagsnummeret. I vinduet Købsopsætning kan du vælge, om bilagsnumre er påkrævet ved at vælge eller rydde markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet Eksternt bilagsnr. obl.

trans-unit.source: Administrators can deploy Business Central app for Teams for specific users, groups, or the entire organization. By centralizing deployment, users receive the app in all of their Teams clients without having to add it themselves.
trans-unit.target: Administratorer kan installere Business Central-app til Teams for specifikke brugere, grupper eller hele organisationen. Ved at centralisere implementeringen modtager brugerne appen på alle deres team klienter uden at skulle tilføje dem selv.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Apps)(LookupHint=Page Teams Centralized Deployment - Control Para1.1.1 - Property InstructionalText)
(Namespace=System.Apps)(LookupHint=Page Teams Centralized Deployment - Control Para1.1.1 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: The Microsoft Teams admin center is where you configure Teams app setup policies for the organization. It requires the Teams Service admin role or the Global admin role.
trans-unit.target: Microsoft Teams Administration er det sted, hvor du konfigurerer konfigurationspolitikker for Teams-app for organisationen. Den kræver rollen Teams Service-admin eller Global-admin.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Apps)(LookupHint=Page Teams Centralized Deployment - Control Para2.1.1 - Property InstructionalText)
(Namespace=System.Apps)(LookupHint=Page Teams Centralized Deployment - Control Para2.1.1 - Property Caption)

(Namespace=System.Apps)(LookupHint=Page Teams Centralized Deployment - Control Para3.1.1 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: The Business Central app for Teams requires a Business Central online user account that is not compatible with how your Business Central is deployed.
trans-unit.target: Business Central-app'en til Teams kræver en Business Central Online-brugerkonto, der ikke er kompatibel med den måde, din Business Central er installeret på.

trans-unit.source: 2. Choose the policy to include the setting to preinstall the Business Central app.
trans-unit.target: 2. Vælg politikken for at inkludere indstillingen til forudinstallation af Business Central-appen.

trans-unit.source: By enabling this feature, you consent to your data being shared with a Microsoft service that might be outside of your organization's selected geographic boundaries and might have different compliance and security standards than Microsoft Dynamics Business Central. Your privacy is important to us, and you can choose whether to share data with the service. To learn more, follow the link below.

Dine personlige oplysninger er vigtige for os, og du kan vælge, om du vil dele data med tjenesten. Følg nedenstående link for at få mere at vide.

trans-unit.source: Specifies that you must put items in bins that are currently below their minimum quantity of items. You define a minimum quantity for bins on the Bin Contents page.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at du skal lægge varer på placeringer, der aktuelt ligger under deres mindste antal varer. Du kan definere et minimumsantal for placeringer på siden Placeringsindhold.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.Activity)(LookupHint=Page Put-away Template Subform - Control Find Bin w. Less than Min. Qty - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that you must put items in a particular bin. You define the bin by choosing the item on a line on the Bin Contents page and selecting the Fixed checkbox. If you haven't specified a fixed bin for items, choose the Find Floating Bin checkbox.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at du skal lægge varer på en bestemt placering. Du kan definere placeringen ved at vælge varen på en linje på siden Placeringsindhold og markere afkrydsningsfeltet Fast. Hvis du ikke har angivet en fast placering til varer, skal du markere afkrydsningsfeltet Søg efter flydende placering.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.Activity)(LookupHint=Page Put-away Template Subform - Control Find Fixed Bin - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that an empty bin must be used in the put-away process.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at der skal bruges en tom placering i læg-på-lager-processen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.Activity)(LookupHint=Page Put-away Template Subform - Control Find Empty Bin - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the description of the set of criteria that is on the put-away template line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en beskrivelse af det sæt kriterier, der gælder for læg-på-lager-skabelonlinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.Activity)(LookupHint=Page Put-away Template Subform - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that you must put items in bins that have the same unit of measure as the item. You define the unit of measure for a bin on the Bin Contents page. To use this option, the bin must be assigned to a location where Directed Put-Away and Pick is enabled.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at du skal lægge varer på placeringer, der har samme enhed som varen. Du kan definere enheden for en placering på siden Placeringsindhold. Hvis du vil bruge denne indstilling, skal placeringen tildeles til en lokation, hvor Styret læg-på-lager og pluk er aktiveret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.Activity)(LookupHint=Page Put-away Template Subform - Control Find Unit of Measure Match - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that you must put items in a bin that is not specifically tied to any particular item. A bin is considered floating when there are no lines in the Bin Contents page where the Fixed, Default, or Dedicated checkbox is selected.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at du skal lægge varer på en placering, der ikke er specifikt knyttet til en bestemt vare. En placering betragtes som flydende, når der ikke er nogen linjer på siden Placeringsindhold, hvor afkrydsningsfeltet Fast, Standard eller Dedikeret er markeret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.Activity)(LookupHint=Page Put-away Template Subform - Control Find Floating Bin - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that you must put items in bins that already contain the same item. You define the bin for an item by choosing the item on a line on the Bin Contents page. This setting doesn't consider the quantity that's currently in the bin.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at du skal lægge varer på placeringer, der allerede indeholder den samme vare. Du kan definere placeringen af en vare ved at vælge varen på en linje på siden Placeringsindhold. Denne indstilling tager ikke højde for den mængde, der aktuelt findes på placeringen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.Activity)(LookupHint=Page Put-away Template Subform - Control Find Same Item - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the number series that will be used to assign numbers to project WIP documents. To see the number series that have been set up in the No. Series table, click the drop-down arrow in the field.

trans-unit.source: Specify whether to use the customer specified for the project for all tasks or allow people to specify different customers. One customer lets you invoice only the customer specified for the project. Multiple customers lets you invoice customers specified on each task, which can be different customers.
trans-unit.target: Angiv, om du vil bruge den kunde, der er angivet for projektet, til alle opgaver, eller om du vil tillade brugere at angive forskellige kunder. Med én kunde kan du nøjes med at fakturere den kunde, der er angivet for projektet. Flere kunder giver dig mulighed for at fakturere kunder, der er angivet for hver opgave, som kan være forskellige kunder.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Setup)(LookupHint=Page Jobs Setup - Control Archiving - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies in the Projects Setup window that cost changes are automatically adjusted each time the Adjust Cost - Item Entries batch job is run. The adjustment process and its results are the same as when you run the Update Project Item Cost batch job.

For metoder til igangværende arbejde, du opretter, kan du kun fjerne markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet, hvis du angiver Realiserede omkostninger til Brug (Kostbeløb).

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the contract (invoiced price) is posted to the general ledger. For system-defined WIP methods, the WIP Sales field is the default and is checked. trans-unit.source: Specifies the planned date that the shipment will be delivered at the customer's address. If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates whether the items will be available for delivery on this date. If the items are available, the planned delivery date will be the same as the requested delivery date. If not, the program calculates the date that the items are available for delivery and enters this date in the Planned Delivery Date field.

Hvis debitoren anmoder om en leveringsdato, beregner programmet, om varerne er disponible for levering på denne dato. Hvis varerne er disponible, er den planlagte leveringsdato den samme som den anmodede leveringsdato. Hvis ikke, beregner programmet den dato, hvor varerne er disponible for levering, og angiver denne dato i feltet Planlagt leveringsdato.

trans-unit.source: Since this is an evaluation company, you can make it easier to try out this feature by not restricting access using permissions. You can always change this afterwards from the license configuration page.

trans-unit.source: You choose which permissions are assigned in the License Configuration page for the Microsoft 365 license. Business Central will not allow these users to edit data, no matter which permissions you configure.
trans-unit.target: Du vælger, hvilke rettigheder der er tildelt på siden Licenskonfiguration til Microsoft 365-licensen. Business Central tillader ikke disse brugere at redigere data, uanset hvilke rettigheder du konfigurerer.

trans-unit.source: To configure other environments, close this setup window, use the switcher (Ctrl+O) to go to another environment, then run this guided setup again.

trans-unit.source: To restrict who gets access, you can assign a security group in the Business Central admin center that determines which licensed Business Central users and which Microsoft 365 license-holders can access this environment.
trans-unit.target: Hvis du vil begrænse, hvem der får adgang, kan du tildele en sikkerhedsgruppe i Business Central Administration, der bestemmer, hvilke licenserede Business Central-brugere og hvilke licenserede Microsoft 365-brugere der har adgang til dette miljø.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Environment.Configuration)(LookupHint=Page MS 365 License Setup Wizard - Control AccessControlPara2 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: When enabled, users within the same organization that have an applicable Microsoft 365 license will be able to read (but not write) Business Central data that is shared with them in Microsoft Teams, without needing a Business Central license.
trans-unit.target: Når indstillingen er aktiveret, kan brugere inden for samme organisation, der har en gældende Microsoft 365-licens, læse (men ikke skrive) Business Central-data, der deles med dem i Microsoft Teams, uden at have behov for en Business Central-licens.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the purpose of the account. Total: Used to total a series of balances on accounts from many different account groupings. To use Total, leave this field blank. End-Total: A total of a series of accounts that starts with the preceding Begin-Total account. The total is defined in the Totaling field.

trans-unit.source: Specifies a period of time during which you do not want the planning system to propose to reschedule existing supply orders forward. The dampener period limits the number of insignificant rescheduling of existing supply to a later date if that new date is within the dampener period. The dampener period function is only initiated if the supply can be rescheduled to a later date and not if the supply can be rescheduled to an earlier date. Accordingly, if the suggested new supply date is after the dampener period, then the rescheduling suggestion is not blocked. If the lot accumulation period is less than the dampener period, then the dampener period is dynamically set to equal the lot accumulation period. This is not shown in the value that you enter in the Dampener Period field. The last demand in the lot accumulation period is used to determine whether a potential supply date is in the dampener period. If this field is empty, then the value in the Default Dampener Period field in the Manufacturing Setup window applies. The value that you enter in the Dampener Period field must be a date formula, and one day (1D) is the shortest allowed period.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en tidsperiode, hvor planlægningsprogrammet ikke skal foreslå at omplanlægge eksisterende forsyningsordrer fremad. Bufferperioden begrænser antallet af ubetydelige omplanlægninger af eksisterende udbud til en senere dato, hvis den nye dato ligger inden for bufferperioden. Bufferperiodefunktionen initieres kun, hvis leveringen kan omplanlægges til en senere dato, og ikke hvis leveringen kan omplanlægges til en tidligere dato. Hvis den foreslåede nye forsyningsdato ligger efter bufferperioden, bliver omplanlægningsforslaget ikke spærret. Hvis akkumuleringsperioden for lot er mindre end bufferperioden, indstilles bufferperioden dynamisk til at svare til akkumuleringsperioden for lot. Dette vises ikke i den værdi, du angiver i feltet Bufferperiode. Den sidste efterspørgsel i akkumuleringsperioden for lot bruges til at bestemme, om en mulig forsyningsdato ligger i bufferperioden. Hvis feltet er tomt, anvendes værdien i feltet standardbufferperiode i vinduet Produktionsopsætning. Den værdi, du angiver i feltet Bufferperiode, skal være en datoformel, og én dag (1D) er den korteste tilladte periode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Location)(LookupHint=Page Stockkeeping Unit Card - Control Dampener Period - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how consumption of the item (component) is calculated and handled in production processes. Manual: Enter and post consumption in the consumption journal manually. Forward: Automatically posts consumption according to the production order component lines when the first operation starts. Backward: Automatically calculates and posts consumption according to the production order component lines when the production order is finished. Pick + Forward / Pick + Backward: Variations with warehousing.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan forbruget af varen (komponenten) beregnes og håndteres i produktionsprocesserne. Manuelt: Angiv og bogfør forbrug i forbrugskladden manuelt. Fremad: Bogfører automatisk forbrug ifølge produktionsordrekomponentlinjerne, når den første handling starter. Baglæns: Beregner og bogfører automatisk forbrug ifølge produktionsordrekomponentlinjerne, når produktionsordren er færdig. Pluk + Fremad / Pluk + Baglæns: Variationer med lagersted.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the original document you received from the vendor. You can require the document number for posting, or let it be optional. By default, it's required, so that this document references the original. Making document numbers optional removes a step from the posting process. For example, if you attach the original invoice as a PDF, you might not need to enter the document number. To specify whether document numbers are required, in the Purchases & Payables Setup window, select or clear the Ext. Doc. No. Mandatory field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bilagsnummeret for det oprindelige bilag, du modtog fra kreditoren. Du kan kræve bilagsnummeret til bogføring, eller du kan lade det være valgfrit. Det er påkrævet som standard, så dette bilag refererer til originalen. Det fjerner et trin fra bogføringsprocessen at gøre bilagsnumre valgfri. Hvis du f.eks. vedhæfter den oprindelige faktura som en PDF-fil, behøver du måske ikke at angive bilagsnummeret. I vinduet Købsopsætning kan du vælge, om bilagsnumre er påkrævet ved at vælge eller rydde markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet Eksternt bilagsnr. obl.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the delivery conditions of the related shipment, such as free on board (FOB). This value is not carried over from the source documents because one warehouse shipment can contain lines from many source documents. If you enter a code, the source document will be updated during posting. If this field is blank, the original shipment method of the source document is used.
trans-unit.target: Angiver leveringsbetingelserne for den relaterede leverance, f.eks. frit om bord (FOB). Denne værdi overføres ikke fra kildedokumenterne, da en lagerstedsforsendelse kan indeholde linjer fra mange kildedokumenter. Hvis du indsætter en kode, vil kildedokumentet blive opdateret ved bogføringen. Hvis feltet er tomt, bruges den oprindelige forsendelsesmetode for kildedokumentet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.Document)(LookupHint=Page Warehouse Shipment - Control Shipment Method Code - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.Document)(LookupHint=Page Warehouse Shipment - Control General - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the service, such as a one-day delivery, that is offered by the shipping agent. This value is not carried over from the source documents because one warehouse shipment can contain lines from many source documents. If you enter a value, the source document will be updated during posting. If this field is blank, the original shipping agent service of the source document is used.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for servicen, f.eks. en endagslevering, som speditøren tilbyder. Denne værdi overføres ikke fra kildedokumenterne, da en lagerstedsforsendelse kan indeholde linjer fra mange kildedokumenter. Hvis du indsætter en værdi, vil kildedokumentet blive opdateret ved bogføringen. Hvis feltet er tomt, bruges den oprindelige speditørservice på kildedokumentet.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the bin where the items are picked or put away.

trans-unit.source: Specifies how you want the program to recalculate the next planned service date for service items in service contracts. Planned: The next planned service date is recalculated by adding the value in the Service Period field for the service item to the previous next planned service date. Also, when the last service actually took place is disregarded. Actual: The next planned service date is recalculated by adding the service period for the service item to the value in the Posting Date field of the last posted service order that belongs to the service contract and includes that service item.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan du ønsker, at programmet skal genberegne den næste planlagte servicedato for serviceartikler i servicekontrakter. Planlagt: Den næste planlagte servicedato genberegnes, når du tilføjer værdien i feltet Serviceperiode for serviceartiklen til den forrige næste planlagte servicedato. Det ignoreres, hvornår den sidste service faktisk fandt sted. Faktisk: Den næste planlagte servicedato genberegnes ved at tilføje serviceperioden for serviceartiklen til værdien i feltet Bogføringsdato på den sidste bogførte serviceordre, der tilhører servicekontrakten og indeholder denne serviceartikel.

trans-unit.source: Specifies a window to reconcile unpaid documents automatically with their related bank transactions by importing a bank statement feed or file. In the payment reconciliation journal, incoming or outgoing payments on your bank are automatically, or semi-automatically, applied to their related open customer or vendor ledger entries. Any open bank account ledger entries related to the applied customer or vendor ledger entries will be closed when you choose the Post Payments and Reconcile Bank Account action. This means that the bank account is automatically reconciled for payments that you post with the journal.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et tidsrum for afstemning af ubetalte bilag automatisk med deres relaterede banktransaktioner ved at importere et bankkontoudtog eller en fil. I betalingsudligningskladden udlignes indgående eller udgående betalinger for din bank automatisk eller delvist automatisk med deres relaterede åbne debitor- eller kreditorposter. Alle åbne bankkontoposter i forhold til de udlignede debitor- eller kreditorposter bliver lukket, når du vælger handlingen Bogfør betalinger og Afstem bankkontoen. Det betyder, at bankkontoen automatisk afstemmes for de betalinger, som du bogfører med kladden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Accountant Activities - Control Non-Applied Payments - Property ToolTip)
