trans-unit.target: Angiver, om varer aldrig, automatisk (altid) eller eventuelt kan reserveres til denne debitor. Valgfri betyder, at du manuelt skal reservere varer til denne debitor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Control28 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity that remains to be invoiced. It is calculated as Quantity - Qty. Invoiced.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal, der mangler at blive faktureret. Det beregnes som Antal - Faktureret antal.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Qty. to Invoice - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT product posting group. Links business transactions made for the item, resource, or G/L account with the general ledger, to account for VAT amounts resulting from trade with that record.
trans-unit.target: Angiver momsproduktbogføringsgruppen. Knytter forretningstransaktioner for varen, ressourcen eller finanskontoen til finansregnskabet for at gøre rede for momsbeløbet som følge af handlen med den pågældende record.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control VAT Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how each unit of the item or resource is measured, such as in pieces or hours. By default, the value in the Base Unit of Measure field on the item or resource card is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan hver enhed af varen eller ressourcen måles, f.eks. i enheder eller timer. Som standard indsættes værdien i feltet Basisenhed på kortet vare eller ressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Unit of Measure Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 3.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode3 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Excl. VAT field on all lines in the document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver summen af værdien i feltet Linjebeløb ekskl. moms på alle linjer i bilaget.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control SubtotalExclVAT - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control SubtotalExclVAT - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tax group that is used to calculate and post sales tax.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den skattegruppe, der bruges til at beregne og bogføre salgsmoms.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Tax Group Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity of the item charge that was assigned to a specified item when you posted this sales line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af varegebyrer, der var tildelt en bestemt vare, da du bogførte salgslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Qty. Assigned - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Return Qty. to Receive - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity of items that remain to be shipped.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal varer, der mangler at blive afsendt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Return Qty. to Receive - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: If the customer is not returning the full quantity, adjust the ‘Qty. to Receive’ value. Similarly, choose the quantity to credit the customer in the Qty to Invoice field.
trans-unit.target: Hvis debitoren ikke returnerer hele antallet, skal du justere værdien 'Antal at modtage'. Vælg ligeledes det antal, der skal krediteres debitoren, i feltet Antal at fakturere.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Return Qty. to Receive - Property AboutText)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount percentage that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den rabatprocent, der tildeles varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Line Discount % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units are being returned.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder der returneres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of transaction that will be posted with the document line. If you select Comment, then you can enter any text in the Description field, such as a message to a customer.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den transaktionstype, der vil blive bogført med bilagslinjen. Hvis du vælger Bemærkning, kan du skrive hvad som helst i feltet Beskrivelse, f.eks. en besked til en debitor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the service, such as a one-day delivery, that is offered by the shipping agent.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for servicen, f.eks. levering samme dag, som tilbydes af speditøren.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Shipping Agent Service Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a discount percentage that is applied to the invoice, based on sales lines where the Allow Invoice Disc. field is selected. The percentage and criteria are defined in the Customer Invoice Discounts page, but you can enter or change the percentage manually.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en rabatprocent, der er knyttet til fakturaen, baseret på salgslinjer, hvor feltet Tillad fakturarabat er markeret. Procenten og kriterierne defineres på siden debitorfakturarabatter, men du kan indsætte eller ændre procentdelen manuelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Invoice Disc. Pct. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Invoice Disc. Pct. - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the bin where the items are picked or put away.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den placering, hvor varerne plukkes eller lægges på lager.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Bin Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price for one unit on the sales line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver prisen for én enhed på salgslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Unit Price - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tax area code for the customer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Tax Area Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the starting date of the returns deferral period.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Returns Deferral Start Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the net weight of one unit of the item. In the sales statistics window, the net weight on the line is included in the total net weight of all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nettovægten af én enhed af varen. I vinduet Salgsstatistik medtages nettovægten på linjen i den samlede nettovægt for alle linjer i det aktuelle salgsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Net Weight - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Net Weight - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 4.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode4 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a discount amount that is deducted from the value of the Total Incl. VAT field, based on sales lines where the Allow Invoice Disc. field is selected. You can enter or change the amount manually.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et rabatbeløb, der trækkes fra værdien i feltet I alt inkl. moms baseret på salgslinjer, hvor feltet Tillad fakturarabat er markeret. Du kan indsætte eller ændre beløbet manuelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Invoice Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Invoice Discount Amount - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the invoice line is included when the invoice discount is calculated.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om fakturalinjen bliver medtaget, når fakturarabatten beregnes.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Allow Invoice Disc. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item ledger entry that the document or journal line is applied -to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret af den varepost, som dette bilag eller denne kladdelinje udlignes på.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Appl.-to Item Entry - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the planned date that the shipment will be delivered at the customer's address. If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates whether the items will be available for delivery on this date. If the items are available, the planned delivery date will be the same as the requested delivery date. If not, the program calculates the date that the items are available for delivery and enters this date in the Planned Delivery Date field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den planlagte dato, hvor leverancen leveres på debitorens adresse. Hvis debitoren anmoder om en leveringsdato, beregner programmet, om varerne er disponible for levering på denne dato. Hvis varerne er disponible, er den planlagte leveringsdato den samme som den anmodede leveringsdato. Hvis ikke, beregner programmet den dato, hvor varerne er disponible for levering, og angiver denne dato i feltet Planlagt leveringsdato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Planned Delivery Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the blanket order that the record originates from.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den rammeordre, hvorfra recorden stammer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Blanket Order No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varianten af varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Variant Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the entry of the product to be sold. To add a non-transactional text line, fill in the Description field only.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en beskrivelse af posten for det produkt, der skal sælges. Hvis du vil tilføje en ikke-transaktionsbaseret tekstlinje, skal du kun udfylde feltet Beskrivelse.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the net amount, excluding any invoice discount amount, that must be paid for products on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det nettobeløb uden eventuelt fakturarabatbeløb, som skal betales for produkterne på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Line Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 5.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode5 - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Item Reference No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the volume of one unit of the item. In the sales statistics window, the volume of one unit of the item on the line is included in the total volume of all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver mængden af én enhed af varen. I vinduet Salgsstatistik indgår mængden af én enhed af varen på linjen i den samlede mængde for alle linjer i det aktuelle salgsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Unit Volume - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the shipping agent who is transporting the items.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den speditør, som transporterer varerne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Shipping Agent Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies when items on the document are shipped or were shipped. A shipment date is usually calculated from a requested delivery date plus lead time.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvornår varerne på bilaget er sendt eller leveret. En afsendelsesdato beregnes normalt ud fra en ønsket leveringsdato plus leveringstiden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Shipment Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of a general ledger account, item, resource, additional cost, or fixed asset, depending on the contents of the Type field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på en finanskonto, vare, ressource, ekstra omkostning eller anlægsaktiv, afhængigt af hvad du har valgt i feltet Type.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Excl. VAT field on all lines in the document minus any discount amount in the Invoice Discount Amount field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver summen af værdien i feltet Linjebeløb ekskl. moms på alle linjer i bilaget minus eventuelle rabatbeløb i feltet Fakturarabatbeløb.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Total Amount Excl. VAT - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Total Amount Excl. VAT - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the gross weight of one unit of the item. In the sales statistics window, the gross weight on the line is included in the total gross weight of all the lines for the particular sales document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bruttovægten af en enhed af varen. I vinduet Salgsstatistik medtages bruttovægten på linjen i den samlede bruttovægt af alle linjer i det aktuelle salgsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Gross Weight - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Gross Weight - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that the shipment should ship from the warehouse. If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates the planned shipment date by subtracting the shipping time from the requested delivery date. If the customer does not request a delivery date or the requested delivery date cannot be met, the program calculates the content of this field by adding the shipment time to the shipping date.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor leverancen skal sendes fra lageret. Hvis debitoren anmoder om en leveringsdato, beregner programmet den planlagte leveringsdato ved at trække fragttiden fra den anmodede leveringsdato. Hvis debitoren ikke anmoder om en leveringsdato, eller den anmodede leveringsdato ikke kan opfyldes, beregner programmet indholdet af dette felt ved at tilføje fragttiden til leveringsdatoen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Planned Shipment Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that you have promised to deliver the order, as a result of the Order Promising function.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor du har lovet at levere ordren som resultat af funktionen Beregning af leveringstid.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Promised Delivery Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies information in addition to the description.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Description 2 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of non-inventory product lines attached to the sales line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af ikke-lagerbaserede produktlinjer, der er knyttet til salgslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Attached Lines Count - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the customer or vendor is liable for sales tax.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om debitoren eller kreditoren er momspligtig.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Tax Liable - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the item or account in your IC partner's company that corresponds to the item or account on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den vare eller konto i IC-partnerens virksomhed, der svarer til varen eller kontoen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control IC Partner Ref. Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item ledger entry that the document or journal line is applied from.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret af den varepost, som dette bilag eller denne kladdelinje udlignes fra.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Appl.-from Item Entry - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item on the line have been posted as invoiced.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af den pågældende vare der allerede er blevet bogført som faktureret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Quantity Invoiced - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the vendor's or customer's trade type to link transactions made for this business partner with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kreditorens eller kundens handelstype for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne forretningspartner, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle bogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Gen. Bus. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that you can assign item charges to this line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at du kan tildele varegebyrer til linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Allow Item Charge Assignment - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the unit cost of the item on the line.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Unit Cost (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 7.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode7 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item on the line have been posted as shipped.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af den pågældende vare der allerede er blevet bogført som leveret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Return Qty. Received - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the blanket order line that the record originates from.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den rammeordre, hvorfra recorden stammer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Blanket Order Line No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 6.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control ShortcutDimCode6 - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the deferral template that governs how revenue earned with this sales document is deferred to the different accounting periods when the good or service was delivered.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den periodiseringsskabelon, der styrer, hvordan indtægter fra dette salgsdokument periodiseres til de forskellige regnskabsperioder, når varen eller tjenesten leveres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Deferral Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the invoice discount amount for the line.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Sales Return Order Subform - Control Inv. Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how to finish setting up your company.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan du fuldfører opsætning af din virksomhed.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Configuration Completion - Control BeforeSetupCloseMessage - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: If you have finished setting up the company, select the profile that you want to use as your default, and then choose the OK button to close the page. Then restart the Business Central client to apply the changes.
trans-unit.target: Hvis du er færdig med at opsætte din virksomhed, skal du vælge, hvilken profil du ønsker at bruge som standard, og derefter klikke på OK for at lukke siden. Derefter skal du genstarte Business Central-klienten for at anvende ændringerne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Configuration Completion - Control BeforeSetupCloseMessage - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the profile code for your configuration solution and package.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Configuration Completion - Control Your Profile Code - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.IO)(LookupHint=Page Configuration Completion - Control Complete Setup - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether to register the user's time usage defined as the time spent from when the user logs in to when the user logs out. Unexpected interruptions, such as idle session timeout, terminal server idle session timeout, or a client crash are not recorded.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om der skal være registrering af brugerens tidsforbrug, der er defineret som den tid, der er gået, fra brugeren logger på, til brugeren logger af. Uventede afbrydelser, f.eks. timeout for inaktiv session, timeout for inaktiv terminalserversession eller nedbrud af klientsystem, registreres ikke.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Setup FactBox - Control Register Time - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the last date on which the user is allowed to post to the company.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den seneste dato, hvor brugeren må bogføre i regnskabet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Setup FactBox - Control Allow Posting To - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if a user is a time sheet administrator. A time sheet administrator can access any time sheet and then edit, change, or delete it.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om en bruger er timeseddeladministrator. En timeseddeladministrator kan få adgang til enhver timeseddel og derefter redigere, ændre eller slette den.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Setup FactBox - Control Time Sheet Admin. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the earliest date on which the user is allowed to post to the company.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den tidligste dato, hvor brugeren må bogføre i regnskabet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Security.User)(LookupHint=Page User Setup FactBox - Control Allow Posting From - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 2, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 2, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Transfer)(LookupHint=Page Transfer Orders - Control Shortcut Dimension 2 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 1, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 1, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Transfer)(LookupHint=Page Transfer Orders - Control Shortcut Dimension 1 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the delivery conditions of the related shipment, such as free on board (FOB).
trans-unit.target: Angiver betingelserne for levering af den relaterede leverance, som f.eks. frit ombord (FOB).
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Transfer)(LookupHint=Page Transfer Orders - Control Shipment Method Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the in-transit code for the transfer order, such as a shipping agent.
trans-unit.target: Angiver transitkoden for overflytningsordren, f.eks. en speditør.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Transfer)(LookupHint=Page Transfer Orders - Control In-Transit Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the transfer does not use an in-transit location.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at overførslen ikke anvender en transitlokation.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Transfer)(LookupHint=Page Transfer Orders - Control Direct Transfer - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the location that the items are transferred to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den lokation, som varerne overflyttes til.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Transfer)(LookupHint=Page Transfer Orders - Control Transfer-to Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the ID of the user who is responsible for the document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver id'et for den bruger, der er ansvarlig for bilaget.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Transfer)(LookupHint=Page Transfer Orders - Control Assigned User ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that you expect the transfer-to location to receive the shipment.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den forventede dato for modtagelsen af leverancen til den lokation, der overflyttes til.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Transfer)(LookupHint=Page Transfer Orders - Control Receipt Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies an instruction to the warehouse that ships the items, for example, that it is acceptable to do partial shipment.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en instruktion til det lager, der afsender varerne, f.eks. at det er tilladt at foretage delleveringer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Transfer)(LookupHint=Page Transfer Orders - Control Shipping Advice - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the shipping agent who is transporting the items.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den speditør, som transporterer varerne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Transfer)(LookupHint=Page Transfer Orders - Control Shipping Agent Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies, for the archived workflow step instance, the workflow step ID of the workflow step instance.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Automation)(LookupHint=Page Archived WF Step Instances - Control Workflow Step ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies, for the workflow step instance, the user who created the workflow step instance.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den bruger, der oprettede workflowtrininstansen, for workflowtrinstansen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Automation)(LookupHint=Page Archived WF Step Instances - Control Created By User ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies, for the archived workflow step instance, the step that you want to precede the step that you are specifying on the line. You use this field to specify branching of steps when one of multiple possible events does not occur and you want the following step to specify another possible event as a branch of the previous step. In this case, both steps have the same value in the Previous Workflow Step ID field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det trin, som skal komme før det trin, som du angiver på linjen for den arkiverede workflowtrininstans. Dette felt anvendes til at angive forgrening af trin, hvis én af flere mulige hændelser ikke forekommer, og du ønsker, at følgende trin skal angive en anden mulig hændelse som en forgrening af det forrige trin. I dette tilfælde har begge trin den samme værdi i feltet Id for foregående workflowtrin.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Automation)(LookupHint=Page Archived WF Step Instances - Control Previous Workflow Step ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies, for the archived workflow step instance, another workflow step than the next one in the sequence that you want to start, for example, because the event on the workflow step failed to meet a condition.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et andet workflowtrin end det næste trin i den rækkefølge, som skal starte, for den arkiverede workflowtrininstans, da hændelsen i workflowtrinnet ikke opfyldte en betingelse.

trans-unit.source: Specifies, for the archived workflow step instance, the workflow that the workflow step instance belongs to.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Automation)(LookupHint=Page Archived WF Step Instances - Control Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies, for the archived workflow step instance, the status of the workflow step instance. Active means that the step instance in ongoing. Completed means that the workflow step instance is done. Ignored means that the workflow step instance was skipped in favor of another path.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the purpose of the account. Total: Used to total a series of balances on accounts from many different account groupings. To use Total, leave this field blank. End-Total: A total of a series of accounts that starts with the preceding Begin-Total account. The total is defined in the Totaling field.

trans-unit.target: Angiver et omkostningstypeinterval for at definere, hvilke omkostningstyper der allokeres. Hvis alle omkostninger, som tilskrives omkostningsstedet, er allokeret, behøver du ikke indstille et omkostningstypeinterval.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation Sources - Control Cost Type Range - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the allocation comes from both budgeted and actual costs, only budgeted costs, or only actual costs.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om allokeringen kommer fra både budgetterede og faktiske omkostninger, kun budgetterede omkostninger eller kun faktiske omkostninger.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation Sources - Control Allocation Source Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a comment that applies to the cost allocation.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en kommentar, der gælder for omkostningsfordelingen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation Sources - Control Comment - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost type to which the credit posting is posted. The costs that are allocated are credited to the source cost center. It is useful to set up a helping cost type to later identify the allocation postings in the statistics and reports.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den omkostningstype, som kreditbogføring bogføres til. De omkostninger, der allokeres, bliver krediteret til kildeomkostningsstedet. Det er en god ide at konfigurere en hjælpeomkostningstype, så det senere er muligt at identificere bogføringerne i statistikken og rapporterne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation Sources - Control Credit to Cost Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the related record is blocked from being posted in transactions, for example a customer that is declared insolvent or an item that is placed in quarantine.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at den relaterede record er forhindret i kunne bogføres under transaktioner – eksempelvis en debitor, som er erklæret insolvent, eller en vare, som er sat i karantæne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation Sources - Control Blocked - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the user ID that applies to the cost allocation.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det bruger-id, som gælder for omkostningsfordelingen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation Sources - Control ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost center code. The code serves as a default value for cost posting that is captured later in the cost journal.
trans-unit.target: Angiver omkostningsstedets kode. Koden fungerer som en standardværdi for omkostningsbogføring, der registreres senere i omkostningskladden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation Sources - Control Cost Center Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that the cost allocation source ends.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor omkostningsfordelingskilden slutter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation Sources - Control Valid To - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the shares of the cost allocation targets.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation Sources - Control Total Share - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.SalesTax)(LookupHint=Page Tax Area - Control General - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code you want to assign to this tax area. You can enter up to 20 characters, both numbers and letters. It is a good idea to enter a code that is easy to remember.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den kode, der skal bruges til dette skatteområde. Du kan bruge op til 20 tegn (både tal og bogstaver). Det anbefales at bruge koder, der er nemme at huske.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.SalesTax)(LookupHint=Page Tax Area - Control Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the tax area. For example, if you use a number as the tax code, you might want to describe the tax area in this field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en beskrivelse af skatteområdet. Hvis du f.eks. bruger et nummer som skattekode, kan du evt. beskrive skatteområdet i dette felt.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the credit account that is automatically inserted on purchase credit memo lines that are created from electronic documents when the incoming document line does not contain an identifiable item. Any incoming document line that does not have a GTIN or the vendor's item number will be converted to a purchase line of type G/L Account, and the No. field on the purchase line will contain the account that you select in the Credit Acc. for Non-Item Lines field. For more information, see Debit Acc. for Non-Item Lines.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den kreditkonto, der automatisk indsættes på købskreditnotalinjer, der er oprettet ud fra elektroniske dokumenter, når den indgående bilagslinje ikke indeholder en identificerbar vare. Enhver indgående bilagslinje, der ikke har et GTIN eller kreditorens varenummer, vil blive konverteret til en købslinje af typen Finanskonto, og feltet Nr. på købslinjen vil indeholde den konto, som du vælger i feltet Kreditkonto til ikke-varelinjer. Yderligere oplysninger finder du under Debetkonto til ikke-varelinjer.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control VAT Product Posting Setup - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: VAT is set up and ready to go.
trans-unit.target: Momsen er konfigureret og klar til brug.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control That's it! - Property InstructionalText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control That's it! - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: You will set up the VAT rates that apply to customers, vendors, and items in different markets, and then specify the accounts to post VAT to. If you sometimes use VAT rates that deviate from standard rates, there's also an option to enter clauses that explain why to tax authorities.
trans-unit.target: Du konfigurerer momssatser, som gælder for debitorer, kreditorer og varer på andre markeder, og derefter angiver du de konti, hvortil moms skal bogføres. Hvis du nogle gange anvender andre momssatser end standardsatserne, kan du også angive klausuler, der forklarer årsagen til SKAT.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Control27 - Property InstructionalText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control VAT Bus. Post. Grp Part - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Looks like you've already posted one or more transactions that include VAT. To avoid mistakes, you'll have to manually set up VAT calculations.
trans-unit.target: Det ser ud til, at du allerede har bogført én eller flere transaktioner, som inkluderer moms. Du skal konfigurere momsudregninger manuelt for at undgå fejl.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Control32 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Specify default VAT rates for customer templates. When assigned to customers, customer templates apply default settings for posting things like revenue, costs, receivables, payables, inventory, and VAT rates.
trans-unit.target: Angiv momssatserne til debitorskabeloner. Når debitorskabelonerne tildeles debitorer, anvender de standardindstillingerne for bogføring af elementer som indtægter, omkostninger, tilgodehavender, skyldige beløb, lager og momssatser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Default VAT Rates on Customer Templates - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Default VAT Rates on Customer Templates
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Default VAT Rates on Customer Templates - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: This assisted setup guide helps you automate VAT calculations for sales and purchase documents.
trans-unit.target: Denne assisterende opsætningsvejledning hjælper dig med at automatisere momsberegninger for salgs- og købsdokumenter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Control28 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Specify default VAT rates for item templates. When assigned to items, item templates apply default settings for posting, including VAT rates.
trans-unit.target: Angiv momssatserne til vareskabeloner. Når vareskabelonerne tildeles varer, anvender de standardindstillingerne for bogføring, herunder momssatser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Default VAT Rates on Item Templates - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Default VAT Rates on Item Templates
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Default VAT Rates on Item Templates - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Get a clear picture of your finances by assigning G/L accounts for sales, purchases, and reversed charges VAT amounts to VAT product posting groups. For example, this lets you compare the VAT amount figures you'll report to VAT authorities to the figures posted in your general ledger.
trans-unit.target: Hvilke salgs-, købs- eller finanskonti eller konti med omvendt betalingspligt bruges til hvilke bogføringsgrupper for momsprodukter? Finanskonti giver en oversigt over den økonomiske situation. De giver også mulighed for at få oplysninger om udgifter og indtægter, der kan sammenholdes med budgetter og med tal fra foregående år. På denne måde er det muligt at finde de indtægtsgivende områder, afværge tab, justere urealistiske budgetter m.v.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control G/L Accounts for VAT Amounts - Property InstructionalText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control G/L Accounts for VAT Amounts - Property Caption)

trans-unit.target: Vælg Næste for at komme i gang.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Control22 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: VAT business posting groups specify where you do business, or the type of business you do. See the options from a VAT perspective, and choose all that apply. In the next steps, you'll specify the VAT types to use for customers, vendors, and items in those markets.
trans-unit.target: Momsvirksomhedsbogføringsgrupper angiver, hvor du driver forretning eller hvilken branche, du er i. Se indstillingerne ud fra et momsperspektiv, og vælg alle dem, der er relevante. I de næste trin skal du angive momstyper for debitorer, kreditorer og varer på disse markeder.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control VAT Business Posting Groups - Property Caption)

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Manual setup required - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Some tax authorities require explanations, and sometimes even references to regulatory statues, when non-standard VAT rates, such as reduced or zero, are used on invoices. You can enter the clauses, and they will be printed on sales documents that use non-standard VAT rates.
trans-unit.target: Nogle skattemyndigheder kræver forklaringer og af og til endda henvisninger til love og forordninger, når der anvendes ikke-standardmomssatser, f.eks. reducerede satser eller nulsatser på priser. Du kan angive klausulerne, hvorefter de udskrives på salgsdokumenter, der anvender ikke-standardmomssatser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Optional: Clauses for Non-Standard VAT Rates - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Optional: Clauses for Non-Standard VAT Rates
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Optional: Clauses for Non-Standard VAT Rates - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: To review your VAT settings later, open the VAT Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Du kan gennemse dine momsindstillinger senere ved at åbne vinduet Momsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Control25 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Specify types of products (items and services) that you buy or sell, and the VAT rates that apply. If the default VAT rates aren't correct, you can adjust them. You can also add lines if you use reduced VAT rates when buying or selling.
trans-unit.target: Angiv produkttyper (varer og servicer), som du køber og sælger, og de gældende momssatser. Hvis standardmomssatserne er forkerte, kan du justere dem. Du kan også tilføje linjer, hvis du anvender reducerede momssatser, når du køber eller sælger.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control VAT Rates for Items and Services - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: VAT Rates for Items and Services
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control VAT Rates for Items and Services - Property Caption)

trans-unit.target: Tildel momsopsætning til debitor-, kreditor- og vareskabeloner

(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Setup Wizard - Control Let's go! - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: To do that now, choose a VAT posting setup. In the VAT Posting Setup window, add or edit the VAT business posting group, VAT product posting group, and other details as needed.
trans-unit.target: Du kan gøre dette nu ved at vælge en momsbogføringsopsætning. I vinduet Momsbogf.opsætning skal du tilføje eller redigere momsvirksomhedsbogføringsgruppen, momsproduktbogføringsgruppen og andre detaljer efter behov.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the purpose of the account. Total: Used to total a series of balances on accounts from many different account groupings. To use Total, leave this field blank. Begin-Total: A marker for the beginning of a series of accounts to be totaled that ends with an End-Total account. End-Total: A total of a series of accounts that starts with the preceding Begin-Total account. The total is defined in the Totaling field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver formålet med kontoen. I alt: Bruges til at sammentælle en række saldi på konti fra mange forskellige grupper. Lad feltet stå tomt, hvis du vil bruge I alt. trans-unit.source: Specifies an account that will be posted to when the revenue that can be recognized for the project is greater than the current invoiced value for the project if the work in process (WIP) method for the project is Sales Value.

trans-unit.source: Specifies an account that accumulates postings when the costs recognized, based on the invoiced value of the project, are greater than the current usage total posted If the WIP method for the project is Cost Value or Cost of Sales. The account is normally a balance sheet accrued expense liability account.

Kontoen er som regel en balancekonto til afstemning af periodisk gæld.

trans-unit.source: Specifies how costs are calculated for items using the Average costing method. Item: One average cost per item in the company is calculated. This means that the average cost of this item depends on where it is stored and which variant, such as color, of the item you have selected.

Det betyder, at den gennemsnitlige kostpris for varen afhænger af, hvor den er lagret, og hvilken variant, f.eks. farve, af varen du har valgt.

trans-unit.source: Shows the source type that applies to the source number that is shown in the Source No. field. If the entry was posted from an item journal line, the field is blank. If posted from a sales line, the source type is Customer. If posted from a purchase line, the source type is Vendor. If the entry resulted from the production of a BOM (bill of materials), the source type is Item.

Hvis posten er et resultat af produktionen af en stykliste, er kildetypen Vare.

If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates whether the items will be available for delivery on this date. If not, the program calculates the date that the items are available for delivery and enters this date in the Planned Delivery Date field.

trans-unit.source: Specifies how checks are voided. Unapply and Void Check: The payment will be unapplied so that the vendor ledger entry for the invoice will be open, and the payment will be reversed by the voided check. Void Check Only: The vendor ledger entry will still be closed by the payment entry, and the voided check entry will be open.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan checks annulleres. Annuller og Annuller check: Betalingen bliver udligningsfortrudt, så kreditorposten for fakturaen vil være åben, og betalingen vil blive tilbageført af den annullerede check. Annuller kun check: Kreditorposten vil stadig være lukket af betalingsposten, og annulleringskontrolposten vil være åben.

trans-unit.source: Specifies an account interval or a list of account numbers. The entries of the account will be totaled to give a total balance. How entries are totaled depends on the value in the Account Type field.

The time element is used in the calculation of the delivery date as follows: Shipment Date + Outbound Warehouse Handling Time = Planned Shipment Date + Shipping Time = Planned Delivery Date.

Tidselementet anvendes ved beregning af leveringsdatoen på følgende måde: Afsendelsesdato + Udgående lagerekspeditionstid = Planlagt afsendelsesdato + Transporttid = Planlagt leveringsdato.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the original document you received from the vendor. You can require the document number for posting, or let it be optional. By default, it's required, so that this document references the original. Making document numbers optional removes a step from the posting process. For example, if you attach the original invoice as a PDF, you might not need to enter the document number. To specify whether document numbers are required, in the Purchases & Payables Setup window, select or clear the Ext. Doc. No. Mandatory field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bilagsnummeret for det oprindelige bilag, du modtog fra kreditoren. Du kan kræve bilagsnummeret til bogføring, eller du kan lade det være valgfrit. Det er påkrævet som standard, så dette bilag refererer til originalen. Det fjerner et trin fra bogføringsprocessen at gøre bilagsnumre valgfri. Hvis du f.eks. vedhæfter den oprindelige faktura som en PDF-fil, behøver du måske ikke at angive bilagsnummeret. I vinduet Købsopsætning kan du vælge, om bilagsnumre er påkrævet ved at vælge eller rydde markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet Eksternt bilagsnr. obl.

trans-unit.source: A Document page represents a transaction for the business. Document pages are the computerized counterpart to paper-based documents: Invoices, orders, quotes. This setup wizard will create a document page, along with a list to manage them.
trans-unit.target: En bilagsside repræsenterer en transaktion for virksomheden. Bilagssider er den computerbehandlede modpart til papirbaserede bilag: Fakturaer, ordrer, tilbud. Denne opsætningsvejledning opretter en bilagsside sammen med en oversigt til at administrere dem.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Tooling)(LookupHint=Page New Page - Control Control16 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Pick card details for managing or browsing business entities or event details. Items, customers, accounts, service charge details and suppliers are examples of details. This setup wizard will create a card details page, along with a list to manage them.
trans-unit.target: Udvælg kortdetaljer til administration eller gennemsyn af forretningsenheder eller hændelsesdetaljer. Varer, debitorer, konti, servicegebyrdetaljer og leverandører er eksempler på detaljer. Denne opsætningsvejledning opretter en side for kortdetaljer sammen med en oversigt, hvor du kan administrere dem.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Tooling)(LookupHint=Page New Page - Control Control9 - Property InstructionalText)

trans-unit.source: Designing a page is easy. How you want to use your page is just as important as what it looks like. How are you planning to use it?
trans-unit.target: Det er let at designe en side. Hvordan du vil bruge siden, er lige så vigtigt som, hvordan den ser ud. Hvordan har du tænkt, at den skulle bruges?

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the original document you received from the vendor. You can require the document number for posting, or let it be optional. By default, it's required, so that this document references the original. Making document numbers optional removes a step from the posting process. For example, if you attach the original invoice as a PDF, you might not need to enter the document number. To specify whether document numbers are required, in the Purchases & Payables Setup window, select or clear the Ext. Doc. No. Mandatory field.

Hvis du f.eks. vedhæfter den oprindelige faktura som en PDF-fil, behøver du måske ikke at angive bilagsnummeret. I vinduet Købsopsætning kan du vælge, om bilagsnumre er påkrævet ved at vælge eller rydde markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet Eksternt bilagsnr. obl.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of decimal places that are shown for unit amounts, item or resource prices per unit, in LCY. The default setting, 2:5, specifies that unit amounts will be shown with a minimum of two decimal places and a maximum of five decimal places. You can also enter a fixed number, such as 2, to specify that all unit amounts are shown with two decimal places. On the Currencies page, you specify how many decimal places to show for unit amounts in foreign currencies.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet decimaler, der vises for priser, vare eller ressourcepriser pr. enhed i RV. Standardværdien 2:5 angiver, at varepriser vises med mindst to decimaler og op til fem decimaler. Du kan også angive et fast tal, f.eks. 2, for at angive, at alle priser skal vises med to decimaler. På siden Valutaer angiver du, hvor mange decimaler der skal vises for beløb i udenlandsk valuta.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control UnitAmountDecimalPlaces - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control UnitAmountDecimalPlaces - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether to register users' time usage defined as the time spent from when a user logs in to when the user logs out. Unexpected interruptions, such as idle session timeout, terminal server idle session timeout, or a client crash are not recorded. This setting can be overruled per user by filling in the Register Time field in the User Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om der skal være registrering af brugerens tidsforbrug, der er defineret som den tid, der er gået, fra brugeren logger på, til brugeren logger af. Uventede afbrydelser, f.eks. timeout for inaktiv session, timeout for inaktiv terminalserversession eller nedbrud af klientsystem, registreres ikke. Denne indstilling kan tilsidesættes pr. bruger ved at udfylde feltet Registrer tid i vinduet Brugeropsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control Register Time - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how the accounts set up for VAT posting in the VAT Posting Setup window will be adjusted for exchange rate fluctuations.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan de konti, der er oprettet til momspostering i vinduet Opsætning af momsbogf., reguleres for kursudsving.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control VAT Exchange Rate Adjustment - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for a global dimension that is linked to the record or entry for analysis purposes. Two global dimensions, typically for the company's most important activities, are available on all cards, documents, reports, and lists.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for en global dimension, der er knyttet til recorden eller posten med henblik på analyse. To globale dimensioner, der er typiske for virksomhedens vigtigste aktiviteter, er tilgængelige på alle kort, bilag, rapporter og lister.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control Global Dimension 1 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies dimension source for Realized Gain/Loss application entries.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control App. Dimension Posting - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for a global dimension that is linked to the record or entry for analysis purposes. Two global dimensions, typically for the company's most important activities, are available on all cards, documents, reports, and lists.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for en global dimension, der er knyttet til recorden eller posten med henblik på analyse. To globale dimensioner, der er typiske for virksomhedens vigtigste aktiviteter, er tilgængelige på alle kort, bilag, rapporter og lister.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control Global Dimension 2 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how the program will round VAT when calculated for the local currency. When you enter an Amount Including VAT in a document, the system first calculates and rounds the Amount Excluding VAT, and then calculates by subtraction the VAT Amount because the total amount has to match the Amount Including VAT entered manually. In that case, the VAT Rounding Type does not apply as the Amount Excluding VAT is already rounded using the Amount Rounding Precision.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan programmet afrunder moms, når den beregnes for den lokale valuta. Når du angivet et beløb inkl. moms i et dokument, beregnes og afrundes beløbet før moms først, og momsbeløbet beregnes derefter ved at fratrække dette beløb, da det samlede beløb skal stemme overens med beløbet inkl. moms, som er angivet manuelt. Når det er tilfældet, vil Momsafrundingstype ikke kunne bruges, da beløbet før moms allerede er afrundet med Afrundingspræcision.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control VAT Rounding Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the last date on which posting to the company books is allowed.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den seneste dato, hvor det er tilladt at bogføre i regnskaberne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control Allow Posting To - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the size of the interval to be used when rounding invoice amounts in LCY. Examples: 1.00: Round to whole numbers (no decimals - divisible by 1.00), 0.05: Round to a number divisible by 0.05, 0.01: No rounding (ordinary currency decimals). On the Currencies page, you specify how to round invoices in foreign currencies.
trans-unit.target: Angiver størrelsen på intervallet, der skal bruges til afrunding af fakturabeløb i RV. Eksempler: 1,00: Afrund til heltal (uden decimaler – deleligt med 1,00). 0,05: Afrund til et tal, der er deleligt med 0,05. 0,01: ingen afrunding (almindelige valutadecimaler). På siden Valutaer angiver du, hvordan fakturaer i fremmede valutaer afrundes.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control Inv. Rounding Precision (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether to recalculate tax amounts when you post payments that trigger payment discounts.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om du vil genberegne momsbeløb, når du bogfører betalinger, der udløser kontantrabatter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control Adjust for Payment Disc. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of decimal places that are shown for amounts in LCY. This covers amounts created with all types of transactions and is useful to avoid inconsistencies when viewing or summing different amounts. The default setting, 2:2, specifies that all amounts in LCY are shown with a minimum of 2 decimal places and a maximum of 2 decimal places. You can also enter a fixed number, such as 2, which also means that amounts are shown with two decimals. On the Currencies page, you specify how many decimal places to show for amounts in foreign currencies.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal decimaler, der vises for beløb i RV. Dette omfatter beløb, der er oprettet med alle typer transaktioner og bruges til at undgå uoverensstemmelser ved visning eller sammenlægning af forskellige beløb. Standardværdien, 2:2, angiver, at alle beløb i RV vises med mindst 2 decimaler og maksimalt 2 decimaler. Du kan også angive et fast tal, f.eks. 2, hvilket også betyder, at beløbene vises med to decimaler. På siden Valutaer angiver du, hvor mange decimaler, der skal vises for beløb i udenlandsk valuta.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control AmountDecimalPlaces - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control AmountDecimalPlaces - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether to display a message when a payment differs from the invoice amount within the specified tolerance, so you can choose how to process it. If you do not enable the message, and a tolerance level is specified, invoices with amounts that are within tolerance will be automatically closed and you cannot choose to leave the remaining amount. Default tolerance levels are specified in the Payment Tolerance % and Max. Payment Tolerance fields, but can also be specified for each customer ledger entry.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om der skal vises en meddelelse, når en betaling afviger fra fakturabeløbet inden for den angivne tolerance, så du kan vælge, hvordan den skal behandles. Hvis du ikke aktiverer meddelelsen, og der er angivet et toleranceniveau, vil fakturaer med beløb, der er inden for tolerancen, blive lukket automatisk, og du kan ikke vælge at efterlade det resterende beløb. Standardtoleranceniveauerne angives i felterne Betalingstolerance % og Maks. betalingstolerance, men kan også angives for hver debitorpost.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control Payment Tolerance Warning - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether or not the Company Bank Account can be updated on posted documents.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om virksomhedens bankkonto kan opdateres på bogførte dokumenter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control Hide Company Bank Account - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the posting method that is used when posting a payment tolerance. Payment Tolerance Accounts: The payment discount tolerance is posted to a special general ledger account set up for payment tolerance. Payment Discount Amount: The payment discount tolerance is posted as a payment discount.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den bogføringsmetode, der bruges ved bogføring af en betalingstolerance. Betalingstolerancekonti: Kontantrabattolerancen bogføres på en bestemt finanskonto, der er angivet for betalingstolerance. Kontantrabatbeløb: Kontantrabattolerancen bogføres som en kontantrabat.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 1, whose dimension values you can then enter directly on journals and sales or purchase lines.

trans-unit.source: Specifies a way of using VAT Date against VAT Return Periods. If you choose ‘Block posting within closed and warn for released period’, system will not allow postings in closed VAT Return Period, but if the period is not closed, but VAT returns are released or submitted, user will be warned what try to post an entry with VAT Date in this period. If you choose ‘Block posting within closed period’, system will still not allow postings in closed VAT Return Period, but there will be no warnings for release or submitted VAT returns. If you choose ‘Warn when posting in closed period’, system will not block posting entry with VAT Date in the closed VAT return period, but it will show warning message before posting. And if you choose ‘Disabled’ options, system will allow you to post without any control regardless of VAT return or period status.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en måde at bruge momsdatoer på i forhold til momsangivelsesperioder. Hvis du vælger "Spær bogføring i lukket periode, og advar om frigivet periode", vil systemet ikke tillade bogføringer i lukkede momsangivelsesperioder, men hvis perioden ikke er lukket, men momsangivelser frigives eller sendes, og brugeren bliver advaret, hvis man prøver at bogføre en post med momsdato i denne periode. Hvis du vælger "Spær bogføring i lukket periode", vil systemet stadig ikke tillade bogføringer i lukkede momsangivelsesperioder, men der vil ikke være nogen advarsler for frigivne eller afsendte momsangivelser. Hvis du vælger "Advar ved bogføring i lukket periode", vil systemet ikke spærre for bogføring af posten med momsdatoen i den lukkede momsangivelsesperiode, men det vil vise en advarselsmeddelelse, før den bogføres. Hvis du vælger indstillingen "Deaktiveret", vil systemet tillade, at du kan bogføre uden kontrol, uanset status af momsangivelse eller -periode.

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether to prevent users from deleting G/L accounts with ledger entries that are after the date in the Check G/L Acc. Deletion After field. Blokering af sletning hjælper f.eks med at undgå at miste økonomiske data, som din virksomhed vil bevare pga. regionale krav i landet.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the size of the interval to be used when rounding amounts in LCY. This covers amounts created with all types of transactions and is useful to avoid inconsistencies when viewing or summing different amounts. Amounts will be rounded to the nearest digit. Example: To have amounts rounded to whole numbers, enter 1.00 in this field. In this case, amounts less than 0.5 will be rounded down and amounts greater than or equal to 0.5 will be rounded up. On the Currencies page, you specify how amounts in foreign currencies are rounded.
trans-unit.target: Angiver størrelsen på intervallet, der bruges til afrunding af beløb i RV. Dette omfatter beløb, der er oprettet med alle typer transaktioner og bruges til at undgå uoverensstemmelser ved visning eller sammenlægning af forskellige beløb. Beløb afrundes til nærmeste ciffer. Eksempel: Hvis beløbene afrundes til hele tal, skal du indtaste 1,00 i dette felt. I dette tilfælde afrundes beløb mindre end 0,5, og beløb, der er større end eller lig med 0,5, rundes op. På siden Valutaer angiver du, hvordan beløb i fremmed valuta afrundes.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control AmountRoundingPrecision - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control AmountRoundingPrecision - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how to round invoice amounts. The contents of this field determine whether the invoice amount to be rounded will be rounded up or down to the nearest interval as specified in the Invoice Rounding Precision field. If you select Nearest, digits that are higher than or equal to 5 will be rounded up, and digits that are lower than or equal to 5 will be rounded down.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan fakturabeløb afrundes. Indholdet i dette felt bestemmer, om fakturabeløbet, der skal afrundes, rundes op eller ned til nærmeste interval som angivet i feltet Fakturaafrundingspræcision. Hvis du vælger Nærmeste, rundes cifre, der er højere end eller lig med 5, op, og cifre, der er mindre end eller lig med 5, rundes ned.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Setup)(LookupHint=Page General Ledger Setup - Control Inv. Rounding Type (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the original document you received from the vendor. You can require the document number for posting, or let it be optional. By default, it's required, so that this document references the original. Making document numbers optional removes a step from the posting process. For example, if you attach the original invoice as a PDF, you might not need to enter the document number. To specify whether document numbers are required, in the Purchases & Payables Setup window, select or clear the Ext. Doc. No. Mandatory field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bilagsnummeret for det oprindelige bilag, du modtog fra kreditoren. Du kan kræve bilagsnummeret til bogføring, eller du kan lade det være valgfrit. Det er påkrævet som standard, så dette bilag refererer til originalen. Det fjerner et trin fra bogføringsprocessen at gøre bilagsnumre valgfri. Hvis du f.eks. vedhæfter den oprindelige faktura som en PDF-fil, behøver du måske ikke at angive bilagsnummeret. I vinduet Købsopsætning kan du vælge, om bilagsnumre er påkrævet ved at vælge eller rydde markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet Eksternt bilagsnr. obl.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Production Planner Activities - Control Prod. BOMs under Development - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Production Planner Activities - Control Routings under Development - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of simulated production orders that are displayed in the Manufacturing Cue on the Role Center. The documents are filtered by today's date.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af simulerede produktionsordrer, der vises i produktionskøindikatoren i Rollecenter. Bilagene filtreres efter dags dato.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 2, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 2, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Shortcut Dimension 2 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount amount that is granted for the item on the line.
