trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Line Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 1, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 1, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Shortcut Dimension 1 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the insurance number on the purchase credit memo line.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Insurance No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the net amount, including VAT, for this line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nettobeløbet inklusive moms for denne linje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Amount Including VAT - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price, in LCY, of one unit of the item or resource. You can enter a price manually or have it entered according to the Price/Profit Calculation field on the related card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver prisen for én enhed af varen eller ressourcen i RV. Du kan angive en pris manuelt eller få den angivet i henhold til feltet Avancepct.beregning på det dertilhørende kort.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Unit Price (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the posting type, if Account Type field contains Fixed Asset.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bogføringstypen, hvis feltet Kontotype indeholder Anlægsaktiv.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control FA Posting Type - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på det relaterede projekt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Job No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the item or resource's unit of measure, such as piece or hour.
trans-unit.target: Angiver navnet på varens eller ressourcens enhed, f.eks. styk eller time.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Unit of Measure - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of a fixed asset with the Budgeted Asset check box selected. When you post the journal or document line, an additional entry is created for the budgeted fixed asset where the amount has the opposite sign.
trans-unit.target: Angivet nummeret for et anlægsaktiv, hvor afkrydsningsfeltet Budgetanlæg er markeret. Når du bogfører kladde- eller bilagslinje, oprettes en ekstra post for det budgetterede anlægsaktiv, hvor beløbet har det modsatte fortegn.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Budgeted FA No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the order number this line is associated with.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det ordrenummer, som linjen er tilknyttet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Order No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the depreciation book to which the line will be posted if you have selected Fixed Asset in the Type field for this line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den afskrivningsprofil, linjen skal bogføres til, hvis du har valgt Anlægsaktiv i feltet Type for denne linje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Depreciation Book Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how each unit of the item or resource is measured, such as in pieces or hours. By default, the value in the Base Unit of Measure field on the item or resource card is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan hver enhed af varen eller ressourcen måles, f.eks. i enheder eller timer. Som standard indsættes værdien i feltet Basisenhed på kortet vare eller ressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Unit of Measure Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount percentage that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den rabatprocent, der tildeles varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Line Discount % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of units of the item specified on the credit memo line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af varen der skal angives på kreditnotalinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the invoice line is included when the invoice discount is calculated.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om fakturalinjen bliver medtaget, når fakturarabatten beregnes.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Allow Invoice Disc. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the vendor who delivered the items.
trans-unit.target: Angiver navnet på den kreditor, der leverede varerne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Buy-from Vendor Name - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item ledger entry that the document or journal line is applied to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den varepost, som dette dokument eller denne kladdelinje udlignes på.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Appl.-to Item Entry - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the percentage of the item's last purchase cost that includes indirect costs, such as freight that is associated with the purchase of the item.
trans-unit.target: Angiver procentdelen af varens sidste købspris, der omfatter indirekte omkostninger, såsom fragt, der er knyttet til købet af varen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Indirect Cost % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if depreciation was calculated until the FA posting date of the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om afskrivningen er beregnet op til linjens anlægsbogføringsdato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Depr. until FA Posting Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varianten af varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Variant Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies either the name of, or a description of, the item or general ledger account.
trans-unit.target: Angiver navnet på eller en beskrivelse af varen eller finanskontoen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if, when this line was posted, the additional acquisition cost posted on the line was depreciated in proportion to the amount by which the fixed asset had already been depreciated.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om den ekstra anskaffelsespris, der er bogført på linjen, blev afskrevet (da denne linje blev bogført) i forhold til det beløb, som anlægget allerede var afskrevet med.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Depr. Acquisition Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the no. of the vendor who delivered the items.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den kreditor, der leverede varerne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Buy-from Vendor No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost of one unit of the selected item or resource.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kostprisen pr. enhed af den valgte vare eller ressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Direct Unit Cost - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the involved entry or record, according to the specified number series.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den tilknyttede post eller record i overensstemmelse med den angivne nummerserie.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies information in addition to the description.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Description 2 - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Document No. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost, in LCY, of one unit of the item or resource on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver omkostningen, i RV, på én enhed af varen eller ressourcen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Unit Cost (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total calculated invoice discount amount for the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det samlede beregnede fakturarabatbeløb for linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.History)(LookupHint=Page Posted Purchase Cr. Memo Lines - Control Inv. Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the original dimension value to register the transfer of items from the original dimension value to the new dimension value.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den oprindelige dimensionsværdi, der registrerer overførslen af varer fra den oprindelige dimensionsværdi til den nye dimensionsværdi.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.Dimension)(LookupHint=Page Edit Reclas. Dimensions - Control Dimension Value Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the new dimension value to register the transfer of items, from the original dimension value to the new dimension value.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den nye dimensionsværdi, der registrerer overførslen af varer fra den oprindelige dimensionsværdi til den nye dimensionsværdi.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.Dimension)(LookupHint=Page Edit Reclas. Dimensions - Control New Dimension Value Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the descriptive name of the Dimension Code field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beskrivende navn på feltet Dimensionskode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.Dimension)(LookupHint=Page Edit Reclas. Dimensions - Control Dimension Name - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a dimension code to attach a dimension to a journal line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en dimensionskode, der knytter en dimension til en kladdelinje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.Dimension)(LookupHint=Page Edit Reclas. Dimensions - Control Dimension Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the descriptive name of the New Dimension Value Code field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beskrivende navn på feltet Ny dimensionsværdikode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.Dimension)(LookupHint=Page Edit Reclas. Dimensions - Control New Dimension Value Name - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the descriptive name of the original Dimension Value Code field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det beskrivende navn på feltet for den oprindelige Dimensionsværdikode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.Dimension)(LookupHint=Page Edit Reclas. Dimensions - Control Dimension Value Name - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the general ledger account number to which to post sales VAT for the particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den finanskonto, hvortil der skal bogføres salgsmoms på for den specielle kombination af momsvirksomheds- og momsproduktbogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Sales VAT Account - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the relevant VAT rate for the particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group. Do not enter the percent sign, only the number. For example, if the VAT rate is 25 %, enter 25 in this field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den momssats, der gælder for den aktuelle kombination af momsvirksomhedsbogføringsgruppe og momsproduktbogføringsgruppe. Brug ikke procenttegn, når du indtaster momsprocenten, kun tal. Hvis momssatsen f.eks. er 25 %, skal du indtaste 25 i feltet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control VAT % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if this combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group are to be reported as services in the periodic VAT reports.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvis denne specielle kombination af momsvirksomheds- og momsproduktbogføringsgruppe skal rapporteres som tjenester i de periodiske momsrapporter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control EU Service - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the general ledger account number to which you want to post reverse charge VAT (purchase VAT) for this combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group, if you have selected the Reverse Charge VAT option in the VAT Calculation Type field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på finanskontoen til bogføring af modtagermoms (købsmoms) for denne kombination af momsvirksomheds- og momsproduktbogføringsgruppen, hvis du har valgt indstillingen Modtagermoms i feltet Momsberegningstype.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Reverse Chrg. VAT Acc. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether the Non-Deductible VAT is considered for this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om den ikke-fradragsberettigede moms tages i betragtning til denne bestemte kombination af bogføringsgrupper for momsvirksomheder og momsprodukter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Allow Non-Deductible VAT - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT specification of the involved customer or vendor to link transactions made for this record with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den involverede debitors eller kreditors momsspecifikation for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne record, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle momsbogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control VAT Bus. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT Clause Code that is associated with the VAT Posting Setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den momsklausulkode, der er tilknyttet Opsætning af momsbogf.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control VAT Clause Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if documents that use this combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group require a certificate of supply.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om bilag, der bruger denne kombination af momsvirksomhedsbogføringsgruppe og momsproduktbogføringsgruppe, kræver et leveringscertifikat.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Certificate of Supply Required - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the account associated with the VAT amount that is not deducted due to the type of goods or services purchased.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den konto, der er knyttet til momsbeløbet, som ikke er fratrukket pga. den købte type varer eller services.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Non-Ded. Purchase VAT Account - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT specification of the involved item or resource to link transactions made for this record with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den involverede vares eller ressources momsspecifikation for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne record, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle momsbogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control VAT Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the general ledger account to post unrealized sales VAT to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den finanskonto, hvortil urealiseret salgsmoms skal bogføres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Sales VAT Unreal. Account - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a code to group various VAT posting setups with similar attributes, for example VAT percentage.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en kode for at gruppere forskellige momsbogføringsopsætninger med ensartede attributter, f.eks. momsprocent.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control VAT Identifier - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the general ledger account to post amounts for unrealized reverse charge VAT to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den finanskonto, hvortil urealiseret modtagermoms skal bogføres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Reverse Chrg. VAT Unreal. Acc. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how to handle unrealized VAT, which is VAT that is calculated but not due until the invoice is paid.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan urealiseret moms skal administreres, dvs. moms, der er beregnet men ikke forfalden, før fakturaen betales.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Unrealized VAT Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the general ledger account number to which to post purchase VAT for the particular combination of business group and product group.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den finanskonto, der skal bogføres købsmomsen for den aktuelle kombination af virksomheds- og produktbogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Purchase VAT Account - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how VAT will be calculated for purchases or sales of items with this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan moms skal beregnes ved køb eller salg af varer med den aktuelle kombination af momsvirksomheds- og momsproduktbogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control VAT Calculation Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the VAT posting setup
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group is blocked.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om den aktuelle kombination af momsvirksomhedsbogføringsgruppe og momsproduktbogføringsgruppe er spærret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Blocked - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the percentage of the transaction amount to which VAT is not applied.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den procentdel af transaktionsbeløbet, som momsen ikke er anvendt med.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Non-Deductible VAT% - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether to recalculate VAT amounts when you post payments that trigger payment discounts.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om du vil genberegne momsbeløb, når du bogfører betalinger, der udløser kontantrabatter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Adjust for Payment Discount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT category in connection with electronic document sending. For example, when you send sales documents through the PEPPOL service, the value in this field is used to populate the TaxApplied element in the Supplier group. The number is based on the UNCL5305 standard.
trans-unit.target: Angiver momskategorien i forbindelse med afsendelse af elektroniske dokumenter. Når du f.eks. sender salgsdokumenter via PEPPOL-tjenesten, bruges værdien i dette felt til at udfylde elementet TaxApplied i leverandørgruppen. Nummeret er baseret på UNCL5305-standarden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Tax Category - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the general ledger account to post unrealized purchase VAT to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den finanskonto, hvortil urealiseret købsmoms skal bogføres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup - Control Purch. VAT Unreal. Account - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if and how the document is attached as a PDF file to an email to the involved customer when you choose the Post and Send button. If you choose the Yes (Prompt for Settings) option, the document is attached to an email according to settings that you must make in the Send Email window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om og hvordan bilaget vedhæftes som en PDF-fil i en mail til den pågældende debitor, når du vælger knappen Bogfør og send. Hvis du vælger indstillingen Ja (Bed om indstillinger), vedhæftes bilaget i en mail i overensstemmelse med indstillingerne, som du skal konfigurere i vinduet Send mail.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Foundation.Reporting)(LookupHint=Page Select Sending Options - Control E-Mail - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if and how the document is printed when you choose the Post and Send button. If you choose the Yes (Prompt for Settings) option, the document is printed according to settings that you must make on the printer setup dialog.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om og hvordan bilaget udskrives, når du vælger knappen Bogfør og send. Hvis du vælger indstillingen Ja (Bed om indstillinger), udskrives bilaget i overensstemmelse med indstillingerne, som du skal konfigurere i dialogboksen printeropsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Foundation.Reporting)(LookupHint=Page Select Sending Options - Control Printer - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies which format to use for electronic document sending. You must fill this field if you selected the Silent option in the Electronic Document field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det format, der skal bruges til afsendelse af elektroniske dokumenter. Du skal udfylde dette felt, hvis du valgte indstillingen Uovervåget i feltet Elektronisk dokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Foundation.Reporting)(LookupHint=Page Select Sending Options - Control Electronic Format - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Foundation.Reporting)(LookupHint=Page Select Sending Options - Control Electronic Format - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the format of the file that is saved to disk.
trans-unit.target: Angiver formatet på filen, der gemmes på disken.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Foundation.Reporting)(LookupHint=Page Select Sending Options - Control E-Mail Format - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies which default order flow is used to supply this assembly item.

trans-unit.source: Specifies links between business transactions made for the item and an inventory account in the general ledger, to group amounts for that item type.
trans-unit.target: Angiver links mellem forretningstransaktioner, som er lavet til varen, og en lagerkonto i finansposterne for at samle beløbene for denne varetype i en gruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Item)(LookupHint=Page Item List - Control Inventory Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the item's indirect cost as an absolute amount.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varens indirekte omkostning som et absolut beløb.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the item's product type to link transactions made for this item with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varens produkttype for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne vare, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle bogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Item)(LookupHint=Page Item List - Control Gen. Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how the item's cost flow is recorded and whether an actual or budgeted value is capitalized and used in the cost calculation.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan varens kostprisforløb registreres, og om en faktisk eller budgetteret værdi føres som aktiv og bruges i beregningen af kostprisen.

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units, such as pieces, boxes, or cans, of the item are in inventory.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Item)(LookupHint=Page Item List - Control InventoryField - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how consumption of the item (component) is calculated and handled in production processes. Manual: Enter and post consumption in the consumption journal manually. Forward: Automatically posts consumption according to the production order component lines when the first operation starts. Backward: Automatically calculates and posts consumption according to the production order component lines when the production order is finished. Pick + Forward / Pick + Backward: Variations with warehousing.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan forbruget af varen (komponenten) beregnes og håndteres i produktionsprocesserne. Manuelt: Angiv og bogfør forbrug i forbrugskladden manuelt. Fremad: Bogfører automatisk forbrug ifølge produktionsordrekomponentlinjerne, når den første handling starter. Baglæns: Beregner og bogfører automatisk forbrug ifølge produktionsordrekomponentlinjerne, når produktionsordren er færdig. Pluk + Fremad / Pluk + Baglæns: Variationer med lagersted.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Item)(LookupHint=Page Item List - Control Flushing Method - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT product posting group. Links business transactions made for the item, resource, or G/L account with the general ledger, to account for VAT amounts resulting from trade with that record.
trans-unit.target: Angiver momsproduktbogføringsgruppen. Knytter forretningstransaktioner for varen, ressourcen eller finanskontoen til finansregnskabet for at gøre rede for momsbeløbet som følge af handlen med den pågældende record.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Item)(LookupHint=Page Item List - Control VAT Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies when the item card was last modified.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvornår varekortet sidst blev ændret.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Item)(LookupHint=Page Item List - Control Default Deferral Template Code - Property Caption)

trans-unit.target: Angiver den dækningsgrad, du vil sælge varen til. Du kan angive en avanceprocent manuelt eller få den angivet i henhold til feltet Avancepct.beregning

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the original document you received from the vendor. You can require the document number for posting, or let it be optional. By default, it's required, so that this document references the original. Making document numbers optional removes a step from the posting process. For example, if you attach the original invoice as a PDF, you might not need to enter the document number. To specify whether document numbers are required, in the Purchases & Payables Setup window, select or clear the Ext. Doc. No. Mandatory field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bilagsnummeret for det oprindelige bilag, du modtog fra kreditoren. Du kan kræve bilagsnummeret til bogføring, eller du kan lade det være valgfrit. Det er påkrævet som standard, så dette bilag refererer til originalen. Det fjerner et trin fra bogføringsprocessen at gøre bilagsnumre valgfri. Hvis du f.eks. vedhæfter den oprindelige faktura som en PDF-fil, behøver du måske ikke at angive bilagsnummeret. I vinduet Købsopsætning kan du vælge, om bilagsnumre er påkrævet ved at vælge eller rydde markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet Eksternt bilagsnr. obl.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining quantity of the resource, item, or general ledger account that remains to complete a project, expressed in base units of measure. The quantity is calculated as the difference between Quantity and Qty. Posted.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date of the planning line. You can use the planning date for filtering the totals of the project, for example, if you want to see the budgeted usage for a specific month of the year.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the purpose of the account. Total: Used to total a series of balances on accounts from many different account groupings. To use Total, leave this field blank. trans-unit.target: Angiver den konto, der er knyttet til momsbeløbet, som ikke er fratrukket pga. den købte type varer eller services.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control Non-Ded. Purchase VAT Account - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT specification of the involved item or resource to link transactions made for this record with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den involverede vares eller ressources momsspecifikation for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne record, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle momsbogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control VAT Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control General - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the general ledger account number to which to post unrealized sales VAT (as calculated when you post sales invoices) using this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den finanskonto, hvor ikke-realiseret salgsmoms skal bogføres (beregnes ved bogføring af salgsfakturaer) med den aktuelle kombination af momsvirksomheds- og momsproduktbogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control Sales VAT Unreal. Account - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a code to group various VAT posting setups with similar attributes, for example VAT percentage.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en kode for at gruppere forskellige momsbogføringsopsætninger med ensartede attributter, f.eks. momsprocent.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control VAT Identifier - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the general ledger account number to which you want to post amounts for unrealized reverse charge VAT (purchase VAT) for this combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group, if you have selected the Reverse Charge VAT option in the VAT Calculation Type field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på finanskontoen til bogføring af beløb til urealiseret modtagermoms (købsmoms) for denne kombination af momsvirksomheds- og momsproduktbogføringsgruppen, hvis du har valgt indstillingen Modtagermoms i feltet Momsberegningstype.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control Reverse Chrg. VAT Unreal. Acc. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how to handle unrealized VAT, which is VAT that is calculated but not due until the invoice is paid.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan urealiseret moms skal administreres, dvs. moms, der er beregnet men ikke forfalden, før fakturaen betales.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control Unrealized VAT Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the general ledger account number to which to post purchase VAT for the particular combination of business group and product group.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den finanskonto, der skal bogføres købsmomsen for den aktuelle kombination af virksomheds- og produktbogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control Purchase VAT Account - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how VAT will be calculated for purchases or sales of items with this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan moms skal beregnes ved køb eller salg af varer med den aktuelle kombination af momsvirksomheds- og momsproduktbogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control VAT Calculation Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies description for this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.
trans-unit.target: Angiver beskrivelsen af den pågældende kombination af bogføringsføringsgrupper for momsvirksomheder og momsprodukter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group is blocked.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om den aktuelle kombination af momsvirksomhedsbogføringsgruppe og momsproduktbogføringsgruppe er spærret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control Blocked - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether to recalculate VAT amounts when you post payments that trigger payment discounts.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om du vil genberegne momsbeløb, når du bogfører betalinger, der udløser kontantrabatter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control Adjust for Payment Discount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT category in connection with electronic document sending. For example, when you send sales documents through the PEPPOL service, the value in this field is used to populate the TaxApplied element in the Supplier group. The number is based on the UNCL5305 standard.
trans-unit.target: Angiver momskategorien i forbindelse med afsendelse af elektroniske dokumenter. Når du f.eks. sender salgsdokumenter via PEPPOL-tjenesten, bruges værdien i dette felt til at udfylde elementet TaxApplied i leverandørgruppen. Nummeret er baseret på UNCL5305-standarden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control Tax Category - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the general ledger account number to which to post unrealized purchase VAT (as calculated when you post purchase invoices) using this particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den finanskonto, hvor urealiseret købsmoms skal bogføres (beregnes ved bogføring af købsfakturaer) med den aktuelle kombination af momsvirksomheds- og momsproduktbogføringsgruppe.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Setup)(LookupHint=Page VAT Posting Setup Card - Control Purch. VAT Unreal. Account - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på det relaterede projekt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Job No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether the project-specific price or unit cost factor for this item should apply to the project. The default project price that is defined is included when project-related entries are created, but you can modify this value.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om den projektspecifikke pris eller kostprisfaktor for denne vare skal gælde for projektet. Standardprojektrabatten for den definerede linje inkluderes, når projektrelaterede poster oprettes, men du kan redigere denne værdi.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Apply Job Price - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how each unit of the item or resource is measured, such as in pieces or hours. By default, the value in the Base Unit of Measure field on the item or resource card is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan hver enhed af varen eller ressourcen måles, f.eks. i enheder eller timer. Som standard indsættes værdien i feltet Basisenhed på kortet vare eller ressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Unit of Measure Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the check box for this field if the project-specific discount percent for this item should apply to the project. The default line discount for the line that is defined is included when project entries are created, but you can modify this value.
trans-unit.target: Angiver afkrydsningsfeltet for dette felt, hvis den projektspecifikke rabatprocent for denne vare skal gælde for projektet. Standardlinjerabatten for den definerede linje inkluderes, når projektposter oprettes, men du kan redigere denne værdi.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Apply Job Discount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a project-specific line discount percent that applies to this line. This is useful, for example, if you want invoice lines for the project to show a discount percent.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en projektspecifik linjerabatprocent, der gælder for denne linje. Det er nyttigt, f.eks. hvis fakturalinjer for projektet skal vise en rabatprocent.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Line Discount % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the unit cost factor, if you have agreed with your customer that he should pay certain item usage by cost value plus a certain percent value to cover your overhead expenses.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kostprisfaktoren, hvis du har aftalt med debitoren, at vedkommende skal betale for forbrug af en bestemt vare med kostværdien plus en procentværdi til dækning af omkostninger.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Unit Cost Factor - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price of one unit of the item or resource. You can enter a price manually or have it entered according to the Price/Profit Calculation field on the related card.
trans-unit.target: Angiver prisen for én enhed af varen eller ressourcen. Du kan angive en pris manuelt eller få den angivet i henhold til feltet Avancepct.beregning på det dertilhørende kort.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Unit Price - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant code if the price that you are setting up should apply to a specific variant of the item.
trans-unit.target: Angiver variantkoden, hvis den pris, du angiver, skal gælde for en bestemt variant af varen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Variant Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the description of the item you have entered in the Item No. field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver beskrivelsen af den vare, du har angivet i feltet Varenr.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the default currency code that is defined for a project. Project item prices will only be used if the currency code for the project item is the same as the currency code set for the project.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den standardvalutakode, der er defineret for et projekt. Projektvarepriser anvendes kun, hvis valutakoden for projektvaren er den samme som den valutakode, der er angivet for projektet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Currency Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the project task if the item price should only apply to a specific project task.
trans-unit.target: Angiv nummeret på projektopgaven, hvis vareprisen kun skal gælde for en specifik projektopgave.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Job Task No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the item that this price applies to. Choose the field to see the available items.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den vare, som denne pris gælder for. Vælg feltet for at se de tilgængelige varer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Pricing)(LookupHint=Page Job Item Prices - Control Item No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if your vendor ships the items directly to your customer.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om din kreditor sender varerne på linjen direkte til din debitor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Drop Shipment - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the global dimension that is linked to the record or entry for analysis purposes. Two global dimensions, typically for the company's most important activities, are available on all cards, documents, reports, and lists.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den globale dimension, der er knyttet til recorden eller posten med henblik på analyse. To globale dimensioner, typiske for virksomhedens vigtigste aktiviteter, er tilgængelige på alle kort, bilag, rapporter og lister.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Global Dimension 1 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the global dimension that is linked to the record or entry for analysis purposes. Two global dimensions, typically for the company's most important activities, are available on all cards, documents, reports, and lists.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den globale dimension, der er knyttet til recorden eller posten med henblik på analyse. To globale dimensioner, typiske for virksomhedens vigtigste aktiviteter, er tilgængelige på alle kort, bilag, rapporter og lister.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Global Dimension 2 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies which type of order that the entry was created in.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvilken type ordre posten er oprettet i.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Order Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies which type of transaction that the entry is created from.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvilken type transaktion posten er oprettet ud fra.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Entry Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total quantity of items that have been applied.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det samlede antal anvendte enheder.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Qty - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Qty - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the location that the entry is linked to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den lokation, som posten er tilknyttet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Location Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the order that created the entry.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den ordre, hvor posten blev oprettet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Order No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity in the Quantity field that remains to be processed.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet i feltet Antal, der mangler at blive behandlet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Remaining Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item on the line have been reserved.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af den pågældende vare der er blevet reserveret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Reserved Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varianten af varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Variant Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the entry.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Description - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Posting Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether there is one or more applied entries, which need to be adjusted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om der er en eller flere udlignede poster, der skal reguleres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Applied Entry to Adjust - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether the entry has been fully applied to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om posten er fuldt udlignet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Open - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number on the entry. The document is the voucher that the entry was based on, for example, a receipt.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bilagsnummeret på posten. Dokumentet er det regnskabsbilag, posten er baseret på, f.eks. en kvittering.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Document No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item in the entry.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på varen i posten.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Item No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item on the line have been invoiced.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af den pågældende vare der er blevet faktureret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Invoiced Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item that have been applied.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af varen der er anvendt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control ApplQty - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control ApplQty - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity per item unit of measure.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Qty. per Unit of Measure - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the entry, as assigned from the specified number series when the entry was created.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på posten, som tildeles fra den angivne nummerserie, da posten blev oprettet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Ledger)(LookupHint=Page Applied Item Entries - Control Entry No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies which type of document the report is used for.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dokumenttype, som rapporten anvendes til.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Setup)(LookupHint=Page Report Selection - Service - Control ReportUsage2 - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Setup)(LookupHint=Page Report Selection - Service - Control ReportUsage2 - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the password of an ADCS user.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.ADCS)(LookupHint=Page ADCS Users - Control Password - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.ADCS)(LookupHint=Page ADCS Users - Control Password - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of an ADCS user.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.ADCS)(LookupHint=Page ADCS Users - Control Name - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.ADCS)(LookupHint=Page ADCS Users - Control Name - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the last day when the Create Recurring Sales Inv. batch job can be used to create sales invoices.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den sidste dag, hvor kørslen Opret tilbagevendende salgsfaktura kan bruges til at oprette salgsfakturaer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Valid To date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how you want to use standard sales codes on sales quotes.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan du vil bruge standardsalgskoder i salgstilbud.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Insert Rec. Lines On Quotes - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how you want to use standard sales codes on sales invoices.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan du vil bruge standardsalgskoder i salgsfakturaer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Insert Rec. Lines On Invoices - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how you want to use standard sales codes on sales orders.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan du vil bruge standardsalgskoder i salgsordrer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Insert Rec. Lines On Orders - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a standard sales code from the Standard Sales Code table.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en standardsalgskode fra tabellen Standardsalgskode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a description of the standard sales code.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the related record is blocked from being posted in transactions, for example a customer that is declared insolvent or an item that is placed in quarantine.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at den relaterede record er forhindret i kunne bogføres under transaktioner – eksempelvis en debitor, som er erklæret insolvent, eller en vare, som er sat i karantæne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Blocked - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how to make payment, such as with bank transfer, cash, or check.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan betalingen skal foretages, f.eks. via bankoverførsel, kontant eller med check.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Payment Method Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the first day when the Create Recurring Sales Inv. batch job can be used to create sales invoices.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den første dag, hvor kørslen Opret tilbagevendende salgsfaktura kan bruges til at oprette salgsfakturaer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Valid From Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the ID of the direct-debit mandate that this standard customer sales code uses to create sales invoices for direct debit collection.
trans-unit.target: Angiver id'et for den Direct Debit-betalingsaftale, som denne standarddebitorsalgskode bruger til at oprette salgsfakturaer for Direct Debit-opkrævning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Direct Debit Mandate ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the customer number of the customer to which the standard sales code is assigned.
trans-unit.target: Angiver debitornummeret på den debitor, som standardsalgskoden er tildelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Customer No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how you want to use standard sales codes on sales credit memos.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan du vil bruge standardsalgskoder i salgskreditnotaer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Insert Rec. Lines On Cr. Memos - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a formula that calculates the payment due date, payment discount date, and payment discount amount.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en formel, der beregner betalingens forfaldsdato, kontantrabatdato og kontantrabatbeløb.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Document)(LookupHint=Page Standard Customer Sales Codes - Control Payment Terms Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that you want the vendor to deliver your order. The field is used to calculate the latest date you can order, as follows: requested receipt date - lead time calculation = order date. If you do not need delivery on a specific date, you can leave the field blank.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the original document you received from the vendor. You can require the document number for posting, or let it be optional. By default, it's required, so that this document references the original. Making document numbers optional removes a step from the posting process. For example, if you attach the original invoice as a PDF, you might not need to enter the document number. To specify whether document numbers are required, in the Purchases & Payables Setup window, select or clear the Ext. Doc. No. Mandatory field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bilagsnummeret for det oprindelige bilag, du modtog fra kreditoren. Du kan kræve bilagsnummeret til bogføring, eller du kan lade det være valgfrit. Det er påkrævet som standard, så dette bilag refererer til originalen. Det fjerner et trin fra bogføringsprocessen at gøre bilagsnumre valgfri. Hvis du f.eks. vedhæfter den oprindelige faktura som en PDF-fil, behøver du måske ikke at angive bilagsnummeret. I vinduet Købsopsætning kan du vælge, om bilagsnumre er påkrævet ved at vælge eller rydde markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet Eksternt bilagsnr. obl.

trans-unit.source: Specifies how project sales prices are calculated if you change the Currency Date or the Currency Code fields on a project planning Line or run the Change Project Planning Line Dates batch project. Fixed LCY option: The project prices in the local currency are fixed. Any change in the currency exchange rate will change the value of project prices in a foreign currency. Fixed FCY option: The project prices in a foreign currency are fixed. Any change in the currency exchange rate will change the value of project prices in the local currency.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the percentage of the available capacity of a work center or machine center to apply load to. Operations on work centers or machine centers that are set up as constrained resources will always be planned serially. This means that if a constrained resource has multiple capacities, then those capacities can only be planned in sequence, not in parallel as they would be if the work or machine center was not set up as a constrained resource. In a constrained resource, the Capacity field on the work center or machine center is greater than 1.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den procentdel af den tilgængelige kapacitet for et arbejdscenter eller produktionsressource, der skal belastes. Handlinger på arbejdscentre eller produktionsressourcer, der er konfigureret som kapacitetsbegrænsede ressourcer, planlægges altid serielt. Det betyder, at hvis en begrænset ressource har flere kapaciteter, kan disse kapaciteter derefter kun planlægges i rækkefølge og ikke parallelt, som hvis arbejdscenteret eller produktionsressourcen ikke blev konfigureret som en begrænset ressource. Feltet Kapacitet i arbejdscenteret eller produktionsressourcen er større end 1 i en begrænset ressource.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the variant of the cost allocation.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Variant - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date when the cost allocation starts.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor omkostningsfordelingen begynder.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Valid From - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies by which level the cost allocation posting is done. For example, this makes sure that costs are allocated at level 1 from the ADM cost center to the WORKSHOP and PROD cost centers, before they are allocated at level 2 from the PROD cost center to the FURNITURE, CHAIRS, and PAINT cost objects.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvilket niveau bogføring af omkostningsfordeling udføres på. Dette sikrer f.eks., at omkostninger fordeles på niveau 1 fra omkostningsstedet ADM til omkostningsstederne WORKSHOP og PROD, før de tildeles på niveau 2 fra omkostningsstedet PROD til omkostningsemnerne MØBLER, STOLE og MALING.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Level - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost object code. The code serves as a default value for cost posting that is captured later in the cost journal.
trans-unit.target: Angiver omkostningsemnets kode. Koden fungerer som en standardværdi for omkostningsbogføring, der registreres senere i omkostningskladden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Cost Object Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies when the cost allocation was last modified.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvornår omkostningsfordelingen sidst blev rettet.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Last Date Modified - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a cost type range to define which cost types are allocated. If all costs that are incurred by the cost center are allocated, you do not have to set a cost type range.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et omkostningstypeinterval for at definere, hvilke omkostningstyper der allokeres. Hvis alle omkostninger, som tilskrives omkostningsstedet, er allokeret, behøver du ikke indstille et omkostningstypeinterval.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Cost Type Range - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control General - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the allocation comes from both budgeted and actual costs, only budgeted costs, or only actual costs.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om allokeringen kommer fra både budgetterede og faktiske omkostninger, kun budgetterede omkostninger eller kun faktiske omkostninger.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Allocation Source Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the ID of the user who posted the entry, to be used, for example, in the change log.
trans-unit.target: Angiver id'et for den bruger, der har bogført posten, der skal bruges, f.eks. i ændringsloggen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control User ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a comment that applies to the cost allocation.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en kommentar, der gælder for omkostningsfordelingen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Comment - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost type to which the credit posting is posted. The costs that are allocated are credited to the source cost center. It is useful to set up a helping cost type to later identify the allocation postings in the statistics and reports.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den omkostningstype, som kreditbogføring bogføres til. De omkostninger, der allokeres, bliver krediteret til kildeomkostningsstedet. Det er en god ide at konfigurere en hjælpeomkostningstype, så det senere er muligt at identificere bogføringerne i statistikken og rapporterne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Credit to Cost Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the related record is blocked from being posted in transactions, for example a customer that is declared insolvent or an item that is placed in quarantine.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at den relaterede record er forhindret i kunne bogføres under transaktioner – eksempelvis en debitor, som er erklæret insolvent, eller en vare, som er sat i karantæne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Blocked - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the ID that applies to the cost allocation.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det id, som gælder for omkostningsfordelingen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control ID - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the cost center code. The code serves as a default value for cost posting that is captured later in the cost journal.
trans-unit.target: Angiver omkostningsstedets kode. Koden fungerer som en standardværdi for omkostningsbogføring, der registreres senere i omkostningskladden.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Cost Center Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that the cost allocation ends.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor omkostningsfordelingen slutter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Allocation)(LookupHint=Page Cost Allocation - Control Valid To - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the shares allocated.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date when the item is planned to arrive in inventory. Forward calculation: planned receipt date = order date + vendor lead time (per the vendor calendar and rounded to the next working day in first the vendor calendar and then the location calendar). If no vendor calendar exists, then: planned receipt date = order date + vendor lead time (per the location calendar). Backward calculation: order date = planned receipt date - vendor lead time (per the vendor calendar and rounded to the previous working day in first the vendor calendar and then the location calendar). If no vendor calendar exists, then: order date = planned receipt date - vendor lead time (per the location calendar).
trans-unit.target: Angiver den dato, hvor varen skal ankomme på lageret. Forlæns beregning: planlagt modtagelsesdato = ordredato + kreditors leveringstid (ifølge kreditorens kalender og afrundet til næste arbejdsdag først i kreditorens kalender og derefter lokationens kalender). Hvis der ingen kalender findes hos kreditoren: planlagt modtagelsesdato = ordredato + kreditors leveringstid (ifølge lokationens kalender). Baglæns beregning: ordredato = planlagt modtagelsesdato - kreditors leveringstid (ifølge kreditorens kalender og afrundet til den forrige arbejdsdag først i kreditorens kalender og derefter lokationens kalender). Hvis der ingen kalender findes hos kreditoren: ordredato = planlagt modtagelsesdato - kreditors leveringstid (ifølge lokations kalender).
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purchase Order Subform - Control Planned Receipt Date - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: To enable typical approval workflows, such as for amounts on purchase invoices, you must specify basic settings, such as the approver, the amount limit and when the approval is due. More advanced settings are preset on the related approval workflow, which you can modify later.
trans-unit.target: Hvis du vil muliggøre typiske godkendelsesworkflows, f.eks. beløb på købsfakturaer, skal du angive grundlæggende indstillinger, f.eks. godkenderen, beløbsgrænsen og sidste frist for godkendelse. trans-unit.source: Specifies for the posted approval entry when an overdue approval request was automatically delegated to the relevant substitute. The field is filled with the value in the Delegate After field in the Workflow Responses window, translated to a date formula. The date of automatic delegation is then calculated based on the Date-Time Sent for Approval field in the Approval Entries window.

Feltet udfyldes med værdien i feltet Uddeleger efter i vinduet Workflowrespons, oversat til en datoformular. Datoen for automatisk uddelegering bliver derefter beregnet ud fra Afsendelsesdato og -tidspunkt for godkendelse for feltet Godkendelse i vinduet Godkendelsesposter.

trans-unit.source: Specifies whether the Usage Link field applies to the project planning line. When this check box is selected, usage entries are linked to the project planning line. Selecting this check box creates a link to the project planning line from places where usage has been posted, such as the project journal or a purchase line. You can select this check box only if the line type of the project planning line is Budget or Both Budget and Billable.

Du kan kun markere dette afkrydsningsfelt, hvis projektplanlægningslinjens type er Budget eller Både budget og Fakturerbar.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the total price in the project currency on the planning line.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining total cost (LCY) for the planning line. The amount is in the local currency.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price of one unit of the item or resource. You can enter a price manually or have it entered according to the Price/Profit Calculation field on the related card.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the remaining quantity of the resource, item, or G/L Account that remains to complete a project. The quantity is calculated as the difference between Quantity and Qty. Posted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det restantal for den ressource, vare eller finanskonto, hvor et projekt endnu ikke er fuldført. Antallet beregnes som differencen mellem Antal og Bogført antal.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity expressed in the base units of measure.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the amount in the local currency that will be posted to the project ledger.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Planning)(LookupHint=Page Job Planning Lines Part - Control Line Amount (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

When you export the configuration information to Excel, the order that you specify for processing is the order in which the fields will be listed in columns in Excel.

trans-unit.target: Angiver en reference til en kombination af dimensionsværdier. De faktiske værdier gemmes i tabellen Dimensionsgruppepost.

trans-unit.source: Specifies actual changes in the general ledger amount, based on closed accounting periods, up until the date in the Date field in the previous accounting year.
trans-unit.target: Angiver de faktiske ændringer i finansbeløbet, baseret på lukkede regnskabsperioder, indtil datoen i feltet Dato i det forrige regnskabsår.

trans-unit.source: Specifies a name of the account-schedule KPI web service.
