trans-unit.source: Specifies the actual general ledger balance, based on closed accounting periods, on the date in the Date field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den faktiske finanssaldo, baseret på lukkede regnskabsperioder, på datoen i feltet Dato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.FinancialReports)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Sched. KPI WS Dimensions - Control Balance at Date Actual - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies changes in the budgeted general ledger amount, based on the general ledger budget, up until the date in the Date field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver ændringer i det budgetterede finansregnskab baseret på finansbudgetposter indtil datoen i feltet Dato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.FinancialReports)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Sched. KPI WS Dimensions - Control Net Change Budget - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the involved entry or record, according to the specified number series.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den tilknyttede post eller record i overensstemmelse med den angivne nummerserie.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.FinancialReports)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Sched. KPI WS Dimensions - Control No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the budgeted general ledger balance, based on the general ledger budget, on the date in the Date field in the previous accounting year.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den budgetterede finansregnskabssaldo baseret på finansbudget indtil datoen i feltet Dato i det forrige regnskabsår.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.FinancialReports)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Sched. KPI WS Dimensions - Control Balance at Date Budget Last Year - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies budgeted changes in the general ledger amount, based on the general ledger budget, up until the date in the Date field in the previous year.
trans-unit.target: Angiver budgetterede ændringer i det budgetterede finansregnskab baseret på finansbudgetposter indtil datoen i feltet Dato i det forrige år.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.FinancialReports)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Sched. KPI WS Dimensions - Control Net Change Budget Last Year - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the budgeted general ledger balance, based on the general ledger budget, on the date in the Date field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den budgetterede finansregnskabssaldo baseret på finansbudget indtil datoen i feltet Dato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.FinancialReports)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Sched. KPI WS Dimensions - Control Balance at Date Budget - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the actual general ledger balance, based on closed accounting periods, on the date in the Date field in the previous accounting year.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den faktiske finanssaldo, baseret på lukkede regnskabsperioder, på datoen i feltet Dato i det forrige regnskabsår.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.FinancialReports)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Sched. KPI WS Dimensions - Control Balance at Date Actual Last Year - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Payables Activities - Control Payments - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of purchase invoices that must be paid today.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på de købsfakturaer, som skal betales i dag.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Payables Activities - Control Purchase Documents Due Today - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of purchase orders that are pending approval.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal købsordrer, der har udestående godkendelser.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Payables Activities - Control POs Pending Approval - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of approved purchase orders.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Payables Activities - Control Approved Purchase Orders - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of vendor to whom your payment is on hold.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret for den kreditor, hvortil din betaling afventer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Payables Activities - Control Vendors - Payment on Hold - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of invoices from your vendors that have not been paid yet.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af fakturaer fra kreditorer, som endnu ikke er betalt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Payables Activities - Control Outstanding Vendor Invoices - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Payables Activities - Control Document Approvals - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of purchase return orders that are displayed in the Finance Cue on the Role Center. The documents are filtered by today's date.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af returordrer, der vises i køindikatoren Finans i Rollecenter. Bilagene filtreres efter dags dato.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.RoleCenters)(LookupHint=Page Acc. Payables Activities - Control Purchase Return Orders - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the service. The description is based on the name of the setup page that opens when you choose the Setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver servicen. Beskrivelsen er baseret på navnet på den opsætningsside, der åbnes, når du vælger Opsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Utilities)(LookupHint=Page Service Connections - Control Name - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the service is enabled or disabled.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om tjenesten er aktiveret eller deaktiveret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Utilities)(LookupHint=Page Service Connections - Control Status - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the web service. This is typically a URL.
trans-unit.target: Angiver navnet på webtjenesten. Dette er typisk en URL-adresse.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Utilities)(LookupHint=Page Service Connections - Control Host Name - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Automation)(LookupHint=Page Workflow User Groups - Control Code - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=System.Automation)(LookupHint=Page Workflow User Groups - Control Description - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 2, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 2, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Shortcut Dimension 2 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Incl. VAT field on all lines in the document minus any discount amount in the Invoice Discount Amount field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver summen af værdien i feltet Linjebeløb inkl. moms på alle linjer i bilaget minus eventuelle rabatbeløb i feltet Fakturarabatbeløb.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Total Amount Incl. VAT - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Total Amount Incl. VAT - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the line discount percentage of the project ledger entry that is related to the purchase line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver linjerabatprocentdelen for den projektfinanspost, der er relateret til købslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Job Line Discount % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount amount that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det rabatbeløb, der ydes på varen, på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Line Discount Amount - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the IC partner. If the line is being sent to one of your intercompany partners, this field is used together with the IC Partner Ref. Type field to indicate the item or account in your partner's company that corresponds to the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den koncernspecifikke partner. Hvis denne linje sendes til en af dine koncerninterne partnere, bruges dette felt sammen med feltet Ref.type for IC-partner for at angive den vare eller den konto i partnerens regnskab, der svarer til linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control IC Partner Reference - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the intercompany partner that the transaction is related to if the entry was created from an intercompany transaction.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den koncerninterne partner, som transaktionen er relateret til, hvis posten blev oprettet fra en koncernintern transaktion.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control IC Partner Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a discount amount that is deducted from the value of the Total Incl. VAT field, based on purchase lines where the Allow Invoice Disc. field is selected. You can enter or change the amount manually.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et rabatbeløb, der trækkes fra værdien i feltet I alt inkl. moms baseret på købslinjer, hvor feltet Tillad fakturarabat er markeret. Du kan indsætte eller ændre beløbet manuelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control InvoiceDiscountAmount - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control InvoiceDiscountAmount - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code explaining why the item was returned.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den kode, der forklarer, hvorfor varen blev returneret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Return Reason Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 1, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for Genvejsdimension 1, der er en af de to globale dimensionskoder, du konfigurerer i vinduet Opsætning af Finans.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Shortcut Dimension 1 Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of units per parcel of the item. In the purchase statistics window, the number of units per parcel on the line helps to determine the total number of units for all the lines for the particular purchase document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver antallet af enheder pr. kolli af varen. I vinduet Købsstatistik kan du bruge antallet af enheder pr. kolli til at fastlægge det samlede antal enheder for alle linjer i det aktuelle købsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Units per Parcel - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies an insurance number if you have selected the Acquisition Cost option in the FA Posting Type field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver et forsikringsnummer, hvis du har valgt indstillingen Anskaffelsespris i feltet Anlægsbogføringstype.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Insurance No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Excl. VAT field on all lines in the document minus any discount amount in the Invoice Discount Amount field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver summen af værdien i feltet Linjebeløb ekskl. moms på alle linjer i bilaget minus eventuelle rabatbeløb i feltet Fakturarabatbeløb.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Total VAT Amount - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Total VAT Amount - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the price for one unit of the item.
trans-unit.target: Angiver pris for en enhed af varen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Unit Price (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the vendor's VAT specification to link transactions made for this vendor with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver kreditorens momsspecifikation for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne kreditoren, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle momsbogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control VAT Bus. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the FA posting type if you have selected Fixed Asset in the Type field for this line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver anlægsbogføringstypen, hvis du har valgt Anlægsaktiv i feltet Type for denne linje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control FA Posting Type - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the related project. If you fill in this field and the Project Task No. field, then a project ledger entry will be posted together with the purchase line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på det relaterede projekt. Hvis du udfylder dette felt og feltet Projektopgavenr., bogføres der en projektfinanspost sammen med købslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Job No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the name of the unit of measure for the item, such as 1 bottle or 1 piece.
trans-unit.target: Angiver enhedsbetegnelsen for varen, f.eks. 1 flaske eller 1 stk.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Unit of Measure - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that this item is a catalog item.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at varen er en katalogvare.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Nonstock - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of a fixed asset with the Budgeted Asset check box selected. When you post the journal or document line, an additional entry is created for the budgeted fixed asset where the amount has the opposite sign.
trans-unit.target: Angivet nummeret for et anlægsaktiv, hvor afkrydsningsfeltet Budgetanlæg er markeret. Når du bogfører kladde- eller bilagslinje, oprettes en ekstra post for det budgetterede anlægsaktiv, hvor beløbet har det modsatte fortegn.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Budgeted FA No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the gross amount of the line, in the local currency.
trans-unit.target: Angiver linjens bruttobeløb angivet i den lokale valuta.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Job Total Price (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the item's product type to link transactions made for this item with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.
trans-unit.target: Angiver varens produkttype for at knytte transaktioner, der er foretaget for denne vare, til den relevante finanskonto i overensstemmelse med den generelle bogføringsopsætning.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Gen. Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the location where the items on the line will be located.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den lokation, hvor varerne på linjen bliver placeret.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Location Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many units of the item charge will be assigned to the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange enheder af varegebyret bliver tildelt linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Qty. to Assign - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code for the depreciation book to which the line will be posted if you have selected Fixed Asset in the Type field for this line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver koden for den afskrivningsprofil, linjen skal bogføres til, hvis du har valgt Anlægsaktiv i feltet Type for denne linje.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Depreciation Book Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the VAT product posting group. Links business transactions made for the item, resource, or G/L account with the general ledger, to account for VAT amounts resulting from trade with that record.
trans-unit.target: Angiver momsproduktbogføringsgruppen. Knytter forretningstransaktioner for varen, ressourcen eller finanskontoen til finansregnskabet for at gøre rede for momsbeløbet som følge af handlen med den pågældende record.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control VAT Prod. Posting Group - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a depreciation book code if you want the journal line to be posted to that depreciation book, as well as to the depreciation book in the Depreciation Book Code field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en afskrivningsprofilkode, hvis kladdelinjen både skal bogføres til den pågældende afskrivningsprofil og til afskrivningsprofilen i feltet Afskrivningsprofilkode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Duplicate in Depreciation Book - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how each unit of the item or resource is measured, such as in pieces or hours. By default, the value in the Base Unit of Measure field on the item or resource card is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan hver enhed af varen eller ressourcen måles, f.eks. i enheder eller timer. Som standard indsættes værdien i feltet Basisenhed på kortet vare eller ressource.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Unit of Measure Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of planning line that was created when the project ledger entry is posted from the purchase line. If the field is empty, no planning lines were created for this entry.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvilken type planlægningslinje, der blev oprettet, da projektfinansposten blev bogført fra købslinjen. Hvis feltet er tomt, er der ikke oprettet planlægningslinjer for denne post.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Job Line Type - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tax group that is used to calculate and post sales tax.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den skattegruppe, der bruges til at beregne og bogføre salgsmoms.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Tax Group Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the sum of the value in the Line Amount Excl. VAT field on all lines in the document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver summen af værdien i feltet Linjebeløb ekskl. moms på alle linjer i bilaget.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control AmountBeforeDiscount - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control AmountBeforeDiscount - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies how much of the item charge that has been assigned.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor meget af varegebyret som er blevet tildelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Qty. Assigned - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the discount percentage that is granted for the item on the line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den rabatprocent, der tildeles varen på linjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Line Discount % - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the quantity of what you're buying. The number is based on the unit chosen in the Unit of Measure Code field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det antal, som du køber. Nummeret er baseret på den enhed, der er valgt i feltet Enhedskode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Quantity - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of transaction that will be posted with the document line. If you select Comment, then you can enter any text in the Description field, such as a message to a customer.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den transaktionstype, der vil blive bogført med bilagslinjen. Hvis du vælger Bemærkning, kan du skrive hvad som helst i feltet Beskrivelse, f.eks. en besked til en debitor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control FilteredTypeField - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies a discount percentage that is applied to the invoice, based on purchase lines where the Allow Invoice Disc. field is selected. The percentage and criteria are defined in the Vendor Invoice Discounts page, but you can enter or change the percentage manually.
trans-unit.target: Angiver en rabatprocent, der er knyttet til fakturaen, baseret på købslinjer, hvor feltet Tillad fakturarabat er markeret. Procenten og kriterierne defineres på siden kreditorfakturarabatter, men du kan indsætte eller ændre procentdelen manuelt.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Invoice Disc. Pct. - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Invoice Disc. Pct. - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the bin where the items are picked or put away.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den placering, hvor varerne plukkes eller lægges på lager.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Bin Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tax area that is used to calculate and post sales tax.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det skatteområde, der bruges til at beregne og bogføre salgsmoms.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Tax Area Code - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the net weight of one unit of the item. In the purchase statistics window, the net weight on the line is included in the total net weight of all the lines for the particular purchase document.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nettovægten af én enhed af varen. I vinduet Købsstatistik medtages nettovægten på linjen i den samlede nettovægt for alle linjer i det aktuelle købsdokument.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Net Weight - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Net Weight - Property Caption)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the purchase is subject to use tax. Use tax is a sales tax that is paid on items that are purchased by a company and are used by that company instead of being sold to a customer.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, at købet er omfattet af forbrugsafgift. Forbrugsafgift er moms, der betales for varer, som købes af en virksomhed og bruges af virksomheden i stedet for blive solgt til en debitor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Use Tax - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the invoice line is included when the invoice discount is calculated.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om fakturalinjen bliver medtaget, når fakturarabatten beregnes.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Allow Invoice Disc. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the item ledger entry that the document or journal line is applied -to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret af den varepost, som dette bilag eller denne kladdelinje udlignes på.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Appl.-to Item Entry - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the blanket order that the record originates from.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummeret på den rammeordre, hvorfra recorden stammer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Blanket Order No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the percentage of the item's last purchase cost that includes indirect costs, such as freight that is associated with the purchase of the item.
trans-unit.target: Angiver procentdelen af varens sidste købspris, der omfatter indirekte omkostninger, såsom fragt, der er knyttet til købet af varen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Indirect Cost % - Property ToolTip)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Line No. - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the line discount amount of the project ledger entry that is related to the purchase line.
trans-unit.target: Angiver linjerabatbeløbet for den projektfinanspost, der er relateret til købslinjen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Page Purch. Invoice Subform - Control Job Line Disc. Amount (LCY) - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if depreciation was calculated until the FA posting date of the line.

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the job queue entry runs on Wednesdays.

trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entries - Control Run on Wednesdays - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies if the job queue entry is recurring. If the Recurring Job check box is selected, then the job queue entry is recurring. If the check box is cleared, the job queue entry is not recurring. After you specify that a job queue entry is a recurring one, you must specify on which days of the week the job queue entry is to run. Optionally, you can also specify a time of day for the job to run and how many minutes should elapse between runs.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om jobkøposten gentages. Hvis afkrydsningsfeltet Gentaget opgave er markeret, gentages jobkøposten. Hvis afkrydsningsfeltet er ryddet, gentages jobkøposten ikke. Efter du har angivet, at en jobkøpost skal gentages, skal du angive, hvilke dage i ugen jobkøposten skal køres. Du kan også angive et tidspunkt på dagen for jobkørslen, og hvor mange minutter der skal gå mellem kørslerne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entries - Control Recurring Job - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the latest time of the day that the recurring job queue entry is to be run.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det seneste tidspunkt på dagen, hvor den gentagne jobkøpost skal køres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entries - Control Ending Time - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies that the job queue entry runs on Saturdays.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the status of the job queue entry. When you create a job queue entry, its status is set to On Hold. You can set the status to Ready and back to On Hold. Otherwise, status information in this field is updated automatically.
trans-unit.target: Angiver status for jobkøposten. Når du opretter en jobkøpost, angives dens status til Afvent. Du kan indstille status til Klar og tilbage til Afvent. Ellers opdateres statusoplysningerne i dette felt automatisk.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=System.Threading)(LookupHint=Page Job Queue Entries - Control Status - Property ToolTip)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the earliest date and time when the job queue entry should be run.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den tidligste dato og det tidligste klokkeslæt for, hvor jobkøposten skal aktiveres.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the minimum number of minutes that are to elapse between runs of a job queue entry. This field only has meaning if the job queue entry is set to be a recurring job.
trans-unit.target: Angiver minimumantallet af minutter, der skal forløbe mellem kørslerne af en jobkøpost. Dette felt har kun betydning, hvis jobkøposten er indstillet til at være et gentaget job.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the earliest time of the day that the recurring job queue entry is to be run.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the document number of the original document you received from the vendor. You can require the document number for posting, or let it be optional. By default, it's required, so that this document references the original. Making document numbers optional removes a step from the posting process. For example, if you attach the original invoice as a PDF, you might not need to enter the document number. To specify whether document numbers are required, in the Purchases & Payables Setup window, select or clear the Ext. Doc. No. Mandatory field.
trans-unit.target: Angiver bilagsnummeret for det oprindelige bilag, du modtog fra kreditoren. Du kan kræve bilagsnummeret til bogføring, eller du kan lade det være valgfrit. Det er påkrævet som standard, så dette bilag refererer til originalen. Det fjerner et trin fra bogføringsprocessen at gøre bilagsnumre valgfri. Hvis du f.eks. vedhæfter den oprindelige faktura som en PDF-fil, behøver du måske ikke at angive bilagsnummeret. I vinduet Købsopsætning kan du vælge, om bilagsnumre er påkrævet ved at vælge eller rydde markeringen i afkrydsningsfeltet Eksternt bilagsnr. obl.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the planned date that the shipment will be delivered at the customer's address. If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates whether the items will be available for delivery on this date. If the items are available, the planned delivery date will be the same as the requested delivery date. If not, the program calculates the date that the items are available for delivery and enters this date in the Planned Delivery Date field.

Hvis debitoren anmoder om en leveringsdato, beregner programmet, om varerne er disponible for levering på denne dato. Hvis varerne er disponible, er den planlagte leveringsdato den samme som den anmodede leveringsdato. Hvis ikke, beregner programmet den dato, hvor varerne er disponible for levering, og angiver denne dato i feltet Planlagt leveringsdato.

trans-unit.source: The G/L Account Where-Used page shows the setup tables that use the given G/L account. Each line refers to one line in a setup table. The page can list several lines from the same setup table if, for example, more than one posting group in a posting setup table uses the account. You can explore details for a line by choosing the Show Details action.

trans-unit.source: Use a column definition to specify the columns to include in a report. For example, you can design a report layout to compare net change and balance for the same period this year and last year. You can have up to 15 columns in a column definition. For example, multiple columns are useful for displaying budgets for 12 months with a column that shows the total.
trans-unit.target: Brug en kolonnedefinition til at angive de kolonner, der skal medtages i en rapport. Du kan f.eks. designe et rapportlayout for at sammenligne nettoændring og saldo for samme periode i år og sidste år. Du kan have op til 15 kolonner i en kolonnedefinition. Flere kolonner er f.eks. nyttige til visning af budgetter for 12 måneder med en kolonne, der viser totalen.

For example, you can create subtotals for groups of accounts and then include that total in other totals. You can also calculate intermediate steps that aren't shown in the final report.

trans-unit.source: View a detailed list of items that must be picked for a particular production order, from which location (and bin, if the location uses bins) they must be picked, and when the items are due for production.
trans-unit.target: Vis en detaljeret oversigt over, hvilke varer der skal plukkes til en bestemt produktionsordre, fra hvilken lokation (og placering, hvis lokationen anvender placeringer) de skal plukkes, og hvornår varerne skal være klar til produktion.

trans-unit.source: View or edit information about where resources are located. In this window, you can assign resources to locations.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger oplysninger om, hvor ressourcerne er placeret. Du kan tildele ressourcer for lokationer i dette vindue.

trans-unit.source: Prepare to create a production order to fulfill the sales demand.
trans-unit.target: Gør dig klar til at oprette en produktionsordre for at opfylde salgsbehovet.

trans-unit.source: Open the item's production bill of material to view or edit its components.
trans-unit.target: Åbn varens produktionsstykliste for at vise eller redigere dens komponenter.

trans-unit.source: Calculate the unit price based on the unit cost and the profit percentage.
trans-unit.target: Beregn enhedsprisen ud fra kostprisen og avanceprocenten.

trans-unit.source: View a list of production BOMs in which the item is used.
trans-unit.target: Få vist en liste over produktionsstyklister, hvor varen anvendes.

trans-unit.source: View the assignment of skills to resources, items, service item groups, and service items. You can use skill codes to allocate skilled resources to service items or items that need special skills for servicing.
trans-unit.target: Vis tildelingen af kvalifikationer til ressourcer, varer, serviceartikelgrupper og serviceartikler. Du kan bruge kvalifikationskoderne til at allokere kvalificerede ressourcer til serviceartikler eller varer, hvor der ved reparation kræves specialviden.

trans-unit.source: View or edit information about technical problems with a service item.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger oplysninger om tekniske problemer med en serviceartikel.

trans-unit.source: Open the item's active production bill of material to view or edit the components.
trans-unit.target: Åbn varens aktive produktionsstykliste for at vise eller redigere komponenterne.
Version af aktiv stykliste for produktion

trans-unit.source: Calculate the unit cost of the item by rolling up the unit cost of each component and resource in the item's production BOM. The unit cost of a parent item must equal the total of the unit costs of its components, subassemblies, and any resources.
trans-unit.target: Beregn kostprisen for varen ved at akkumulere kostprisen for hver komponent og ressource på varens produktionsstykliste. Kostprisen for en overordnet vare skal altid svare til den samlede kostpris for komponenter, halvfabrikata og andre ressourcer.

trans-unit.source: View or edit your settings for troubleshooting service items.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger dine indstillinger for fejlfinding til serviceartikler.

trans-unit.source: View a list of all registered resources with information about whether they have the skills required to service the particular service item group, item, or service item.
trans-unit.target: Vis en liste over alle registrerede ressourcer med oplysninger om, hvorvidt de har de nødvendige kvalifikationer til at reparere den aktuelle serviceartikelgruppe, vare eller serviceartikel.

trans-unit.source: Use this function to export manufacturing item related data to text file (you can attach this file to support requests in case you may have issues with costing calculation).
trans-unit.target: Brug denne funktion til at eksportere fremstillingsrerelaterede data til en tekstfil (du kan vedhæfte denne fil til supportanmodninger, hvis du har problemer med omkostningsberegning).

trans-unit.source: Calculate the unit cost of the item by rolling up the unit cost of each component and resource in the item's assembly BOM. The unit cost of a parent item must equal the total of the unit costs of its components, subassemblies, and any resources.
trans-unit.target: Beregn kostprisen for varen ved at akkumulere kostprisen for hver komponent og ressource på varens montagestykliste. Kostprisen for en overordnet vare skal altid svare til den samlede kostpris for komponenter, halvfabrikata og andre ressourcer.

trans-unit.source: View instances of the item as service items, such as machines that you maintain or repair for customers through service orders.
trans-unit.target: Vis forekomster af varen som serviceartikler, f.eks. maskiner som du vedligeholder eller reparerer for debitorer via serviceordrer.

trans-unit.source: Open the stockkeeping unit's production bill of material to view or edit its components. If production bill of material is not defined in the stockkeeping unit, the production bill of material from the item card is used.
trans-unit.target: Åbn lagervarens produktionsstykliste for at få vist eller redigere dens komponenter. Hvis der ikke er angivet en produktionsstykliste i lagerbeholdningen, bruges produktionsstyklisten fra varekortet.

trans-unit.source: Open the stockkeeping unit's active production bill of material to view or edit the components. If production bill of material is not defined in the stockkeeping unit, the production bill of material from the item card is used.
trans-unit.target: Åbn lagervarens aktive produktionsstykliste for at få vist eller redigere komponenterne. Hvis der ikke er angivet en produktionsstykliste i lagerbeholdningen, bruges produktionsstyklisten fra varekortet.
Version af aktiv stykliste for produktion

trans-unit.source: View the assignment of skills to the resource. You can use skill codes to allocate skilled resources to service items or items that need special skills for servicing.
trans-unit.target: Vis tildelingen af kvalifikationer til ressourcen. Du kan bruge kvalifikationskoderne til at allokere kvalificerede ressourcer til serviceartikler eller varer, som kræver specialviden ved reparation.

trans-unit.source: View the service order allocations of the resource.
View where resources are located or assign resources to locations.
trans-unit.target: Vis, hvor ressourcer er placeret, eller tildel ressourcer til lokationer.

trans-unit.source: View the different service zones that you can assign to customers and resources. When you allocate a resource to a service task that is to be performed at the customer site, you can select a resource that is located in the same service zone as the customer.
trans-unit.target: Vis de forskellige servicezoner, som du kan tildele debitorer og ressourcer. Når du allokerer en ressource til en serviceopgave, der skal udføres på debitorens adresse, kan du vælge en ressource, som er placeret i samme servicezone som debitoren.

trans-unit.source: Send an email to this user.
trans-unit.target: Send en mail til denne bruger.

trans-unit.target: Vis brugerens faktiske rettigheder for alle objekter ud fra det tildelte rettighedssæt, og rediger brugerens rettigheder i rettighedssættet af typen Brugerdefineret.

trans-unit.source: Set up an external accountant with access to your Dynamics 365.
trans-unit.target: Giv en ekstern revisor adgang til din Dynamics 365.

trans-unit.source: View or edit the available permission sets and apply permission sets to existing users.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger de tilgængelige sæt, og anvend rettighedssæt på eksisterende brugere.

trans-unit.source: View the warehouse employees that exist in the system.
trans-unit.target: Få vist de lagerstedsmedarbejdere, der findes i systemet.

trans-unit.source: Send an email to this user.
trans-unit.target: Send en mail til denne bruger.

trans-unit.source: View the salespeople/purchasers that exist in the system.
trans-unit.target: Få vist de sælgere/indkøbere, som findes i systemet.

trans-unit.source: Restore the default permissions based on changes to the related plan.
trans-unit.target: Gendan standardtilladelserne baseret på ændringer af den relaterede plan.

trans-unit.source: View or edit the available permission sets and apply permission sets to existing security groups.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger de tilgængelige rettighedssæt, og anvend rettighedssæt på eksisterende sikkerhedsgrupper.

trans-unit.source: View or edit which feature objects that users need to access and set up the related permissions in permission sets that you can assign to the users of the database.
trans-unit.target: Vis eller rediger, hvilke funktionsobjekter brugerne skal bruge til at få adgang til og konfigurere de relaterede tilladelser i rettighedssæt, som du kan tildele til databasens brugere.

trans-unit.source: Assign printers to users and/or reports so that a user always uses a specific printer, or a specific report only prints on a specific printer.
trans-unit.target: Tildel printere til brugere og/eller rapporter, så en bruger altid benytteren en specifik printer, eller en specifik rapport kun udskrives på en specifik printer.

trans-unit.source: Add or modify groups of users that you can assign user tasks to in this company.
trans-unit.target: Tilføj eller rediger brugergrupper, du kan tildele brugeropgaver i denne virksomhed.

trans-unit.source: Set up journals, journal templates, and journal batches for fixed assets.
trans-unit.target: Konfigurer kladder, kladdetyper og kladdenavne til anlægsaktiver.

trans-unit.source: Make additional choices for certain users.
trans-unit.target: Foretag yderligere valg til bestemte brugere.

trans-unit.source: Here, you can define when certain users can post transactions. You can also designate time sheet roles or associate users with sales/purchaser codes.
trans-unit.target: Her kan du definere, hvornår bestemte brugere kan bogføre transaktioner. Du kan også tildele timeseddelroller eller knytte brugere til salgs-/indkøberkoder.

View where and in what quantities the item is used in the product structure. The report only shows information for the top-level item. For example, if item "A" is used to produce item "B", and item "B" is used to produce item "C", the report will show item B if you run this report for item A. If you run this report for item B, then item C will be shown as where-used.
trans-unit.target: Vis, hvor og i hvilke mængder varen bruges, i produktstrukturen. Rapporten viser kun oplysninger for varen på øverste niveau. Hvis varen A f.eks. anvendes til at producere varen B, og varen B anvendes til at producere varen C, viser rapporten varen B, hvis du kører en rapport for varen A. Hvis du kører rapporten for varen B, vises varen C som Indgår-i.

trans-unit.source: View the cost shares of all items in the item's product structure, their quantity and their cost shares specified in material, capacity, overhead, and total cost. Capacity and subcontractor costs are calculated as the costs related to produce all of the items in the parent item's product structure.
trans-unit.target: Vis kostprisfordelinger for alle varer i varens produktstruktur, deres antal og deres kostprisfordelinger med angivelse af materiale, kapacitet, indirekte og samlede omkostninger. Materialekostprisen beregnes som kostprisen af alle varer i den overordnede vares produktstruktur. Kapacitet og underleverandør beregnes som omkostningen ved at producere alle varerne i den overordnede vares produktstruktur.

trans-unit.source: View the item's cost broken down in inventory, WIP, or COGS, according to purchase and material cost, capacity cost, capacity overhead cost, manufacturing overhead cost, subcontracted cost, variance, indirect cost, revaluation, and rounding. The report breaks down cost at a single BOM level and does not roll up the costs from lower BOM levels. The report does not calculate the cost share from items that use the Average costing method.
trans-unit.target: Vis varens omkostninger fordelt i lager, Igangværende arbejde eller vareforbrug afhængigt af indkøbs- og materialekostpris, faste kapacitetsomkostninger, faste produktionsomkostninger, underleverandørkostpris, varians, indirekte omkostning, regulering og afrunding. Rapporten fordeler omkostningen ved et enkelt styklisteniveau og akkumulerer ikke omkostningerne fra lavere styklisteniveauer. Rapporten beregner ikke kostprisfordelingen for elementer, som bruger kostmetoden Gennemsnit.

trans-unit.source: Specifies how consumption of the item (component) is calculated and handled in production processes. Manual: Enter and post consumption in the consumption journal manually. Forward: Automatically posts consumption according to the production order component lines when the first operation starts. Backward: Automatically calculates and posts consumption according to the production order component lines when the production order is finished. Pick + Forward / Pick + Backward: Variations with warehousing.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvordan forbruget af varen (komponenten) beregnes og håndteres i produktionsprocesserne. Manuelt: Angiv og bogfør forbrug i forbrugskladden manuelt. Fremad: Bogfører automatisk forbrug ifølge produktionsordrekomponentlinjerne, når den første handling starter. trans-unit.source: Specifies the default number of units of the item that are processed in one production operation. This affects standard cost calculations and capacity planning. If the item routing includes fixed costs such as setup time, the value in this field is used to calculate the standard cost and distribute the setup costs. During demand planning, this value is used together with the value in the Default Dampener % field to ignore negligible changes in demand and avoid re-planning. Note that if you leave the field blank, it will be threated as 1.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det standardantal enheder af varen, der er behandlet i én produktionshandling. Det påvirker beregningen af standardkostprisen og kapacitetsplanlægning. Hvis vareruten indeholder faste omkostninger, f.eks. opstillingstid, bruges værdien i dette felt til at beregne standardkostprisen og fordele opsætningsomkostningerne. Under behovsplanlægningen bruges denne værdi sammen med værdien i feltet Standardbuffer % for at ignorere ubetydelige ændringer i efterspørgslen og undgå ny planlægning. Bemærk, at hvis du lader feltet være tomt, behandles det som 1.

Example 2: To pay the invoice two days before the due date, enter -2D (minus two days).

Eksempel 1: Hvis du vil betale fakturaen om fredagen i den uge, hvori den forfalder, skal du indtaste CW-2D (current week (aktuel uge) minus to dage). Eksempel 2: Hvis du vil betale fakturaen to dage før forfaldsdatoen, skal du indtaste -2D (minus to dage).

trans-unit.source: Specifies if you want the batch job to make one line per vendor for each currency in which the vendor has ledger entries. If, for example, a vendor uses two currencies, the batch job will create two lines in the payment journal for this vendor. If you are using Remit Addresses the batch job will create a line for each remit address. The batch job then uses the Applies-to ID field when the journal lines are posted to apply the lines to vendor ledger entries. If you do not select this check box, then the batch job will make one line per invoice.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, om batchjobbet skal oprette én linje pr. kreditor for hver valuta, hvor kreditoren har finansposter. Hvis en kreditor f.eks. benytter to valutaer, oprettes der to linjer i udbetalingskladden for denne kreditor. Hvis du bruger Remitteringsadresser, opretter batchjobbet en linje for hver remitteringsadresse. Batchjobbet bruger derefter feltet Udlignings-id til at føje linjerne til kreditorposterne, når kladdelinjerne er bogført, så linjerne udlignes med kreditorposter. Hvis du ikke markerer afkrydsningsfeltet, oprettes der én linje pr. faktura.

trans-unit.source: If you want to proceed, you must first ensure that no negative inventory exists in the location. Negative inventory is not allowed in a location that uses warehouse management logic and must be cleared by posting a suitable quantity to inventory.

(Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Production Order Statistics - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Analyse your actual costs and variance from expected cost for production orders to make key decisions about your production execution and its impact on costs. Displays a breakdown of all cost categories for a production order including material, capacity, subcontracting, and overheads.
trans-unit.target: Analysér dine faktiske omkostninger og afvigelser fra den forventede kostpris for produktionsordrer for at træffe vigtige beslutninger om din produktionsudførelse og dens indvirkning på omkostningerne. Viser en opdeling af alle omkostningskategorier for en produktionsordre, herunder materiale, kapacitet, underleverandører og faste omkostninger.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Production Order Statistics - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Fixed Asset - Details - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: The **Fixed Asset Details** report provides a comprehensive overview of all relevant information pertaining to each fixed asset owned by an organization. This report serves as a detailed transaction information and reference tool for asset management.
trans-unit.target: Rapporten **Detaljer om anlægsposter** giver et omfattende overblik over alle relevante oplysninger vedrørende hvert enkelt anlægsaktiv, der ejes af en organisation. Denne rapport fungerer som et detaljeret transaktionsinformations- og referenceværktøj til aktivstyring.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Fixed Asset - Details - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Ledger)(LookupHint=Report Job Register - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Document a project register's contents for internal or external audits.
trans-unit.target: Dokumentere et projektregisters indhold til interne eller eksterne revisioner.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Projects.Project.Ledger)(LookupHint=Report Job Register - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Salesperson - Opportunities - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Review which salespeople handle which opportunities.
trans-unit.target: Gennemse, hvilke sælgere der håndterer hvilke Leads.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Salesperson - Opportunities - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Reporting)(LookupHint=Report VAT Register - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: The **VAT Register** report displays all posted VAT transactions from sales, purchases, and journals, with filters for posting date, VAT business posting group, and document number. Use it for reviewing individual VAT entries before filing returns or investigating discrepancies, ensuring audit readiness and accurate tax tracking.
trans-unit.target: Rapporten **Momsjournal** viser alle bogførte momstransaktioner fra salg, køb og kladder med filtre for bogføringsdato, momsvirksomhedsbogføringsgruppe og dokumentnummer. Brug den til at gennemgå individuelle momsposter, før du indsender angivelser eller undersøger uoverensstemmelser, hvilket sikrer revisionsparathed og nøjagtig momssporing.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Reporting)(LookupHint=Report VAT Register - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Where-Used (Top Level) - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Get an overview of where, and in what quantities, you use items in the product structures of other items.
trans-unit.target: Få et overblik over, hvor og i hvilke mængder du bruger varer i andre varers produktstrukturer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Where-Used (Top Level) - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Customer - Balance to Date - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Generate customer statements to get a clear summary of amounts due. You can share the amounts with customers to follow up on payments. For example, if you need to close an accounting period or fiscal year.
trans-unit.target: Generer debitorkontoudtog for at få en klar oversigt over skyldige beløb. Du kan dele beløbene med debitorer for at følge op på betalingerne. Det kan f.eks. være, hvis du har brug for at lukke en regnskabsperiode eller et regnskabsår.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Customer - Balance to Date - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Warehouse.Journal)(LookupHint=Report Calculate Whse. Adjustment - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property Caption)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Detail Trial Balance - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: View bank account balances at the end of the period, including the opening balance, each transaction within the period, and the closing balance grouped by bank. View a running balance and reconciled entries.
trans-unit.target: Få vist bankkontosaldi ved periodens slutning, herunder primosaldoen, hver transaktion i perioden og ultimosaldoen grupperet efter bank. Få vist en løbende saldo og afstemte poster.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Detail Trial Balance - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Inventory Purchase Orders - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Analyse your outstanding purchase orders to understand your expected purchase volume. Show all outstanding purchases and highlight overdue purchase lines for each item.
trans-unit.target: Analysér dine udestående købsordrer for at forstå din forventede købsvolumen. Vis alle udestående køb, og fremhæv forfaldne købslinjer for hver vare.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Inventory Purchase Orders - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Service Items - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Get an overview of registered service items, grouped by customer.
trans-unit.target: Få en oversigt over registrerede servicevarer grupperet efter debitor.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Service Items - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Vendor - List - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: This is a legacy report for vendor analysis. See report documentation for alternatives.
trans-unit.target: Dette er en ældre rapport til kreditoranalyse. Se dokumentationen til rapporten for alternativer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Vendor - List - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Cost Acctg. Journal - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: The **Cost Acctg. Journal** report displays cost entries recorded in journals, including amounts, dates, and dimensions. Use it for validating posted cost transactions by reviewing journalized entries and ensuring accuracy in cost postings.
trans-unit.target: Rapporten **Regnskabskladde** viser omkostningsposter, der er registreret i kladder, herunder beløb, datoer og dimensioner. Brug den til validering af bogførte omkostningstransaktioner ved at gennemgå kladdeposter og sikre nøjagtighed i omkostningsposteringer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Cost Acctg. Journal - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Inventory Valuation - WIP - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Details Starting WIP, Consumption, Capacity and Output posted during a period and ending WIP for each Production Order. Use it to report in detail your WIP balance and to Reconcile your WIP to the General Ledger WIP Balance Sheet Account at the end of each period.
trans-unit.target: Oplysninger om Start af igangværende arbejde, Forbrug, Kapacitet og Afgang, der er bogført i løbet af en periode, og som slutter igangværende arbejde for hver produktionsordre. Brug den til at rapportere din saldo for igangværende arbejde detaljeret og til at afstemme dit igangværende arbejde med finanskontoen for din balance for igangværende arbejde ved udgangen af hver periode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Inventory Valuation - WIP - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Service Profit (Resp. Centers) - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Get an overview on profit for responsibility centers.
trans-unit.target: Få et overblik over profit for ansvarscentre.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Service Profit (Resp. Centers) - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Customer/Item Sales - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Analyze your item sales per customer to understand sales trends, optimize inventory management and improve marketing efforts. Assess the relationship between discounts, sales amount and volume of sales for each customer/item combination in the given period.
trans-unit.target: Analysér dit varesalg pr. debitor for at forstå salgstendenser, optimere lagerstyring og forbedre marketingindsatsen. Vurder forholdet mellem rabatter, salgsbeløb og salgsvolumen for hver debitor/varekombination i den givne periode.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Customer/Item Sales - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Detailed Calculation - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: This report provides a detailed breakdown of manufacturing costs, including Production BOM details, Routing operations, and associated expenses. It also accounts for scrap costs, ensuring an accurate total cost for producing the item.
trans-unit.target: Denne rapport indeholder en detaljeret oversigt over produktionsomkostninger, herunder detaljer om produktionsstykliste, rutehandlinger og tilknyttede udgifter. Det tegner sig også for skrotomkostninger, hvilket sikrer en nøjagtig samlet pris for produktion af varen.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Detailed Calculation - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Service Item - Resource Usage - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Analyze resource usage of service items.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Service Item - Resource Usage - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.Deferral)(LookupHint=Report Deferral Summary - Sales - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Track recognition of deferred sales revenue. Use this report when analyzing how sales-related revenue is deferred across accounting periods and to reconcile revenue deferral balances.
trans-unit.target: Spor registrering af periodiserede salgsindtægter. Brug denne rapport, når du analyserer, hvordan salgsrelaterede indtægter periodiseres på tværs af regnskabsperioder, og til at afstemme saldi for indtægtsperiodiseringer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.Deferral)(LookupHint=Report Deferral Summary - Sales - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Reports)(LookupHint=Report G/L Register - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: The **G/L Register** report provides a batch-wise list of all posted general ledger entries, including entry numbers, posting dates, user IDs, and source descriptions. Use it for auditing, tracing who posted what and when, and verifying financial transaction integrity by filtering entries by source, user, or date
trans-unit.target: Rapporten **Finansjournal** indeholder en batchagtig liste over alle bogførte finansposter, herunder løbenumre, bogføringsdatoer, bruger-id'er og kildebeskrivelser. Brug den til revision, sporing af, hvem der har bogført hvad og hvornår, og bekræftelse af finansielle transaktioners integritet ved at filtrere poster efter kilde, bruger eller dato
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.GeneralLedger.Reports)(LookupHint=Report G/L Register - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Cost Types Details - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: The **Cost Types Details** report provides a categorized breakdown of total costs by cost type—such as labor, materials, and overhead. Use it for detailed cost tracking and analysis when you need to understand how each cost type contributes to overall expenses.
trans-unit.target: Rapporten **Omkostningstyper - detaljer** indeholder en kategoriseret opdeling af de samlede omkostninger efter omkostningstype – f.eks. arbejdskraft, materialer og faste omkostninger. Brug den til detaljeret omkostningssporing og -analyse, når du har brug for at forstå, hvordan hver omkostningstype bidrager til de samlede udgifter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Cost Types Details - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Report Purchase Reservation Avail. - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Explore the availability of items for shipment on purchase documents, such as return orders.
trans-unit.target: Udforsk tilgængeligheden af varer til levering på købsdokumenter, f.eks. returordrer.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Purchases.Document)(LookupHint=Report Purchase Reservation Avail. - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Work Center Load - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Analyze the load on a work center. ** This report is obsolete and will be removed in a later release.** Please consult the report documentation for alternative ways to get to this data.
trans-unit.target: Analyser belastningen på et arbejdscenter. **Denne rapport er forældet og vil blive fjernet i en senere version.** Se dokumentationen til rapporten for at finde alternative måder at få adgang til disse data på.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Manufacturing.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Work Center Load - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Customer - Payment Receipt - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Send a report to customers who want documentation for receipt of payment.
trans-unit.target: Send en rapport til debitorer, der ønsker dokumentation for modtagelse af betaling.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Customer - Payment Receipt - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Contract Invoicing - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Find service contracts that are due for invoicing up to a date that you specify.
trans-unit.target: Find servicekontrakter, der er forfaldne til fakturering op til den dato, du angiver.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Contract Invoicing - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Fixed Asset - Acquisition List - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: The **Fixed Asset Acquisition List** report is a detailed accounting document that provides an organized summary of all fixed assets acquired by an organization during a specific period. This report is essential for tracking new additions to the asset base and ensuring accurate financial reporting.
trans-unit.target: Rapporten **Anlægsanskaffelsesoversigt** er et detaljeret regnskabsdokument, der indeholder en organiseret oversigt over alle anlægsaktiver, der er erhvervet af en organisation i en bestemt periode. Denne rapport er afgørende for at spore nye tilføjelser til aktivbasen og sikre nøjagtig finansiel rapportering.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Fixed Asset - Acquisition List - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Segment - Cover Sheet - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Get or print cover sheets for your segments.
trans-unit.target: Hent eller udskriv følgebreve til dine målgrupper.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CRM.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Segment - Cover Sheet - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Service Contract - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Get an overview of all your service contracts.
trans-unit.target: Få et overblik over alle dine servicekontrakter.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Service Contract - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Salesperson - Commission - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Analyze the commissions by salesperson. See the customer, document, sales amounts and profit amounts provided by a salesperson's contributions.
trans-unit.target: Analysér provisionerne efter sælger. Se debitor, dokument, salgsbeløb og avancebeløb efter en sælgers bidrag.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Sales.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Salesperson - Commission - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Fixed Asset Document Nos. - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Get a list of fixed asset ledger entries, sorted by document type and number. Use it when you audit your fixed asset transactions.
trans-unit.target: Få en liste over anlægsposter, sorteret efter dokumenttype og nummer. Brug den, når du reviderer dine anlægstransaktioner.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.FixedAssets.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Fixed Asset Document Nos. - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Service.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Service Contract-Detail - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: Get an overview of your service contracts.

trans-unit.source: The **G/L - VAT Reconciliation** report compares VAT amounts posted in the general ledger with the underlying VAT entries. Use it for validating VAT accuracy during filing periods to ensure reported amounts match transaction-level data. It helps detect discrepancies early and supports audit readiness by reconciling VAT postings with actual entries.
trans-unit.target: Rapporten **Finans – momsafstemning** sammenligner momsbeløb, der er bogført i finans, med de underliggende momsposter. Brug den til validering af momsnøjagtighed i indberetningsperioder for at sikre, at rapporterede beløb stemmer overens med data på transaktionsniveau. Det hjælper med at opdage uoverensstemmelser tidligt og understøtter revisionsparathed ved at afstemme momsbogføringer med faktiske poster.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Reporting)(LookupHint=Report G/L - VAT Reconciliation - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.Consolidation)(LookupHint=Report G/L Consolidation Eliminations - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: The **G/L Consolidation Eliminations** report identifies and removes internal transactions between companies to prevent duplication in consolidated financial statements. Use it for intercompany financial consolidation to eliminate duplicate revenues and expenses, ensuring accurate and compliant group reporting.
trans-unit.target: Rapporten **Arbejdskladde o. kons. råbal.** identificerer og fjerner interne transaktioner mellem virksomheder for at undgå duplikering i koncernregnskaber. Brug den til intern finansiel konsolidering for at eliminere duplikerede indtægter og udgifter, hvilket sikrer nøjagtig koncernrapportering, der overholder standarderne.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.Consolidation)(LookupHint=Report G/L Consolidation Eliminations - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)
(Namespace=Microsoft.Finance.VAT.Reporting)(LookupHint=Report EC Sales List - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: The **EC Sales List** report summarizes sales of goods and services to VAT-registered customers in other EU countries for tax reporting. Use it for preparing and submitting EC Sales declarations to EU tax authorities, ensuring compliance with intra-EU VAT reporting requirements.

Brug den til at udarbejde og indsende EU-salgsangivelser til EU's skattemyndigheder og sikre overholdelse af momsrapporteringskravene inden for EU.

(Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Cost Acctg. Statement/Budget - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutTitle)

trans-unit.source: The **Cost Accounting Statement/Budget** report compares actual costs against budgeted amounts by cost center, highlighting variances in both value and percentage. Use it for evaluating budget performance during planning cycles, helping identify gaps between projected and actual costs to improve budgeting accuracy.
trans-unit.target: Rapporten **Omk.regnskabskontoudtog/budget** sammenligner faktiske omkostninger med budgetterede beløb efter omkostningssted og fremhæver afvigelser i både værdi og procentdel. Brug den til evaluering af budgetresultater under planlægningscyklusser, hvilket hjælper med at identificere huller mellem forventede og faktiske omkostninger, så budgetteringsnøjagtigheden forbedres.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.CostAccounting.Reports)(LookupHint=Report Cost Acctg. Statement/Budget - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)

trans-unit.source: Analyze vendor balances at the end of each period by calculating outstanding invoice, credit memo, and payment totals in three periods of equal length. Monitor unpaid invoices, and prioritize payments for overdue accounts.
trans-unit.target: Analysér kreditorsaldi i slutningen af hver periode ved at beregne udestående fakturaer, kreditnotaer og betalingstotaler i tre perioder af samme længde. Overvåg ubetalte fakturaer, og prioriter betalinger for forfaldne konti.

trans-unit.source: Helps you decide whether to change component suppliers or replace internal resources with outsourced labor (or vice versa). It can also help you review and modify an item's bill of materials.
trans-unit.target: Hjælper dig med at beslutte, om du vil skifte komponentleverandør eller erstatte interne ressourcer med outsourcet arbejdskraft (eller omvendt). Det kan også hjælpe dig med at gennemgå og redigere en vares stykliste.
trans-unit.note: (Namespace=Microsoft.Inventory.Reports)(LookupHint=Report BOM Cost Share Distribution - RequestPage RequestOptionsPage - Property AboutText)

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date that the shipment should ship from the warehouse. If the customer requests a delivery date, the program calculates the planned shipment date by subtracting the shipping time from the requested delivery date. If the customer does not request a delivery date or the requested delivery date cannot be met, the program calculates the content of this field by adding the shipment time to the shipping date.

Hvis debitoren anmoder om en leveringsdato, beregner programmet den planlagte afsendelsesdato ved at trække fragttiden fra den ønskede leveringsdato. Hvis debitoren ikke anmoder om en leveringsdato, eller den ønskede leveringsdato ikke kan opfyldes, beregner programmet indholdet af dette felt ved at tilføje fragttiden til leveringsdatoen.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the method to use to calculate and handle output at the work center. Manual: Output must be posted manually by using the output journal. Forward: Output is automatically calculated and posted when you change the status of a simulated, planned (or firm planned) production order to Released. You can still post output manually from the output journal. Backward: Output is automatically calculated and posted when you change the status of a released production order to Finished or when the last operation is finished. You can still post output manually from the output journal. The setting you make in this field is copied to the Flushing Method field on the production order routing line according to the machine/work center of the master routing, but you can change the field for an individual production order to allow a different output (or consumption) posting of that order.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den metode, der skal bruges til beregning og håndtering af afgang på arbejdscenteret. Manuelt: Afgang skal bogføres manuelt ved hjælp af afgangskladden. Fremad: Afgang beregnes og bogføres automatisk, når du ændrer status for en simuleret, planlagt (eller fastlagt) produktionsordre til Frigivet. Du kan stadig bogføre afgang manuelt fra afgangskladden. Baglæns: afgang beregnes og bogføres automatisk, når du ændrer status for en frigivet produktionsordre til Færdig, eller når den sidste operation er fuldført. Du kan stadig bogføre afgang manuelt fra afgangskladden. Den indstilling, du foretager i dette felt, kopieres til feltet Trækmetode på produktionsordrerutelinjen i henhold til produktionsressourcen/arbejdscenteret for hovedruten, men du kan ændre feltet for en individuel produktionsordre, så der tillades en anden afgangspostering (eller forbrug) af ordren.

trans-unit.source: Specifies which date must be used as the default posting date on sales documents. If you select Work Date, the Posting Date field will be populated with the work date at the time of creating a new sales document. If you select No Date, the Posting Date field will be empty by default and you must manually enter a posting date before posting.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvilken dato der skal bruges som standardbogføringsdato på salgsdokumenter. Hvis du vælger Arbejdsdato, udfyldes feltet Bogføringsdato med arbejdsdatoen på tidspunktet for oprettelse af et nyt salgsdokument. Hvis du vælger Ingen dato, er feltet Bogføringsdato tomt som standard, og du skal indsætte en bogføringsdato manuelt, før du bogfører.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of sales discounts to post separately. No Discounts: Discounts are not posted separately but instead will subtract the discount before posting. Invoice Discounts: The invoice discount and invoice amount are posted simultaneously, based on the Sales Inv. Disc. Account field in the General Posting Setup window. Line Discounts: The line discount and the invoice amount will be posted simultaneously, based on Sales Line Disc. Account field in the General Posting Setup window. All Discounts: The invoice and line discounts and the invoice amount will be posted simultaneously, based on the Sales Inv. Disc. Account field and Sales Line. Disc. Account fields in the General Posting Setup window.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvilken type salgsrabatter der skal bogføres separat. Ingen rabat: Rabatter bogføres ikke separat, men skal i stedet fratrække rabatten inden bogføringen. Fakturarabatter: Fakturarabatten og fakturabeløbet bogføres samtidigt, baseret på feltet Salgsfakturarabatkonto i vinduet Bogføringsopsætning. Linjerabatter: Linjerabatten og fakturabeløbet bogføres samtidigt, baseret på feltet Salgslinjerabatkonto i vinduet Bogføringsopsætning. Alle rabatter: Faktura- og linjerabatterne samt fakturabeløbet bogføres samtidigt, baseret på feltet Salgsfakturarabatkonto og feltet Salgslinjerabatkonto i vinduet Bogføringsopsætning.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the method to use to calculate and handle output at the machine center. Manual: Output must be posted manually by using the output journal. Forward: Output is automatically calculated and posted when you change the status of a simulated, planned (or firm planned) production order to Released. You can still post output manually from the output journal. Backward: Output is automatically calculated and posted when you change the status of a released production order to Finished. You can still post output manually from the output journal. The setting you make in this field is copied to the Flushing Method field on the production order routing line according to the machine/work center of the master routing, but you can change the field for an individual production order to allow a different output posting of that order.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den metode, der skal bruges til beregning og håndtering af afgangen på produktionsressourcen. Manuelt: Afgang skal bogføres manuelt vha. afgangskladden. Fremad: Afgang beregnes og bogføres automatisk, når du ændrer status for en simuleret, planlagt (eller fastlagt) produktionsordre til Frigivet. Du kan stadig bogføre afgang manuelt fra afgangskladden. Baglæns: Afgang beregnes og bogføres automatisk, når du ændrer status for en frigivet produktionsordre til Færdig, eller når den sidste operation er fuldført. Du kan stadig bogføre afgang manuelt fra afgangskladden. Den indstilling, du foretager i dette felt, kopieres til feltet Trækmetode på produktionsordrerutelinjen i henhold til produktionsressourcen/arbejdscenteret for hovedruten, men du kan ændre feltet for en individuel produktionsordre, så der tillades en anden afgangspostering (eller forbrug) af ordren.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the method to use to calculate and handle output at the work or machine center. Manual: Output must be posted manually by using the output journal. Forward: Output is automatically calculated and posted when you change the status of a simulated, planned (or firm planned) production order to Released. You can still post output manually from the output journal. Backward: Output is automatically calculated and posted when you change the status of a released production order to Finished. You can still post output manually from the output journal.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den metode, der bruges til at beregne og håndtere afgang i arbejdscenteret eller produktionsressourcen. Manuel: Afgang skal bogføres manuelt ved hjælp af afgangskladden. Fremad: Afgang beregnes og bogføres automatisk, når du ændrer status for en simuleret, planlagt (eller fastlagt planlagt) produktionsordre til Frigivet. Du kan stadig bogføre afgang manuelt fra afgangskladden. Baglæns: Afgang beregnes og bogføres automatisk, når du ændrer status for en frigivet produktionsordre til Færdig. Du kan stadig bogføre afgang manuelt fra afgangskladden.

trans-unit.source: Due to how Business Central posts and updates amounts in an additional reporting currency (ACY), you can't use this feature if you use ACY. For example, system will allow to create Pick for 10 units even if the component in the BOM is defined for 3 units.
